AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型是在没有物理损失的情况下学习物理定律，还是仅仅模仿运动？整体运动与外观评分无法对此作出判定。我们通过非线性受迫响应对此展开研究：用一个激励使悬挂物体的支承发生振动。我们引入双重视觉—数值条件（dual visual-numeric conditioning），并在仅使用流匹配损失（flow-matching loss）的情况下适配六个图像到视频骨干网络来预测该运动。Wan 能准确预测运动，并可泛化到未见过的激励、物体、姿态和场景。反事实测试表明其能力超出了对训练视频的回放。但它们究竟学到了什么定律？我们利用动力学与几何的泰勒展开（Taylor expansions）设计了三层测试。全部六个模型都再现了线性响应，包括共振；其中五个捕捉到了高阶动力学，包括非线性软化（nonlinear softening）。值得注意的是，软化在训练中几乎不存在：仅占摆动位移平方的 0.74%。扩展到双摆和摇块（rocking block）的测试表明，持续动力学比短暂冲击被学习得更为忠实。然而，当状态估计或传播出现错误时，学到的动力学可能无法显现。我们将这些测试与发现转化为改进视频训练与生成的策略。

title: CaT-Movie: Balancing Global Planning and Local Rendering for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Current multi-shot video generators render only limited durations per pass, requiring long movies to be stitched from local segments across which narrative progression and visual identity drift. To synthesize long-horizon movies with Coherence across Time, we present CaT-Movie, a multi-shot generation system consisting of a global story planner and a local window renderer. The planner expands user requests via a large language model to preserve, infer, and complete story details, while deterministic code maintains the resulting storyboard across shots to compile self-contained shot prompts and index reference frames from generated history. To execute this guidance, the renderer applies reference-routed sparse self-attention and shot-wise cross-attention to route identities from the indexed frames while isolating per-shot textual conditions. Given the scarcity of high-quality open-source multi-shot data, we construct a dataset of over 350K film shots annotated with semantic state transitions, entity grounding, and multi-granularity requests. We further build CaT-MBench, a benchmark on held-out films with the same annotations. It gives every baseline its native format and counts cross-shot consistency only when a cut opens a new camera setup, preventing repeated framing from passing as consistency. On CaT-MBench, CaT-Movie attains the highest average score and the most consistent characters among all methods. The project page is available at https://jinplu.github.io/CaT-Movie/.

AI.title_zh: CaT-Movie：平衡全局规划与局部渲染的长多镜头视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 当前的多镜头视频生成器每次仅能渲染有限的时长，因此长篇电影需要由局部片段拼接而成，而在这些片段之间，叙事推进与视觉身份会发生漂移。为合成在时间上具有连贯性（Coherence across Time）的长时程电影，我们提出了 CaT-Movie，一个由全局故事规划器与局部窗口渲染器组成的多镜头生成系统。规划器通过大语言模型扩展用户请求，以保留、推断并补全故事细节，同时由确定性代码在各镜头间维护所得到的故事板，以编译自包含的镜头提示，并从已生成的历史中索引参考帧。为执行该引导，渲染器采用参考路由的稀疏自注意力与逐镜头交叉注意力，从被索引的帧中路由身份信息，同时隔离各镜头的文本条件。鉴于高质量开源多镜头数据的稀缺，我们构建了一个包含超过 350K 个电影镜头的数据集，并标注了语义状态转换、实体定位与多粒度请求。我们进一步构建了 CaT-MBench，这是一个基于留存影片、具有相同标注的基准。它为每个基线方法提供其原生格式，并且仅在剪切开启新的机位设置时才计入跨镜头一致性，从而防止以重复取景冒充一致性。在 CaT-MBench 上，CaT-Movie 在所有方法中取得了最高的平均分与最一致的角色表现。项目页面见 https://jinplu.github.io/CaT-Movie/。

title: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal World Modeling with Content-Adaptive Spatial Addressing
summary: Long-horizon world modeling in partially observable environments requires compact memories that preserve spatial structure despite accumulated localization drift. Inspired by hippocampal episodic and spatial memory and the multi-periodic coding of entorhinal grid cells, we propose HiSTFormer, a hierarchical spatiotemporal world model, which adopts a layer-wise organization of local temporal RoPE and multi-periodic spatial RoPE, together with content-conditioned address offsets, to capture recent temporal context and long-range spatial structure. A fixed-capacity memory keeps KV storage and per-step attention cost bounded as the sequence grows. On MemoryMaze and HM3D, HiSTFormer outperforms strong world-model baselines within the training sequence length and generalizes substantially better to prediction horizons far beyond those seen during training, while using a compact model. The hierarchical spatiotemporal design remains effective across deeper Transformer stacks, with consistent gains as depth increases. These results show that hierarchical spatiotemporal organization and content-adaptive spatial addressing provide effective inductive biases for efficient long-horizon world modeling.

AI.title_zh: 具有内容自适应空间寻址的分层时空世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 在部分可观测环境中的长时程世界建模需要紧凑的记忆，以便在累积的定位漂移下仍能保持空间结构。受海马体情景记忆与空间记忆以及内嗅皮层网格细胞的多周期编码启发，我们提出 HiSTFormer，一种分层时空世界模型，它采用局部时间 RoPE 与多周期空间 RoPE 的分层组织，并结合以内容为条件的地址偏移，以捕捉近期时间上下文与长程空间结构。固定容量的记忆使 KV 存储和每步注意力开销随序列增长而保持有界。在 MemoryMaze 和 HM3D 上，HiSTFormer 在训练序列长度内优于强有力的世界模型基线，并且在远超训练中所见范围的预测时程上具有显著更好的泛化能力，同时使用紧凑的模型。该分层时空设计在更深的 Transformer 堆栈中依然有效，并随着深度增加带来一致的增益。这些结果表明，分层时空组织与内容自适应空间寻址为高效的长时程世界建模提供了有效的归纳偏置。

title: Bradley-Terry Training Can Distort Outcome Probabilities of Initially Accurate Language World Models
summary: Comparative feedback, in which a judge says which of two candidate outcomes is closer to what happened, is a practical way to train language world models that assign probabilities to an action's outcomes. We show that, fitted with a Bradley-Terry objective, it need not teach the true outcome probabilities and can distort accurate ones. On a simulated robot push with enumerated outcome distributions, this objective takes a model that is accurate on unseen layouts (hazard error 2.4 percentage points, pp) and moves 33 to 43 pp of its probability onto outcomes that none of a condition's enumerated branches produces. The cause is the objective, not the comparisons: its optimum, computed before training, predicts where the model ends up, and a likelihood that knows the judge's rule learns from the same comparisons without the shift. The shift is robust: it recurs on unseen conditions, under five candidate laws and a three-fold denser enumeration, and about 29 pp remain without the physically impossible events. Its cost is conditional: with those events it inflates hazard probabilities, and a threshold inherited from the pre-feedback model costs about 3 pp of utility per decision on trained and 1 to 2 pp on unseen conditions, through false rejects; without them the utility loss averages below 1 pp over six seeds, though a small regret in action choice remains. Audits of readout, response and decision trace the effect from probabilities to actions.

AI.title_zh: Bradley-Terry 训练会扭曲初始准确的语言世界模型的结果概率
AI.abstract_zh: 比较式反馈——即由评判者指出两个候选结果中哪一个更接近实际发生的情况——是训练语言世界模型（为某一动作的结果分配概率）的一种实用方法。我们表明，当以 Bradley-Terry 目标进行拟合时，该方法未必能教会真实的结果概率，并可能扭曲原本准确的结果概率。在一个结果分布可枚举的模拟机器人推动任务上，该目标使一个在未见布局上表现准确的模型（危险误差为 2.4 个百分点，pp）将其 33 至 43 pp 的概率转移到某一条件下所枚举分支均不会产生的结果上。原因在于该目标本身，而非比较：该目标的最优点（在训练前计算）可预测模型最终所处的位置，而一个已知评判者规则的似然方法则能从相同的比较中学习而不出现这种偏移。该偏移具有稳健性：它在未见条件下、在五种候选法则下、以及在密度提高三倍的枚举下都会重现，并且在没有物理上不可能事件的情况下仍残留约 29 pp。其代价是有条件的：在包含这些事件时，它会抬高危险概率，而一个继承自反馈前模型的阈值会在已训练条件下每次决策损失约 3 pp 的效用、在未见条件下损失 1 至 2 pp 的效用，其途径是误拒绝；在不包含这些事件时，效用损失在六个随机种子上平均低于 1 pp，尽管在动作选择上仍存在少量遗憾（regret）。对读出、响应与决策的审计将该效应从概率追溯到动作。

title: AeroBelief: Budgeted First-Action Verification for Evidence-Guided Aerial Sensing
summary: Aerial sensing must combine uncertain overhead context with current observations while budgeting prediction, movement and image processing. AeroBelief uses the next executable action as the unit of verification against reference scores. It groups candidate views by first action, scans them with an inexpensive proposer, and selectively queries a structured world model (WM). Calibrated group bounds support strict commitment; a six-query controller connects selective prediction with belief updates, acceptance checks and scheduled sensing. Across four layout families, 40 worlds and 960 closed-loop executions, the AeroBelief controller completes 75.42% of tasks, compared with 73.33% for exhaustive WM scoring and 65.83% for line-of-sight geometry, using 91.81% fewer reference-candidate evaluations than exhaustive scoring. In fixed-reference replay with a six-query cap, proposer-scaled anchored bounds raised first-action certificate availability from 36.25% to 54.69% and reduced mean queries per state by 13.54% relative to unit-scale anchored bounds. A complete ground-hosted pipeline processes 2,685 self-collected 20-megapixel unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images from seven DJI Mavic 3M routes. Context-guided admission and feedback retain all eight independently supported target confirmations with 76.05% fewer processed images and 70.02% less accumulated active processing service than uncapped all-frame processing; feedback saves another 5.17% of images relative to static context. The studies connect budgeted action selection with evidence-driven processing of recorded flight imagery.

AI.title_zh: AeroBelief：面向证据引导空中感知的预算化首动作验证
AI.abstract_zh: 空中感知必须在为预测、移动和图像处理分配预算的同时，将不确定的俯视上下文与当前观测相结合。AeroBelief 以"下一个可执行动作"作为针对参考分数进行验证的单元。它按首动作对候选视角进行分组，用廉价的提议器（proposer）对其扫描，并有选择地查询结构化世界模型（WM）。经过校准的分组边界支持严格承诺；一个六查询控制器将选择性预测与信念更新、接受检查以及调度式感知连接起来。在四个布局族、40 个世界和 960 次闭环执行中，AeroBelief 控制器完成了 75.42% 的任务，而穷举式 WM 评分为 73.33%，视线几何方法为 65.83%，且其参考候选评估次数比穷举式评分少 91.81%。在查询上限为六次的固定参考回放中，相对于单位尺度锚定边界，提议器尺度锚定边界将首动作证书（first-action certificate）的可用率从 36.25% 提升至 54.69%，并将每个状态的平均查询次数减少了 13.54%。一个完整的地面托管流水线处理了来自七条 DJI Mavic 3M 航线的 2,685 张自行采集的 2000 万像素无人机（UAV）图像。上下文引导的准入与反馈保留了全部八项独立支持的目标确认，同时相比无上限的全帧处理，处理的图像数量减少了 76.05%，累积的主动处理服务减少了 70.02%；相对于静态上下文，反馈还额外节省了 5.17% 的图像。这些研究将预算化动作选择与对已记录飞行影像的证据驱动处理联系起来。

title: TwoPass: Draft-Guided Few-Step Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Action-conditioned video prediction lets robots anticipate the visual consequences of their actions for planning and policy evaluation. Existing predictors denoise each future from noise without using their own estimate of it, which limits the quality of the predicted future, in particular of the manipulated objects, and requires many network calls. We present TwoPass, a self-conditioned training-and-inference framework that keeps the standard flow-matching objective. Self-Generated Draft Training supplies a detached clean-video estimate from the shared network as conditioning at the same noisy state. A Refinement-Only Late Adapter applies a dedicated residual transformation when a draft is present. At inference, Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement obtains both a solver update and the next draft from each velocity prediction, requiring as few as 4 function evaluations (NFE) per video chunk. Training samples discrete solver-query noise levels and updates the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on Bridge and Language Table show that TwoPass achieves state-of-the-art results with 4 NFE, far fewer than the 50-59 calls of existing predictors. Code: https://github.com/PlantPotatoOnMoon/TwoPass.

AI.title_zh: TwoPass：面向机器人操作的草稿引导少步视频预测
AI.abstract_zh: 动作条件视频预测使机器人能够预见其动作的视觉后果，从而用于规划与策略评估。现有的预测器从噪声中对每个未来帧进行去噪，却不使用其自身对该未来的估计，这限制了所预测未来（尤其是被操作物体）的质量，并且需要大量网络调用。我们提出 TwoPass，一个自条件（self-conditioned）的训练与推理框架，它保持标准的流匹配（flow-matching）目标。自生成草稿训练（Self-Generated Draft Training）在同一噪声状态下，将来自共享网络的、经过截断（detached）的干净视频估计作为条件提供。仅精化后期适配器（Refinement-Only Late Adapter）在存在草稿时施加专门的残差变换。在推理时，草稿复用迭代精化（Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement）从每次速度预测中同时获得求解器更新与下一个草稿，每个视频块仅需少至 4 次函数评估（NFE）。训练采样离散的求解器查询噪声水平，并更新预训练骨干网络。在 Bridge 和 Language Table 上的大量实验表明，TwoPass 在 4 次 NFE 下取得最先进的结果，远少于现有预测器所需的 50-59 次调用。代码：https://github.com/PlantPotatoOnMoon/TwoPass。

title: PRIO: Pre-trained Representation for Interactive Objects in 4D Worlds
summary: 3D worlds can now be captured, reconstructed, and generated at scale, yet the objects in them stay still: a pressed pillow does not compress, and a pulled door does not swing. Bringing these objects into interactive 4D world models requires a representation of how they can move, deform, and respond physically to user actions in real time. We present PRIO, a pre-trained representation for interactive objects. Given static geometry, PRIO predicts an object-specific configuration space in a single forward pass. This space provides generalized coordinates for Lagrangian mechanics, allowing physical laws and user actions to govern motion. Configurations are linear in these coordinates, allowing the quantities needed by the dynamics to be precomputed. Dynamics then run at interactive rates without further network inference. Pre-trained on diverse 4D trajectories, PRIO learns priors over object configurations that generalize to unseen shapes. It supports meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians, bringing objects in reconstructed and generated scenes into interaction. We demonstrate its use in real-to-sim workflows and robot manipulation. In addition, compared with existing 4D generation methods, PRIO generates dynamics faster and follows user actions more faithfully.

AI.title_zh: PRIO：面向 4D 世界中可交互对象的预训练表示
AI.abstract_zh: 3D 世界如今已能大规模地被采集、重建与生成，但其中的物体仍然静止不动：被按压的枕头不会压缩，被拉动的门不会转动。要将这些物体引入可交互的 4D 世界模型，需要一种能够表示它们如何实时地运动、形变并对用户动作做出物理响应的表示。我们提出 PRIO，一种面向可交互对象的预训练表示。给定静态几何，PRIO 通过单次前向传播（single forward pass）预测出对象特定的构型空间（configuration space）。该空间为拉格朗日力学（Lagrangian mechanics）提供广义坐标，使物理定律与用户动作能够支配运动。构型在这些坐标下是线性的，从而使动力学所需的各项量可以预先计算。随后动力学以交互级速率运行，无需进一步进行网络推理。PRIO 在多样的 4D 轨迹上预训练，学习到关于对象构型的先验，并可泛化到未见过的形状。它支持网格（meshes）、点云（point clouds）与 3D 高斯（3D Gaussians），使重建场景与生成场景中的物体能够参与交互。我们展示了其在真实到仿真（real-to-sim）工作流与机器人操作中的应用。此外，与现有的 4D 生成方法相比，PRIO 生成动力学更快，并更忠实地遵循用户动作。

title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.

AI.title_zh: TuringPAI：面向端侧物理AI的基础模型
AI.abstract_zh: 物理AI需要能够在有限的板载算力下理解空间关系与动态环境、并将观测转化为动作的模型。我们提出TuringPAI，一个用于端侧物理AI的模型系列，包括用于共享视觉-语言理解的TuringPAI-VL、用于自动驾驶的TuringPAI-Drive，以及用于机器人操作的TuringPAI-Embodied。TuringPAI-VL是一个基于HybridViT-MLQ构建的0.65B模型，HybridViT-MLQ将卷积式局部聚合与基于Transformer的全局建模相结合。多尺度潜在查询（Multi-scale Latent Queries）在同一个视觉Transformer中整合空间特征与观测历史，为语言模型提供紧凑且结构化的接口。训练将通用视觉-语言数据与几何、跨视角和时间监督相结合。TuringPAI-VL支持通用多模态理解，并在定量几何感知上优于Qwen2-VL-2B，同时为两个下游VLA模型提供共享初始化。在自动驾驶方面，TuringPAI-Drive使用MLQ接口，使所有被评估的ADE/FDE指标与全token的HybridViT基线相差保持在1.2%以内，并在内部仿真评估中取得可比的综合得分。在单颗NVIDIA Orin-X SoC上使用小鹏原生运行时（XPeng Native Runtime，XNRT），TuringPAI-Drive在车载运行中以12\,Hz生成轨迹。在机器人操作方面，TuringPAI-Embodied在四个LIBERO套件上取得96.8%的平均成功率。这些结果展示了在实际端侧约束下用于驾驶与机器人操作的共享视觉-语言基础模型。

title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
summary: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.

AI.title_zh: VisualTalk-Bench：评估问题驱动的虚拟形象主导视频解释
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成与虚拟形象合成方面的进展，为用户通过视觉解释来回答问题提供了新途径。该任务要求系统能够给出正确答案、将相关信息转化为视觉材料，并通过虚拟形象的语音与动作来传达解释。现有基准很少评估虚拟形象是否指向其正在讨论的视觉内容。我们提出 VisualTalk-Bench，用于金融以及中英文教育领域中问题驱动的虚拟形象主导视频解释。它包含 800 个精选参考视频和 100 个独立评估请求，评估内容事实性（Content Factuality）、语音-视觉一致性（Speech-Visual Consistency）、视觉质量（Visual Quality）、运动流畅性（Motion Smoothness）以及虚拟形象-内容指向（Avatar-Content Pointing）。然而，端到端视频生成器往往难以将手势与特定视觉目标对齐。为探究这一挑战，我们开发了 Avatar-O Agent，这是一个具有显式交互规划的模块化参考实现。在六个智能体上的实验表明，事实精确性与视觉质量并不保证准确的指向。一项比较四个智能体的 26 名参与者研究发​​现，Avatar-O Agent 在视觉引导、感知指向准确性和解释有效性方面获得最高的平均评分。我们将发布数据和代码。

title: Stuck in Place: Stall Diagnosis and Remedies for JEPA Planners
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models plan from pixels with model predictive control, yet often fail on tasks their model should handle. Test-time adaptation attributes such failures to model error under distribution shift and updates the weights on the current episode, without checking this attribution against the planning loop itself. We follow the executed planning loop on pushing tasks. In most settings, with and without distribution shift, nearly all failures (at least 96%) are stalls, where the object stays in place while the model predicts progress. The warm-started gradient-descent (GD) planner then returns nearly the same plan, a fixed point where the agent mostly idles. We propose Unstick, which pairs on-policy fine-tuning before deployment with a fixed-weight loop breaker: a residual memory of the episode's prediction errors or random re-initialization at every replan. With GD, Unstick recovers most of the adaptation gain on pushing tasks with the memory, and with re-initialization most of it on shape shifts but much less on visual shifts. A large part of what limits these planners under GD is thus a fixed point of the planning loop, present with and without distribution shift, which a planner with fixed weights can break. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/unstick.

AI.title_zh: 原地卡住：JEPA 规划器的停滞诊断与补救
AI.abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（joint-embedding predictive architecture, JEPA）世界模型借助模型预测控制从像素进行规划，却常常在其模型本应能够处理的任务上失败。测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）将这类失败归因于分布偏移下的模型误差，并在当前回合（episode）上更新权重，而未对照规划循环本身检验这一归因。我们在推物任务上跟踪实际执行的规划循环。在大多数设定下，无论是否存在分布偏移，几乎所有失败（至少 96%）都是停滞（stall），即物体原地不动，而模型却预测有进展。此时，热启动的梯度下降（gradient-descent, GD）规划器随即返回几乎相同的规划，即一个智能体大多处于空转状态的固定点（fixed point）。我们提出 Unstick，它将部署前的同策略（on-policy）微调与一个固定权重的循环打破机制相结合：该机制或使用本回合预测误差的残差记忆，或在每次重新规划时随机重新初始化。在使用 GD 的情况下，Unstick 借助记忆在推物任务上恢复了大部分自适应增益，借助重新初始化在形状偏移上恢复了大部分增益，但在视觉偏移上恢复得少得多。因此，在 GD 下限制这些规划器的一大部分原因在于规划循环的一个固定点，该固定点无论是否存在分布偏移都存在，而具有固定权重的规划器能够将其打破。代码见 https://github.com/jhlee0619/unstick。

title: Zero to Four Views: Unified Panorama Generation and Preference RL for Unobserved Regions
summary: Panoramas can serve as shared scene backgrounds for multi-shot video generation, but most existing panorama generators take text alone or a single input image. We present a single model that generates a full equirectangular panorama from a text caption and K in {0,...,4} perspective conditioning views taken by a four-camera rig at one viewpoint. We fine-tune a pretrained text-to-image rectified-flow transformer in two stages. In the first stage, each conditioning view is appended to the token sequence together with the ID of its camera slot, and the number of views varies during training, so one set of weights serves every input setting. In the second stage, we improve the region not covered by any conditioning view. Supervised training computes its loss on noisy latents of the ground truth and never scores a panorama the model has generated and decoded, so we propose Uncovered-Region GRPO (UR-GRPO), a reinforcement-learning recipe that rewards the candidates a vision-language model prefers in pairwise comparisons on crops around this region. Because the slot ID alone does not tell the model which way the rig points, we also offer an optional variant that writes each view's camera direction into its position encoding, which lets the user decide where each view appears in the output. With one conditioning view, our model outperforms the previous state of the art, 360Anything, trained on the same data and evaluated with the same code, on Laval Indoor and gives mixed results on an indoor subset of SUN360; the second stage improves the results for every number of conditioning views.

AI.title_zh: 从零到四个视角：面向未观测区域的统一全景生成与偏好强化学习
AI.abstract_zh: 全景图可以作为多镜头视频生成的共享场景背景，但现有大多数全景生成器仅以文本或单张输入图像为条件。我们提出一个单一模型，可从一段文本描述以及 K ∈ {0,...,4} 个透视条件视图生成完整的等距柱状全景图，这些视图由同一视点处的四相机装置拍摄。我们对一个预训练的文本到图像整流流 Transformer 进行两阶段微调。在第一阶段，每个条件视图与其相机槽位 ID 一同被追加到 token 序列中，且视图数量在训练过程中变化，因此同一组权重即可服务所有输入设置。在第二阶段，我们改进未被任何条件视图覆盖的区域。监督训练在真值的含噪潜变量上计算损失，从不评分模型已生成并解码的全景图，因此我们提出 Uncovered-Region GRPO（UR-GRPO），这是一种强化学习方案，对该区域周围裁剪块上视觉语言模型在成对比较中更偏好的候选给予奖励。由于仅有槽位 ID 无法告诉模型装置朝向何方，我们还提供一个可选变体，将每个视图的相机方向写入其位置编码，从而让用户决定每个视图在输出中出现的位置。在单个条件视图下，我们的模型在 Laval Indoor 上优于先前的最先进方法 360Anything（使用相同数据训练、相同代码评估），在 SUN360 的室内子集上结果参差不齐；第二阶段在每种条件视图数量下都改善了结果。

title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.

AI.title_zh: TuringSpace：以交互式 CAPTCHA 将空间智能锚定于行动
AI.abstract_zh: 人类在视觉世界中行动的方式是：推断 2D 视图背后的 3D 布局，预测某个动作将如何改变它，并在看到结果后进行自我纠正。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能否做到同样的事？CAPTCHA 提供了一个自然的测试，因为人类正是通过这一循环来解决它们的：在屏幕上点击和拖动，并在每次结果之后进行调整。然而，现有的 CAPTCHA 基准大多已被解决，且很少涉及空间；而空间基准又很少要求行动。因此，我们提出了 TuringSpace，这是一个包含 125 个交互式 CAPTCHA 的合成网页环境，覆盖五种空间能力，必须通过在屏幕上的点击和拖动来解决。每个任务都是一个程序，配有检查器（checker）和判题器（oracle）以生成新的实例，因此这些任务也构成了一个可扩展的训练场（gym）。人类解决了其中 94.1% 的任务，而最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra 仍有 25.9% 的任务失败，最佳开放权重模型 Kimi K3 则失败 68.0%。我们进一步的分析表明，大多数失败源于对截图的误读，并且模型的推理很少能纠正错误的判断，反而会幻觉出证据来为其辩护。为检验这类空间能力是否可以被学习，我们在该训练场上微调了 Qwen3.5-9B。其成功率从 1.6% 提升至 33.1%，高于 Kimi K3，并在全部七个分布外（out-of-distribution）基准上均有提升，包括在 VSI-Bench 的真实世界室内视频上取得 9.9 个百分点的提升。这些结果表明，将空间智能锚定于屏幕行动能揭示 MLLMs 的不足，并提供了一种可扩展的教学方式，其所带来的提升可迁移到真实世界场景。我们将发布 TuringSpace 以支持进一步研究。

title: Search or Scoring? Diagnosing Why Visual World-Model Planners Fail
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 30 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Visual world models such as DINO-WM and JEPA-WM plan with an optimizer that searches for actions whose predicted outcome has the lowest cost, its distance to a goal image. A plan can thus fail in two ways: the optimizer never tries a good action that the cost would prefer (a search failure), or the cost, computed on predictions, ranks a bad action first (a scoring failure). The two need different remedies, more search or a better model, but a planner does not record which one occurred. We tell them apart by executing the optimizer's candidates, scoring a known solution with the planner's own cost, and comparing costs on predicted and real outcomes. An error model explains when each arises and so how to use retrieved demonstration windows (DemoProp): start the search from them (a warm start) when prediction errors are small, and average them without the model when large errors make the optimizer pick overrated actions. Across four simulated environments and three world models, on short tasks whose goals the planner can represent, PushT and Wall fail mostly by search, while Metaworld and RoboCasa fail by scoring because the cost, sound on real outcomes (AUROC 0.94 on Metaworld), is at chance on predictions (0.54). The diagnosis tells which remedy pays off: a four times larger search lowers the real-outcome cost only where failures come from search (clearly for DINO-WM), and where they come from scoring, averaging the windows without the model solves 127 of 168 new Metaworld tasks, against at most 87 when the model chooses among them. Within PushT, degrading only the model flips which use is better, and our rule, frozen in advance, follows the flip and solves 678 of 960 new episodes, against 530 for the best fixed use.

AI.title_zh: 搜索还是打分？诊断视觉世界模型规划器为何失败
AI.abstract_zh: 诸如 DINO-WM 与 JEPA-WM 之类的视觉世界模型，使用一个优化器进行规划，该优化器搜索那些预测结果代价最低的动作，代价即预测结果与目标图像之间的距离。因此，一个规划可能以两种方式失败：优化器从未尝试过代价会偏好的好动作（搜索失败），或者基于预测计算出的代价将一个坏动作排在最前（打分失败）。二者需要不同的补救措施——更多的搜索或更好的模型——但规划器并不记录究竟发生了哪一种。我们通过以下方式区分二者：执行优化器的候选动作，用规划器自身的代价对一个已知解进行打分，并比较预测结果与真实结果上的代价。一个误差模型解释了每种失败分别在何时出现，并由此说明如何使用检索到的示范窗口（DemoProp）：当预测误差较小时，从这些窗口启动搜索（热启动）；当较大误差使优化器选择被高估的动作时，则不使用模型而直接对这些窗口取平均。在四个模拟环境和三个世界模型上，对于规划器能够表示其目标的短任务，PushT 和 Wall 主要因搜索而失败，而 Metaworld 和 RoboCasa 则因打分而失败，因为该代价在真实结果上是可靠的（在 Metaworld 上 AUROC 为 0.94），但在预测结果上却仅相当于随机水平（0.54）。这一诊断指明了哪种补救措施更有效：四倍规模的搜索只在失败源于搜索时才降低真实结果上的代价（对 DINO-WM 尤为明显）；而当失败源于打分时，不使用模型而直接对窗口取平均，解决了 168 个新 Metaworld 任务中的 127 个，相比之下，当由模型在这些窗口中进行选择时，最多只解决 87 个。在 PushT 内部，仅退化模型本身就会扭转哪种使用方式更优，而我们预先冻结的规则会跟随这一扭转，解决了 960 个新回合中的 678 个，相比之下，最佳的固定使用方式仅解决 530 个。

title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
summary: Reconstructing an editable 3D scene from video requires matching visible structure while plausibly completing unseen surfaces. Agents can write scene-construction programs, but direct reconstruction attempts often produce errors in layout, scale, and lighting. We introduce SceneAnything, an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos, enabling text-to-scene construction when paired with video generation. A software harness coordinates agents, pretrained vision models, and graphics tools through an explicit reconstruction protocol. Shared camera, depth, and segmentation estimates ground component construction: a scene-owner agent plans the environment and briefs authors, who write parameterized Blender programs. A visibility- and fit-based level-of-detail rule selects the construction level, while unseen regions are completed and marked as inferred. Assembled scenes use fitted lighting and supported motion, and revisions undergo programmatic checks and independent visual comparisons. Accepted programs and lessons are reused across scenes. We evaluate on 100 scenes; subset comparisons show improved original-view fidelity over direct-agent reconstruction and higher novel-view content similarity than the compared video-to-3D methods. We will release the harness, agent instructions, reusable libraries, and scenes.

AI.title_zh: SceneAnything：从单段视频出发对大规模网格场景的智能体重建
AI.abstract_zh: 从视频重建可编辑的三维场景，既需要匹配可见结构，又需要以合理的方式补全未观测到的表面。智能体可以编写场景构建程序，但直接重建的尝试常常在布局、尺度和光照上产生错误。我们提出 SceneAnything，这是一个从真实视频和生成视频重建网格场景的自动化系统，与视频生成相结合时可实现文本到场景的构建。一个软件框架（harness）通过显式的重建协议协调智能体、预训练视觉模型和图形工具。共享的相机、深度和分割估计为组件构建提供基础：由场景负责人智能体（scene-owner agent）规划环境并向编写者下达任务说明，编写者据此编写参数化的 Blender 程序。基于可见性与拟合程度的细节层次（level-of-detail）规则用于选择构建级别，而未观测区域会被补全并标记为推断结果。组装完成的场景使用拟合的光照和受支持的（supported）运动，修订过程需经过程序化检查和独立的视觉比较。被接受的程序和经验教训可在不同场景之间复用。我们在 100 个场景上进行评估；子集比较显示，与直接由智能体重建相比，本方法在原始视角下的保真度更高，并且与所比较的视频到三维（video-to-3D）方法相比，在新视角下的内容相似度更高。我们将发布该框架、智能体指令、可复用库以及场景。

title: VideoRNG: Relightable Neural Gaussians from Generative Video Models
summary: Generating realistic 3D assets remains constrained by classical representations: surface meshes and compact physically based materials struggle to express objects whose appearance arises from fine geometry or complex light transport, while existing Gaussian-splatting generators typically bake fixed illumination into appearance. We introduce VideoRNG, a two-stage method that generates complete, relightable 3D assets from a text prompt or a single image without prescribing a mesh or analytic material model. A video generator fine-tuned from a pretrained video diffusion backbone first produces a structured RGBA turntable sequence under a known pose, camera, and illumination. A feed-forward large reconstruction model initialized from a pretrained video diffusion backbone then maps the video-VAE latent frames of selected turntable frames directly to millions of anisotropic Gaussians with learned neural appearance features. A shared directional decoder and stochastic Gaussian ray tracer turn this representation, which we call ray-traced Relightable Neural Gaussians (rtRNG), into radiance under novel viewpoints and illumination. To preserve high-frequency appearance while learning geometry, we introduce depth-anchored appearance training, and we make million-Gaussian reconstruction practical through foreground token selection and cost-aware distributed sampling. VideoRNG generates complex assets such as fur, feathers, and spider webs that can be interactively rendered, relit, and integrated into scenes.

AI.title_zh: VideoRNG：从生成式视频模型生成可重光照的神经高斯
AI.abstract_zh: 生成逼真的三维资产仍受限于经典表示方式：表面网格与紧凑的基于物理的材质难以表达其外观源自精细几何或复杂光传输的物体，而现有的高斯泼溅生成器通常将固定光照烘焙进外观之中。我们提出 VideoRNG，一种两阶段方法，可从文本提示或单张图像生成完整、可重光照的三维资产，而无需预先指定网格或解析材质模型。一个由预训练视频扩散骨干微调得到的视频生成器首先在已知的姿态、相机与光照条件下生成结构化的 RGBA 转台序列。随后，一个由预训练视频扩散骨干初始化的前馈大规模重建模型将所选转台帧的视频 VAE 潜变量帧直接映射为数百万个带有学习到的神经外观特征的各向异性高斯。一个共享的方向解码器与随机高斯光线追踪器将这一表示（我们称之为光线追踪可重光照神经高斯，ray-traced Relightable Neural Gaussians，rtRNG）在新视角与新光照下转换为辐射亮度。为在学习几何的同时保留高频外观，我们引入了深度锚定外观训练，并通过前景令牌选择与代价感知的分布式采样使百万高斯重建变得可行。VideoRNG 能生成诸如毛发、羽毛和蜘蛛网等复杂资产，这些资产可进行交互式渲染、重光照并集成到场景中。

title: MoRE: Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Physics Robotic World Models
summary: A robotic world model should predict how objects evolve under robot actions and physical dynamics. While recent 3D world models have shown strong predictive capabilities, they still struggle with the heterogeneous dynamics arising from diverse object interactions. To address this in a unified framework, we decompose robotic interactions into distinct physical regimes and assign each to a specialized motion expert. We introduce MoRE, a 3D world model with a mixture of motion experts organized around rigid, deformable, and prehensile dynamics. This design enables a single model to capture diverse physical behaviors while preserving regime-specific priors. Trained on mixed simulation and real-world data, MoRE integrates with Model Predictive Control (MPC) to support diverse manipulation tasks. Experiments show that MoRE improves prediction accuracy across physics regimes, leading to stronger real-world MPC performance. Code, data, and project website are available at https://alwaysleepy.github.io/MoRE-WM-site/.

AI.title_zh: MoRE：用于多物理机器人世界模型的专家混合
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人世界模型应能预测物体在机器人动作与物理动力学作用下如何演化。尽管近期的三维世界模型已展现出强大的预测能力，但它们仍难以应对由多样物体交互所产生的异质动力学。为在一个统一框架中解决这一问题，我们将机器人交互分解为不同的物理机制（physical regimes），并为每一种机制分配一个专门的运动专家。我们提出 MoRE，一个围绕刚体、可变形与抓取（prehensile）动力学组织运动专家混合的三维世界模型。该设计使单一模型能够捕捉多样的物理行为，同时保留各机制特有的先验。MoRE 在混合的仿真与真实世界数据上训练，并与模型预测控制（Model Predictive Control, MPC）相结合，以支持多样的操作任务。实验表明，MoRE 提升了各物理机制下的预测精度，从而带来更强的真实世界 MPC 性能。代码、数据与项目网站见 https://alwaysleepy.github.io/MoRE-WM-site/。

title: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

AI.title_zh: WEVO：面向全身移动-操作的由世界模型赋能的 VLA 优化
AI.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）能够超越模仿学习来改进视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，但人形机器人的探索并不安全，且仿真器 RL 可能利用残留的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距。我们提出 WEVO，一个无需遥操作的框架，用于在动作条件视频世界模型（WM）中对全身人形 VLA 进行后训练。仿真操作与移动的游玩（play）数据改善了接触动力学与视角变化的预测。一个在合成示范上训练的 VLA，在每个任务上采集 20 条自主真实机器人 rollout，以将 WM 与部署观测对齐。随后，VLA、全身控制器（WBC）与视频 WM 构成一个具有稠密进度奖励的闭环 RL 环境。在三个真实机器人任务上，游玩数据改善了所有被评估的 WM 指标以及下游策略的成功率；视频 WM RL 将平均成功率从 23.3% 提升至 75.0%，而真实机器人 RL 为 48.3%。因此，我们利用两种环境的互补优势：仿真提供策略初始化与广泛覆盖，而视频 WM 提供一个与部署对齐的环境用于策略改进。项目网站：https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/。

title: Verify2Act: Critic-Guided Latent World Models for Verifying Language-Conditioned Manipulation Plans
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can propose multi-step manipulation plans, but they have no grounded model of how a scene will change, and the pixel-level world models that could check those plans are slow and drift over long horizons. We present Verify2Act, a modular verification framework that separates semantic action proposal from latent physical verification. A VLM proposes candidate plans, a latent world model (V2A-WM) imagines each of them in the DINOv2 feature space, and a dual-head critic checks the imagined rollouts for temporal consistency and goal satisfaction before anything is executed. V2A-WM extends recent flow-matching world models with cross-attention action grounding and a causal temporal history window. We deploy the full system on a low-cost robot arm, training the world model and critic only on data generated in a digital twin. Across six language-conditioned tasks, Verify2Act reaches 83.3\% task success, compared with 61.7\% for a latent world model without our architectural changes, 53.3\% for the VLM alone, and 46.7\% for a pixel-diffusion world model. It verified every plan it executed and incurred no planning-induced failures: all of its failed episodes were caused by low-level grasp or placement slips. In simulation, Verify2Act obtains the highest five-task chain success on CALVIN among the compared baselines with 30$\times$ fewer reflective VLM calls than pixel-diffusion verification, and the highest success on cluttered nut assembly.

AI.title_zh: Verify2Act：用于验证语言条件操作计划的评论家引导潜在世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够提出多步操作计划，但它们缺乏对场景将如何变化的有根据（grounded）建模；而能够检验这些计划的像素级世界模型速度慢，并且在长时程上会发生漂移。我们提出 Verify2Act，一个模块化验证框架，它将语义动作提议与潜在物理验证相分离。VLM 提出候选计划，一个潜在世界模型（V2A-WM）在 DINOv2 特征空间中想象每一个计划，一个双头评论家（dual-head critic）在执行任何动作之前检查所想象的 rollout 的时间一致性和目标满足情况。V2A-WM 通过交叉注意力动作接地（cross-attention action grounding）和因果时间历史窗口扩展了近期的流匹配（flow-matching）世界模型。我们将完整系统部署在一台低成本机械臂上，仅在数字孪生中生成的数据上训练世界模型和评论家。在六个语言条件任务上，Verify2Act 达到 83.3\% 的任务成功率，相比之下，未采用我们架构改动的潜在世界模型为 61.7\%，仅使用 VLM 为 53.3\%，像素扩散世界模型为 46.7\%。它验证了其执行的每一个计划，并且没有产生任何由规划引发的失败：其所有失败回合均由底层抓取或放置滑脱导致。在仿真中，Verify2Act 在 CALVIN 上于所比较的基线中取得了最高的五任务链成功率，且反思性 VLM 调用次数比像素扩散验证少 30$\times$，并在杂乱螺母装配任务上取得了最高成功率。

title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
comment: 42 pages, 6 figures, 15 supplementary figures. Author's version of the article published in Science Robotics. Project page: https://roam-hiking.github.io
summary: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.

AI.title_zh: 弥合视觉-语言推理与学习控制的鸿沟：面向野外环境的足式机器人导航
AI.abstract_zh: 在多样化的真实世界环境中进行自主导航仍然是机器人学中最重大的挑战之一。它既需要鲁棒的低层运动控制以应对多样地形，也需要高层推理以解读环境线索。我们提出 ROAM（Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility，鲁棒开放世界自主移动），一个使足式机器人能够在复杂的阿尔卑斯山区与城市环境中执行公里级导航的系统。ROAM 将基于互联网规模数据预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）的世界知识与通过强化学习（RL）在仿真中学习到的鲁棒运动及局部规划策略相结合。VLM 提供常识推理与场景语义解读，评估风险、解读标识，并生成带有相应导航代价的语义标签。一个开放词汇分割模块将这些标签转换为稠密的实时风险地图，该地图作为两个预训练 RL 策略的条件输入，这两个策略分别负责敏捷运动与局部导航，从而有效地将高层 VLM 推理与低层物理控制耦合起来。真实世界实验表明，该系统能够自主导航于广泛的复杂真实环境。机器人以极少的干预完成公里级徒步，解读标识以避开危险，并评估其环境以识别可安全踏足的区域。这项工作代表了面向非结构化环境中系统可靠部署的一步进展。然而，它也凸显了在 VLM 可靠性与空间推理方面仍然存在的挑战，表明基础模型是关键组成部分，但尚不是野外导航的完整解决方案。

title: Identity World Model: Recognizing People in an Imagined Latent World
summary: Whole-body human recognition has advanced rapidly with large vision models. However, existing methods remain fragile under real-world variations, as they tie identity to transient cues such as clothing, texture, pose, or viewpoint. We argue that a robust recognizer should not merely learn to ignore these cues, but imagine how a person would be represented if they changed. To this end, we propose IDWorld, an identity world model: just as a latent world model predicts the features of a scene after an action, IDWorld predicts how a person would be represented under a changed condition. In a single forward pass, IDWorld imagines these counterfactual features under shared canonical conditions, such as the same outfit, a fixed view, or a bare silhouette, without rendering any pixels. Compared with explicit imagination in pixels, this latent imagination keeps nearly the same accuracy while being over 11x faster, at 5.9 ms per frame. Since each imagined condition has its own strengths, IDWorld then fuses them adaptively, weighting each condition for every probe-gallery pair. Extensive experiments show that IDWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on CCPG and CCGR-MINI, outperforms the compared methods on MEVID, and generalizes best to CASIA-B* and SUSTech1K, with the best mAP on CCVID. These results suggest identity world models offer a simple yet effective path to robust recognition. Code will be released.

AI.title_zh: 身份世界模型：在想象出的潜空间中识别人
AI.abstract_zh: 全身行人识别随着大型视觉模型的发展而迅速进步。然而，现有方法在真实世界的变化下仍然脆弱，因为它们将身份与服装、纹理、姿态或视角等短暂线索绑定在一起。我们认为，一个稳健的识别器不应仅仅学会忽略这些线索，而应当想象一个人在发生变化后会被如何表示。为此，我们提出 IDWorld，一个身份世界模型：正如潜世界模型（latent world model）会预测某一场景在某个动作之后的特征，IDWorld 预测一个人在条件改变后会被如何表示。在一次前向传播中，IDWorld 在共享的规范条件下（例如相同的衣着、固定的视角或裸露的轮廓）想象这些反事实特征，而无需渲染任何像素。与在像素层面的显式想象相比，这种潜空间想象保持了几乎相同的准确率，同时速度提升超过 11 倍，达到每帧 5.9 ms。由于每一种想象出的条件都有其自身的优势，IDWorld 随后对它们进行自适应融合，为每一个 probe-gallery 对（查询—候选对）对每种条件加权。大量实验表明，IDWorld 在 CCPG 和 CCGR-MINI 上取得了最先进的结果，在 MEVID 上优于所比较的方法，并且在 CASIA-B* 和 SUSTech1K 上取得最佳的泛化表现，在 CCVID 上取得最佳 mAP。这些结果表明，身份世界模型为稳健识别提供了一条简单而有效的路径。代码将发布。

title: MADJEPA: Enhanced Multi-Stage Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: Anomaly detection in medical images is a complex task, requiring the development of a robust model using only healthy patient data. Without access to labeled data, modern approaches typically employ self-supervised learning to obtain a model of normality. Since world models promise to build strong internal representations of their environment, we consider them as suitable candidates for the medical anomaly detection environment, namely medical investigations of healthy patients. To this end, we propose MADJEPA, a medical anomaly detector based on an enhanced multi-stage joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). We design a multi-stage training pipeline to produce a robust detector: (1) image-based JEPA (I-JEPA) training aims to learn a strong representation of normal training data; (2) target encoder distillation aims to modulate over-generalization of I-JEPA representations to abnormal data; (3) pseudo-anomaly classification aims to calibrate anomaly predictions by learning a tight boundary around the normal data manifold. To demonstrate our design, we carry out comprehensive experiments on six datasets covering various medical image domains (e.g.~MRI, OCT, X-ray, histopathology), comparing our MADJEPA with numerous state-of-the-art methods. The results show that our carefully designed world model, MADJEPA, attains competitive results, ranking first on three datasets. Our ablation studies further confirm the utility of each training stage, indicating that I-JEPA alone is not sufficient to obtain competitive results in medical anomaly detection. We publicly release our code at https://github.com/Sabina085/madjepa.

AI.title_zh: MADJEPA：用于医学异常检测的增强型多阶段联合嵌入预测架构
AI.abstract_zh: 医学图像中的异常检测是一项复杂的任务，需要仅利用健康患者数据来开发一个稳健的模型。由于无法获得带标签的数据，现代方法通常采用自监督学习来获得一个正常性模型。由于世界模型（world models）有望为其环境构建强大的内部表征，我们将其视为医学异常检测环境（即对健康患者的医学检查）的合适候选方案。为此，我们提出 MADJEPA，一种基于增强型多阶段联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的医学异常检测器。我们设计了一个多阶段训练流程以产生稳健的检测器：（1）基于图像的 JEPA（I-JEPA）训练旨在学习正常训练数据的强表征；（2）目标编码器蒸馏旨在调节 I-JEPA 表征对异常数据的过度泛化；（3）伪异常分类旨在通过学习正常数据流形周围的紧致边界来校准异常预测。为展示我们的设计，我们在涵盖多种医学图像领域（例如 MRI、OCT、X 射线、组织病理学）的六个数据集上开展了全面的实验，将我们的 MADJEPA 与众多最先进方法进行比较。结果表明，我们精心设计的世界模型 MADJEPA 取得了有竞争力的结果，在三个数据集上排名第一。我们的消融研究进一步证实了每个训练阶段的有效性，表明仅靠 I-JEPA 不足以在医学异常检测中获得有竞争力的结果。我们在 https://github.com/Sabina085/madjepa 公开了我们的代码。

title: GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable effective short-horizon goal-conditioned planning, such as reaching nearby targets and pushing objects over short distances, by predicting candidate action outcomes and comparing their representations with a goal representation. However, extending this approach to long-horizon tasks is challenging: prediction errors accumulate over extended rollouts, while latent-space similarity to distant goals provides limited guidance for ranking candidate outcomes. Existing methods address these limitations by introducing intermediate subgoals, either generated by learned models or selected from experience memory. Generated subgoals can contain hallucinations or be inaccurate in aspects such as object positions and timing. Memory-based approaches are constrained by experience coverage and may lack precise guidance for selecting appropriate intermediate states from stored observations. We introduce GEMS, which generates temporally structured subgoals to guide action search and state selection from Latent Experience Memory (LEM). A distance gate determines whether predicted outcomes are evaluated against the generated subgoal or the selected memory state. Experiments across six tasks and task suites spanning manipulation, navigation, and reaching demonstrate the effectiveness of GEMS for long-horizon planning. GEMS outperforms state-of-the-art world-model planning baselines across different manipulation settings, achieving success rates of 92.8% on Cube, 68.4% on Push-T, and 54.1% on Meta-World. It improves over the strongest evaluated baseline on these tasks by 24.0, 7.3, and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate that generated subgoals and experience memory can jointly strengthen long-horizon planning with a frozen world model.

AI.title_zh: GEMS：面向子目标引导的长时程世界模型规划的生成与经验记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测候选动作的结果并将其表示与目标表示进行比较，能够实现有效的短时程目标条件规划，例如到达附近目标以及将物体推动较短距离。然而，将这一方法扩展到长时程任务具有挑战性：预测误差会在延长的推演过程中累积，而与远期目标的潜空间相似度对候选结果排序所提供的指导有限。现有方法通过引入中间子目标来应对这些局限，这些子目标或由学习到的模型生成，或从经验记忆中选取。生成的子目标可能包含幻觉，或在物体位置和时机等方面不准确。基于记忆的方法受限于经验覆盖范围，并且可能缺乏从存储观测中选取合适中间状态的精确指导。我们提出 GEMS，它生成具有时间结构的子目标，以指导动作搜索以及从潜经验记忆（Latent Experience Memory, LEM）中进行状态选择。一个距离门控决定是将预测结果与生成的子目标还是与所选记忆状态进行评估比较。在涵盖操作、导航和到达的六个任务及任务套件上的实验证明了 GEMS 在长时程规划方面的有效性。GEMS 在不同操作设置下优于最先进的世界模型规划基线，在 Cube 上达到 92.8%、在 Push-T 上达到 68.4%、在 Meta-World 上达到 54.1% 的成功率。在这些任务上，它分别比评估中最强的基线高出 24.0、7.3 和 22.2 个百分点。这些结果表明，生成的子目标与经验记忆能够在世界模型冻结的情况下共同增强长时程规划。

title: Render the Robot, Generate the World: One Video World Model Across Embodiments
summary: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. Most video world models attempt to learn both from numerical actions, even though geometry and kinematics already specify the intended motion. We introduce Doppel, an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renderings of future body configurations and numerical action trajectories. By explicitly providing the intended motion, Doppel can focus on predicting object motion and interaction-driven changes in the environment. Rendered motion also provides a common visual interface across different embodiments and action spaces. To train on robot datasets without camera extrinsics, we recover camera poses and align rendered trajectories with recorded observations. We jointly train a single shared video backbone and conditioning adapter on eight datasets spanning eight robot and human embodiments, from single- and bimanual robot arms to a dexterous humanoid and human hands and bodies, using about 600 hours of video without embodiment labels. Across three robot-arm datasets, Doppel improves PSNR over action-only baselines by 1.00 dB on held-out trajectories and 1.20 dB under out-of-distribution evaluation, while predicting more consistent object motion. Training on all eight embodiments (Doppel-8) improves robot predictions over the three-robot model (Doppel-3) on four of six evaluation sets. Project page: https://doppelwm.github.io/.

AI.title_zh: 渲染机器人，生成世界：一个跨具身的视频世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 预测智能体动作的后果，需要对身体运动与环境响应同时建模。大多数视频世界模型试图从数值动作中学习这两者，尽管几何与运动学已经指定了预期的运动。我们提出 Doppel，一个与具身无关的视频世界模型，它以与相机对齐的未来身体构型渲染图以及数值动作轨迹为条件。通过显式提供预期运动，Doppel 可以专注于预测物体运动以及环境中由交互驱动的变化。渲染出的运动还为不同具身和动作空间提供了共同的视觉接口。为了在没有相机外参的机器人数据集上训练，我们恢复相机位姿，并将渲染的轨迹与记录的观测对齐。我们在涵盖八种机器人与人类具身的八个数据集上联合训练一个共享的视频骨干网络和条件适配器，这些具身从单臂和双臂机械臂，到灵巧人形以及人的手与身体，使用约 600 小时的视频且不使用具身标签。在三个机械臂数据集上，Doppel 在留出轨迹上将 PSNR 相比仅使用动作的基线提升了 1.00 dB，在分布外评估下提升了 1.20 dB，同时预测出更一致的物体运动。在全部八种具身上训练（Doppel-8）相比三机器人模型（Doppel-3），在六个评估集中的四个上提升了机器人预测。项目页面：https://doppelwm.github.io/。

title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
summary: Recent work on human-scene interaction (HSI) generation moves from single interactions to long-horizon interaction, where a language-model agent plans and executes a sequence of interactions in a 3D scene under one instruction. However, existing agents struggle in challenging everyday scenarios (e.g., picking up a toy and throwing it into a basket) because they lack spatial control over the motion and quantitative feedback on its execution, and they often fail to complete the interaction sequence. To address these gaps, we present Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework in which the agent specifies each motion through positions, paths and poses, measures how the executed interaction deviates from its intent, and revises the control specification accordingly. For an extensive evaluation in such scenarios, we build Inhabit, a benchmark of 75 household tasks in 31 furniture layouts of an apartment, in which every task chains one to three goals on movable objects and is carried out by the whole body, excluding fingers. On Inhabit, Inhabitant completes 98.7\% of the tasks with Claude Opus 5.5, and 93.3\% and 82.7\% with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. Ablations confirm that without spatial control the agent fails most tasks, and without quantitative feedback its motion becomes less precise. Code is available on the project page.

AI.title_zh: Inhabitant：一个具备空间控制与定量反馈的长时程人-场景交互智能体框架
AI.abstract_zh: 近期关于人-场景交互（human-scene interaction, HSI）生成的研究已从单次交互转向长时程交互，即由语言模型智能体在单条指令下于三维场景中规划并执行一系列交互。然而，现有智能体在具有挑战性的日常场景中（例如捡起玩具并将其扔进篮子）表现不佳，因为它们缺乏对运动的控制以及对其执行情况的定量反馈，并且常常无法完成交互序列。为弥补这些不足，我们提出 Inhabitant，这是一个免训练（training-free）的智能体框架。在该框架中，智能体通过位置、路径和姿态来指定每个运动，测量所执行交互与其意图之间的偏差，并据此修正控制规范。为在此类场景中进行广泛评估，我们构建了 Inhabit，这是一个包含公寓中 31 种家具布局下 75 项家务任务的基准，其中每项任务对可移动物体串联一到三个目标，并由除手指之外的全身完成。在 Inhabit 上，Inhabitant 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 完成了 98.7\% 的任务，使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon 分别完成了 93.3\% 和 82.7\% 的任务。消融实验证实，若没有空间控制，智能体在大多数任务上失败；若没有定量反馈，其运动变得不够精确。代码可在项目页面获取。

title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
comment: V2 corrects errors in the author list and institutional affiliations. Homepage: https://alaya-lab.github.io/WorldRuler/
summary: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.

AI.title_zh: WorldRuler：可配置规则下的交互式世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 规则决定了玩家动作如何改变交互式世界。不同的规则会在相似的场景与动作空间中创造出不同的玩法体验。为了实现可定制的玩法，生成式世界模型必须遵循超越真实世界行为的用户自定义规则。然而，实现用户自定义规则面临两个挑战：规则-状态持久化（Rule-State Persistence）与规则到视觉的实现（Rule-to-Visual Realization）。前者要求在保存与加载过程中保留规则定义、依赖关系与世界状态，使得恢复后的世界遵循既定规则。后者要求在被影响对象不可见的情况下，仍能准确地在指定对象与属性上实现规则所引起的变化。本文提出 WorldRuler，它将规则定义、依赖关系与对象状态组织为一个可执行的 3D 规则图，并将规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈以闭环方式连接起来。该图支持规则与世界状态的联合保存与恢复，同时动态对象绑定将规则指定的实体锚定到视觉实例上，并利用存储的状态从这些对象首次出现时即约束生成。我们进一步引入对象属性状态替换与反事实重建训练，从而实现准确的属性控制以及兼容的外观与运动变化，同时限制对无关内容的干扰。我们利用 GTA-V 与 Habitat 构建了一套自动化数据采集与标注流水线，用以构建 RuleVerse——一个包含详细状态与事件标注的规则驱动交互数据集，其中包含规则在受影响对象变为可见之前即已生效的情形。大量实验表明，WorldRuler 在保存与加载过程中保持规则-状态一致性，以及在指定对象与属性上准确实现规则结果方面均具有有效性。

title: Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the WAM-AD Workshop, WACV 2027. Code: https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter
summary: World models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to predict how a scene evolves under the ego vehicle's actions, supporting counterfactual reasoning and model-based planning. However, existing evaluations focus on prediction fidelity and planning performance, and rarely verify that the predictions depend on the conditioning action. In this paper, we study action dependence in action-conditioned semantic forecasting, which predicts future semantic segmentation from past segmentations and the ego action. We compare a forecaster with feature-wise and input-level action conditioning against an identical model without action input, and measure action dependence with test-time action interventions scored by standard segmentation metrics. The evaluation is validated in a synthetic environment with known action-dependent dynamics and applied to Cityscapes and BDD100K, both within each dataset and across the two vehicle platforms. Experiments show that the executed action improves mid-term mIoU by at most 2.5 points on Cityscapes and 0.6 points on BDD100K, whereas a wrong action reduces it by up to 23.2 and 7.0 points, below the model without action input. On real data, feature-wise conditioning depends 1.6 times more on the action than input-level conditioning at similar accuracy, whereas both depend on it equally in the synthetic environment, where the history does not determine the action. These results show that an accuracy gain indicates that a driving world model uses its action, but not how strongly its forecasts depend on it. Code is available at https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter.

AI.title_zh: 动作是否重要？将动作条件语义预测作为自动驾驶世界模型的探究
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型在自动驾驶中日益被用于预测场景在自车动作下如何演化，从而支持反事实推理与基于模型的规划。然而，现有评估侧重于预测保真度与规划性能，很少验证预测是否依赖于所条件的动作。本文研究动作条件语义预测（action-conditioned semantic forecasting）中的动作依赖性，该任务根据过去的语义分割和自车动作预测未来的语义分割。我们将采用特征级（feature-wise）与输入级（input-level）动作条件化的预测器，与一个不带动作输入的相同模型进行比较，并通过在测试时进行动作干预、以标准分割指标评分来衡量动作依赖性。该评估在动作依赖动态已知的合成环境中得到验证，并应用于 Cityscapes 和 BDD100K，既在各数据集内部进行，也在两个车辆平台之间跨数据集进行。实验表明，执行的动作在 Cityscapes 上将中期 mIoU 最多提升 2.5 个点，在 BDD100K 上最多提升 0.6 个点；而错误的动作则使其最多下降 23.2 和 7.0 个点，低于不带动作输入的模型。在真实数据上，在精度相近的情况下，特征级条件化对动作的依赖程度是输入级条件化的 1.6 倍；而在历史不能决定动作的合成环境中，两者的依赖程度相同。这些结果表明，精度提升表明驾驶世界模型使用了其动作，但并不表明其预测对动作的依赖有多强。代码见 https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter。

title: DiWALI: Diffusion Policy Learning in World Models via Latent Action Inference from Human and Robot Play
summary: Learning robot manipulation is constrained by the availability of action-labeled robot data, for both imitation and world models. Humans can demonstrate skills in seconds, but their demonstrations lack the required robot actions. We introduce DiWALI, a framework that learns and improves diffusion policies within a world model trained on human and robot play. DiWALI infers latent actions from consecutive frames using an inverse dynamics model, enabling world model training without action labels, and grounds them in robot commands through a decoder trained separately on robot play. Skill policies are trained over latent actions from action-free human demonstrations and improved with reinforcement learning in imagination. On the CALVIN benchmark, DiWALI policies trained solely from human demonstrations substantially outperform baselines trained with robot demonstrations. Incorporating human play into the world model training also yields stronger policies after fine-tuning than using the same amount of robot play alone. Experiments on a physical robot show that skills learned primarily from human demonstrations are further improved in imagination with a world model trained on human and robot play. Together, these results demonstrate that human experience can support both manipulation skill acquisition and subsequent policy improvement, reducing reliance on action-labeled robot data. Videos, dataset and code are available at https://diwali.cs.uni-freiburg.de.

AI.title_zh: DiWALI：通过从人类与机器人游玩中推断潜在动作在世界模型中学习扩散策略
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人操作技能的学习受到带动作标注的机器人数据可得性的制约，无论是对于模仿学习还是世界模型而言都是如此。人类可以在数秒内演示技能，但其演示缺乏所需的机器人动作。我们提出 DiWALI，一个在由人类与机器人游玩数据训练的世界模型内学习并改进扩散策略的框架。DiWALI 使用逆动力学模型从连续帧中推断潜在动作，从而无需动作标签即可训练世界模型，并通过一个单独在机器人游玩数据上训练的解码器将这些潜在动作锚定到机器人指令上。技能策略在来自无动作人类演示的潜在动作上训练，并在想象中通过强化学习加以改进。在 CALVIN 基准上，仅用人类演示训练的 DiWALI 策略大幅优于用机器人演示训练的基线。将人类游玩数据纳入世界模型训练，在微调后也能比仅使用同等数量的机器人游玩数据得到更强的策略。在真实机器人上的实验表明，主要从人类演示中学习到的技能，在使用由人类与机器人游玩数据训练的世界模型于想象中进一步改进。总体而言，这些结果表明人类经验能够同时支持操作技能的获取与随后的策略改进，从而减少对带动作标注的机器人数据的依赖。视频、数据集与代码见 https://diwali.cs.uni-freiburg.de。

title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
summary: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.

AI.title_zh: 反事实世界模型：能够推理“如果……会怎样”的JEPA
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型运行在一个它们无法完全观测的世界中。当一种隐藏扰动（例如推动船只的水流）改变了一个动作的结果时，一个反事实问题随之产生：在相同的扰动下，若采取另一个不同的动作，本会发生什么？这一问题的答案能将糟糕的决策与坏运气区分开来。我们证明，基于事实性转移（factual transitions）训练的世界模型无法仅凭自身回答该问题，无论其数据或容量如何。对于许多物理系统而言，观测到的结果加上动力学的一个简单性质就足够了：natura non facit saltus，即自然不作跳跃。当动作与扰动作为彼此独立的力起作用时，它们的相互作用在时间上是二阶的，因此反事实结果在一阶近似下等于观测结果加上世界模型在替代动作与事实动作下预测值之差。由此得到一种反事实世界模型，它无需反事实数据、无需额外参数、也无需重新训练。对于时长为 $h$ 的转移，我们证明了相对于扰动方差的反事实误差的 $O(h^2)$ 界，建立了基于非配对事实数据的相匹配的极小极大下界，并刻画了在不连续处、坐标折叠处以及扰动对指令进行缩放的情形下的失效情况。我们在冻结的 DINOv2 与掩码自编码器（MAE）编码器上，用 JEPA 世界模型从像素验证了这些预测。在四个渲染模拟器上，我们的方法在相同的世界模型下将反事实 $R^2$ 从 $38$--$46\%$ 提升至 $86$--$96\%$；在第五个模拟器——一艘水下航行器上，在使用多十六倍的事实数据的情况下达到 $90$--$94\%$。另外四个冻结编码器 DINOv3、SigLIP~2、CLIP 与 EVA-02 在相同模拟器上给出 $81$--$95\%$。在事后规划（hindsight planning）中，它在 $35$--$69\%$ 的事件中找到了本可到达目标的动作，而一个知晓模拟器但不知晓结果的预言机规划器（oracle planner）则为 $14$--$23\%$。

title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling for Human Behavior Prediction
comment: Accepted to the KDD 2027 AI for Sciences Track
summary: Understanding how stable psychometric traits and time-varying states jointly inform behavior is an important problem in computational behavioral science. Existing personalized agents commonly condition actions directly on a static profile, leaving realized state transitions unused as an explicit source of supervision. We introduce a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment--behavior state transitions to learn transition-informed representations for behavioral prediction. During training, a posterior encoder quantizes realized transitions, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. The prior code and predicted next state then condition macro-level behavior and simulator-grounded execution. Thus, the world model provides structured transition supervision instead of treating personality as a direct action descriptor. We evaluate the framework in VEET, a controlled behavioral simulator with human trajectories, and in AgentSociety as a structurally different synthetic environment. A participant-disjoint split of 240 training, 25 validation, and 48 test participants evaluates generalization to unseen people. On VEET, the model reaches 0.904 Top-1 accuracy (95\% CI: [0.895, 0.913]) and 0.0033 Macro KL. Ablations associate continuous next-state modeling with most of the Top-1 gain, while discrete codes and prior alignment mainly improve Top-3 and distributional alignment. These results establish transition-informed world-model supervision as useful for subject-generalized behavior prediction, without implying causal psychological mechanisms or calibrated long-horizon state dynamics.

AI.title_zh: PsyWorld：面向人类行为预测的以心理画像为条件的世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 理解稳定的心理测量特质与随时间变化的状态如何共同为行为提供信息，是计算行为科学中的一个重要问题。现有的个性化智能体通常直接以静态画像作为动作的条件，而未将实际发生的状态转移作为显式的监督来源加以利用。我们提出了一种以心理画像为条件的状态世界模型，利用观测到的环境—行为状态转移来学习带有转移信息的表征，用于行为预测。在训练过程中，后验编码器对实际发生的转移进行量化，而先验则根据心理测量画像和转移前上下文来预测由此得到的编码。随后，先验编码与预测的下一状态共同作为宏观层面行为和基于模拟器的执行的条件。因此，该世界模型提供的是结构化的转移监督，而不是将人格当作直接的动作描述符。我们在 VEET（一个带有真人轨迹的受控行为模拟器）以及 AgentSociety（一个结构上不同的合成环境）中对这一框架进行了评估。采用参与者不重叠的划分方式，即 240 名训练、25 名验证和 48 名测试参与者，以评估对未见人群的泛化能力。在 VEET 上，模型达到 0.904 的 Top-1 准确率（95\% CI：[0.895, 0.913]）和 0.0033 的 Macro KL。消融实验表明，Top-1 的提升大部分与连续下一状态建模相关，而离散编码和先验对齐主要改善 Top-3 与分布对齐。这些结果确立了带有转移信息的世界模型监督对于主体泛化的行为预测是有用的，但并不意味其揭示了因果心理机制，也不意味其长时程状态动态是经过校准的。

title: HandWorldBench: A Unified Benchmark for Hand-Centric World Models
summary: Recent advances in world models are opening new possibilities for fine-grained embodied tasks, with hand-object interaction offering a particularly demanding setting. Modeling these interactions involves capturing how hand actions change objects and how the resulting states persist over time. Yet systematic evaluation tailored to these hand-centric capabilities remains underdeveloped. To address this gap, we introduce HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands along six dimensions: visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence. To construct the benchmark, we develop a data curation pipeline that extracts hand-object interaction clips and screens them for quality, yielding 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage. We then manually select 500 clips covering seven task families for evaluation. Benchmarking eleven models under a unified protocol reveals that stronger hand-pose control does not consistently translate into coherent object-state evolution and persistence or robust cross-embodiment performance, with several specialized hand-control models underperforming general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.

AI.title_zh: HandWorldBench：一个面向手部中心世界模型的统一基准
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型的最新进展为细粒度具身任务开辟了新的可能性，其中手-物体交互提供了一个尤为严苛的设定。对这类交互进行建模，涉及刻画手部动作如何改变物体以及由此产生的状态如何随时间保持。然而，针对这些以手部为中心的能力所量身定制的系统性评估仍不充分。为填补这一空白，我们提出 HandWorldBench，这是一个统一基准，沿六个维度系统评估面向人手、仿真灵巧手和真实灵巧手的以手部为中心的世界模型：视觉质量、手部保真度、外观一致性、指令遵循、物理一致性和时间连贯性。为构建该基准，我们开发了一套数据整理流程，提取手-物体交互片段并对其质量进行筛选，从超过 600 小时的视频素材中获得了 20,500 个高质量的第一人称视角片段。随后，我们人工选取了 500 个片段，覆盖七个任务族用于评估。在统一协议下对十一个模型进行基准测试表明，更强的手部姿态控制并不总是能转化为连贯的物体状态演化与保持，或稳健的跨具身性能；若干专门的手部控制模型在灵巧手任务上表现不及通用的文本/图像到视频生成器。

title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
summary: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

AI.title_zh: 超越外观：证据引导的程序化三维场景重建与智能体光照推理
AI.abstract_zh: 面向三维场景重建的图像到代码（image-to-code）方法会生成可执行代码，从而产生可编辑的数字内容并支持视觉仿真。然而，现有方法主要依赖外观相似性，这对区分几何、材质与光照方面的错误提供的指导有限。光通过其与几何和材质的相互作用塑造场景外观，影响着色、投射阴影与反射。因此，我们提出 LightHarness，一个基于 VLM（视觉语言模型）的智能体框架，将显式光照推理纳入迭代式场景重建。具体而言，我们利用互补的几何、本征（intrinsic）与光照线索来联合细化场景结构与外观，并提出光照推理记忆（Lighting Reasoning Memory）来维护光源假设，该记忆在整个迭代过程中支撑证据与修订历史。二者共同支持对部分可见与不可见光源的推理，并由证据引导的验证来指导后续修订。我们的框架通过对几何、材质与光照进行连贯推理来重建显式场景，无需额外训练或可微渲染。大量实验表明，在具有挑战性的阴影与复杂光照下，该方法具有更优的图像到代码重建精度，并进一步支持下游的场景编辑、物体插入与多样化重打光（relighting）。

title: TTL Approximations for a Family of CLOCK-Like Cache Replacement Policies
comment: Accepted and presented at IFIP Performance 2026. To appear in ACM SIGMETRICS Performance Evaluation Review
summary: While CLOCK-like cache replacement policies are highly appealing in practice due to their frugal memory usage and implementation simplicity, analytical models for their performance remain limited. The difficulty stems from the "eviction hand" itself. As it scans sequentially for an evictee, sparing objects with survival counters along the way, it inherently entangles the state of one cached object with the next. This strong coupling heavily obscures the system's steady state. To address this gap, we introduce a time-to-live (TTL) approximation for a family of eviction policies---which we term CLOCK($K$)---that decouples individual object dynamics using a globally fixed timer. In contrast to the intrinsic coupling induced by assuming a fixed cache capacity, such a TTL proxy yields a tractable matrix-analytic solution for the steady-state miss ratio functions across a broad and highly expressive class of phase-type renewal traffic. Among other benefits, this effectively reduces the analysis per-object to solving a linear system of order $O(Kd)$, where $d$ is the phase dimension. Moreover, our model for CLOCK($K$) recovers the canonical CLOCK when $K=1$ and FIFO when $K=0$, while empirically exhibiting Schur-concavity under the Independent Reference Model (IRM). Finally, we validate the model against a suite of trace-driven simulations.

AI.title_zh: 一类类CLOCK缓存替换策略的TTL近似
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管类 CLOCK 缓存替换策略因其节省内存占用和实现简单而在实践中极具吸引力，但针对其性能的分析模型仍然有限。困难源于"驱逐指针"（eviction hand）本身。当它顺序扫描以寻找被驱逐对象、并在扫描过程中放过带有存活计数器（survival counter）的对象时，它本质上将当前缓存对象的状态与下一个对象的状态纠缠在一起。这种强耦合极大地掩盖了系统的稳态。为弥补这一空白，我们为一类驱逐策略——我们称之为 CLOCK($K$)——引入了一种生存时间（time-to-live, TTL）近似，它利用全局固定计时器解耦单个对象的动态。与假设固定缓存容量所导致的内在耦合不同，这种 TTL 代理能够针对一大类具有高度表达力的相位型更新（phase-type renewal）流量，为稳态未命中率函数给出可处理的矩阵解析解。除其他优势外，这有效地将逐对象分析简化为求解一个阶数为 $O(Kd)$ 的线性系统，其中 $d$ 为相位维数。此外，我们的 CLOCK($K$) 模型在 $K=1$ 时还原为经典的 CLOCK，在 $K=0$ 时还原为 FIFO，同时在独立引用模型（Independent Reference Model, IRM）下经实验表现出 Schur 凹性。最后，我们通过一系列基于轨迹驱动的仿真对模型进行了验证。

title: Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies
summary: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.

AI.title_zh: 将每一代生成与独立同源样本（siblings）进行比较，为视频世界模型的后训练提供了针对结果频率的恰当目标
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型被用作模拟器，因此当第一帧留下若干种可能的物理结果时，重复生成应当使每种结果出现的频率与数据中该结果发生的频率一致。物理后训练将每一次生成与其历史所记录的唯一未来进行打分，这使单条视频更忠实，但期望得分对模型分布是线性的，并且总是生成最可能的结果即可使其最大化。所记录结果的对数似然由数据分布最大化，其梯度在衡量与记录的一致性时，按模型生成该生成结果的频率的倒数进行加权，而该频率可由同一历史下使用独立噪声的其他生成（即其同源样本，siblings）来估计。为了在有限组内使用该权重进行训练，我们提出 SibPO，即同源配对策略优化（Sibling-paired Policy Optimization）：同源样本为与记录的一致性估计一个截断的逆频率权重，第二项则减去同一权重乘以与同源样本的一致性，这使得在任意组大小下，期望目标都是关于结果单元（outcome cells）的严格恰当散度（strictly proper divergence）。在 PisaBench 上，在四个视频模型中的三个上，SibPO 相对于其奖励族之外的最强方法，将到模拟着陆时间的 KS 距离降低了 9.1–10.2%，且未使单条视频性能下降；同时将所估计的机器人策略成功率误差降低了 13%。

title: Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
summary: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset carried from the previous denoising step. On four text-to-video and image-to-video models from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, PQRS is the fastest of all the sparse attention methods we evaluate and the closest to the dense output, reaching $28.9$ dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V and $35.4$ dB on HunyuanVideo at $1.66$--$2.10\times$ end-to-end speedup.

AI.title_zh: 每个查询自行路由：以逐查询路由稀疏注意力加速视频扩散 Transformer
AI.abstract_zh: 长 token 序列上的自注意力主导了视频扩散 Transformer 的推理开销。基于聚类的稀疏注意力对查询和键同时进行聚类，并让同一簇内的所有查询共享同一种键簇选择。我们表明这种共享限制了精度：在键簇和密度固定的情况下，随着查询簇被细化，注意力变得更准确，并且在每个查询各自进行选择时最为准确，而这根本不需要查询聚类。因此我们提出逐查询路由稀疏注意力（Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention，PQRS），这是一种无需训练的方法，它只对键进行聚类，让每个查询选择自己的键簇，并用未选中键簇的质心对其进行补偿。逐查询的选择使得没有任何查询分块拥有共享的键列表，因此 PQRS 转而对键簇进行遍历而非遍历查询，将具有相同选择的查询分桶为稠密任务，并在从上一去噪步骤携带而来的固定 softmax 偏移下，一次性合并它们的部分结果。在来自 Wan 和 HunyuanVideo 系列的四个文本到视频与图像到视频模型上，PQRS 是我们评估的所有稀疏注意力方法中最快的，并且最接近稠密输出，在 Wan2.1-T2V 上达到 $28.9$ dB PSNR，在 HunyuanVideo 上达到 $35.4$ dB，端到端加速为 $1.66$--$2.10\times$。

title: When to Refine: Selective Search for Frozen Visual World Models
summary: Planning with a visual world model requires deciding both which actions to execute and how long to search for them. We introduce Selective CEM Refinement (SCR), a learned rule for deciding whether to continue cross-entropy method (CEM) search with a frozen LeWorldModel. After five it- erations, the gate measures how far the mean first action chunk has moved, how much the mean terminal cost of elite plans has fallen, and how widely their first chunks vary. It returns the current plan for execution or continues the same search for ten more iterations. The gate requires no addi- tional world-model rollout. On 16 PushT scenes evaluated with two planning seeds, SCR succeeded in 25 of 32 trials, compared with 28 of 32 for fixed 15-iteration search (Fixed-15). All 25 SCR suc- cesses occurred in trials that Fixed-15 also solved, yield- ing 89.29% paired success retention. Across complete episodes, including replanning, SCR evaluated 23.81% fewer candidate plans and reduced mean controller time per eight-environment batch by 17.22%. Its observed suc- cess rate was 5.36 percentage points above an analytic mix- ture of the two fixed-depth controllers at the same expected candidate workload, although the difference changed sign across planning seeds. Compared with gating only at the initial solve under the same random-draw padding proto- col, gating again at replanning produced nine additional early exits. This reduced total candidate evaluations by 15.79%, while successes fell from 27 to 25.

AI.title_zh: 何时进行精细化：面向冻结视觉世界模型的选择性搜索
AI.abstract_zh: 使用视觉世界模型进行规划需要同时决定执行哪些动作以及为这些动作搜索多长时间。我们引入选择性CEM精细化（Selective CEM Refinement, SCR），这是一种学习得到的规则，用于决定是否在冻结的LeWorldModel上继续交叉熵方法（cross-entropy method, CEM）搜索。在五次迭代之后，该门控机制衡量平均首个动作块移动了多远、精英计划的平均终端代价下降了多少，以及它们首个动作块的差异有多大。它要么返回当前计划用于执行，要么继续同一搜索再进行十次迭代。该门控不需要额外的世界模型推演（rollout）。在采用两个规划种子的16个PushT场景上，SCR在32次试验中的25次中取得成功，而固定15次迭代搜索（Fixed-15）为32次中的28次。SCR的全部25次成功都发生在Fixed-15也成功求解的试验中，配对成功保留率为89.29%。在整个完整回合（包括重新规划）中，SCR评估的候选计划减少了23.81%，并将每个八环境批次的平均控制器时间减少了17.22%。其观测到的成功率比在相同预期候选工作负载下两种固定深度控制器的解析混合高出5.36个百分点，尽管该差异在不同规划种子之间改变了符号。与在相同随机抽取填充协议下仅在初始求解时进行门控相比，在重新规划时再次进行门控多产生了九次提前退出。这使总候选评估次数减少了15.79%，同时成功次数从27次降至25次。

title: ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model
summary: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.

AI.title_zh: ShoWorld：形状保真的多假设占据世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 占据世界模型由于运动不确定性和形状畸变而难以预测运动物体。单一轨迹可能将多个合理的未来平均为一条不合理的路径，而重复的体素化即使在运动正确的情况下也可能侵蚀或膨胀物体形状。我们提出 ShoWorld，通过分离的运动与形状表示来应对这些挑战。运动预测器以场景布局、邻近智能体和未来自车轨迹为条件预测概率性轨迹。每个假设被渲染为占据表示，并根据其概率进行融合，以保留多种替代未来。形状组件从局部几何中预测带有占据概率和偏移量的亚体素点。这些点随物体刚性移动，而体素占据状态遵循至少有一个被占据点落入其中的概率。这种表示减少了运动过程中的形状畸变。ShoWorld 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上取得了最先进的结果。在给定真实占据和自车轨迹的情况下，其整体 mIoU 和 IoU 分别提升了 6.56 和 9.16 个点，在动态类别上分别提升了 6.06 和 5.53 个点。

title: Probing Physics in Motion Diffusion Models Against Their Own Estimate
summary: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. The estimate also flags floating samples without training, but aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute. In a video model, plausibility that linear probes miss in Wan 2.1's clean latent becomes readable after one fixed nonlinearity.

AI.title_zh: 探测运动扩散模型中相对于其自身估计的物理信息
