AI.abstract_zh: 全面的音视频感知需要语义推理与空间推理。现有的空间模型因数据稀缺而泛化能力较差，而仅关注语义的模型则无法完整捕捉空间特征。我们提出一个模型，能够在语义任务和空间任务上对双耳音频与视觉进行联合推理，并具有更好的泛化能力。为克服真实世界数据的不足，我们开发了一套自动流程：在视频中定位声源、估计其相对三维轨迹，并渲染双耳音频。随后我们利用该流程对 VGGSound 进行空间化处理，从而能够在更大得多的规模上进行训练。我们展示了在空间推理任务上性能与泛化能力的提升，同时在与仅关注语义的模型相比时，在语义任务上仍保持竞争力。

title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

AI.title_zh: ResWAM：学习变化之物，而非不变之物，用于世界-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（world-action models, WAMs）通过未来预测来增强视觉-语言-动作策略（VLAs），使策略能够预判其动作将如何影响物理世界。现有 WAM 对完整的未来观测进行监督。然而，观测在一个动作块（action chunk）内通常变化很小，因此未来损失主要由复制静态背景内容所主导，而非学习与任务相关的机器人及物体运动，从而限制了策略学习。此外，现有 WAM 依赖大型视频生成模型或独立的世界模型，带来沉重的训练与推理计算开销，阻碍了闭环部署。为提升策略性能，我们提出视觉残差学习（visual residual learning），仅在冻结的 DINOv3 空间中监督从当前帧到未来帧的特征变化。与完整的未来特征相比，该残差学习目标产生更高的特征秩，对场景变化具有更丰富、更多样的表示，并在空间上集中于机械臂与被操作物体而非背景。为进一步提升计算效率，我们提出 ResWAM，一个总参数量为 2.3B 的残差世界-动作模型，其中包含一个轻量级 0.5B 双分支 DiT，通过条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）联合训练动作分支与残差分支。在未进行机器人预训练（即在基准演示之外的外部机器人动作轨迹上进行预训练）的情况下，ResWAM 在 LIBERO-Plus（81.1%）、RoboTwin 2.0（93.8%）和 RoboDojo（9.40% 成功率，13.41 分数）上取得最高的平均成功率，且训练算力（2.7-4.0 TFLOPs）与推理算力（1.0-1.4 TFLOPs）最低，并在真实机器人 Open、Put 和 Stack 任务上以 92.7 ms 的延迟取得领先（平均 80.0%，相比 $π_{0.5}$ 提升 +10.0%）。

title: Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning
comment: 28 pages, 13 figures. Under review at L4DC 2027
summary: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/scwm.

AI.title_zh: 面向安全离线规划的学习世界模型中的逐次凸化
AI.abstract_zh: 从离线数据学习得到的世界模型使智能体无需进一步与环境交互即可进行规划，但与之配合使用的基于采样的规划器仅通过评分或拒绝采样得到的动作序列来处理安全约束。我们转而将学习世界模型潜空间中的安全规划表述为一个逐次凸规划（SCP）问题，其中学习的离散时间控制障碍函数被作为约束施加于规划时域的每一步。SCP 要求动力学具有平滑性，因此我们使用平滑的 MaxMin 激活函数和谱归一化层构建网络，并以 Lipschitz 界和平滑宽度为度量界定了由此产生的线性化误差。由于 SCP 是一种局部方法，我们从采样得到的计划出发对其进行初始化。在两个使用离线数据的 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上，在我们的主要比较中，该规划器在相同实际耗时下，其违反约束次数少于分别采样 128 倍的 MPPI 和 CEM，尽管差异并不显著；并且在更长时域上获得更高的回报，且比不使用采样起点的 SCP 安全得多。SCP 在具有 Lipschitz 界的模型上收敛得更频繁。与采样方法不同，它还在每一步报告其计划是否为模型中规划问题的一个可行的一阶最优 KKT 点，或者报告在附近未找到可行计划。我们的实现已公开于 https://github.com/youngers2006/scwm。

title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.

AI.title_zh: 为开放词汇查询准备更轻量、更快速的方案：一种面向高斯泼溅的查询级三维分割器
AI.abstract_zh: 开放词汇三维理解旨在定位并分割预定义类别之外的任意物体。然而，现有基于高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）的方法往往依赖昂贵的预处理和漫长的训练，限制了其在需要快速、轻量解决方案时的适用性。我们提出一种轻量、无需训练的框架，用于在高斯泼溅上进行查询驱动的三维实例分割。我们不采用传统的掩码级 CLIP 嵌入，而是使用稠密的像素级 CLIP 特征，以保留细粒度的语义信息，并在不依赖预定义实例候选的情况下实现灵活的文本驱动定位。给定一个文本查询，我们在精心选定的枢轴视图中识别出高质量的目标区域，并使用视频分割器将其跨视图传播，从而对目标实例提供一致且全面的覆盖。随后，我们通过一种新颖的可见性投票策略将所得的二维轨迹片段提升到三维高斯，生成具有清晰物体边界的高精度三维分割掩码。大量实验表明，本方法在 LERF-OVS、ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上取得了最先进的性能，在 3D-OVS 上取得了有竞争力的结果，并且相较现有开放词汇三维分割方法实现了显著加速。这些结果凸显了我们的框架在无需逐场景训练的情况下实现高效开放词汇三维理解的有效性。

title: XLSAR-Bench: Towards Extremely Large SAR Imagery Understanding of MLLMs
summary: The rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has highlighted the need for comprehensive benchmarks to assess their capabilities and limitations in remote sensing (RS). However, evaluating MLLMs in large-size synthetic aperture radar (SAR) scenarios remains challenging, as understanding complete scenes requires both global semantic interpretation and fine-grained target perception. Existing SAR benchmarks predominantly rely on small image patches, limiting their ability to assess these capabilities jointly. To address these limitations, we present XLSAR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the perception and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs in large-scene SAR imagery. XLSAR-Bench comprises 405 images with an average size of 7153$\times$7153 pixels, ten tasks spanning visual question answering, visual grounding, and detailed image captioning, with all evaluation samples meticulously annotated manually, assisted by a semi-automatic captioner. Experimental results from general-purpose and domain-specific MLLMs reveal persistent challenges in understanding large SAR scenes and accurately perceiving small targets. We have open-sourced XLSAR-Bench to support further research in developing more powerful MLLMs for complete large SAR scenes.

AI.title_zh: XLSAR-Bench：迈向多模态大语言模型对超大尺寸SAR影像的理解
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展，凸显了构建全面基准以评估其在遥感（RS）领域能力与局限性的需求。然而，在大尺寸合成孔径雷达（SAR）场景中评估MLLMs仍具挑战性，因为理解完整场景既需要全局语义解读，也需要细粒度目标感知。现有SAR基准主要依赖小图像块，限制了其联合评估上述能力的能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出XLSAR-Bench，这是一个用于评估MLLMs在大场景SAR影像中感知与推理能力的综合基准。XLSAR-Bench包含405幅图像，平均尺寸为7153$\times$7153像素，涵盖视觉问答、视觉定位和详细图像描述共十项任务，所有评估样本均经人工精心标注，并由一个半自动描述生成器辅助完成。来自通用型和领域专用MLLMs的实验结果揭示了在理解大SAR场景和准确感知小目标方面持续存在的挑战。我们已将XLSAR-Bench开源，以支持进一步研究，开发面向完整大SAR场景的更强大MLLMs。

title: Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

AI.title_zh: 黑盒世界模型的宏观控制与能力评估：面向LLM智能体市场的双机制框架
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以被组织成多智能体市场，这些市场充当世界模型，将宏观信息映射为涌现的宏观动态，而评估者只观察到宏观输入与宏观输出。本文将模型的能力拆分为单一聚合分数无法区分的两个阶段：从宏观信息到微观行为的信息模拟，以及从微观行为到宏观结果的宏观涌现。我们引入一种软宏观控制方法，逐日公布一条公共参考路径，而不触及个体决策、订单或撮合；并提出一个双机制评估框架，仅凭宏观观测即可度量上述两个阶段。在仅参考机制中，对称的真实参考与翻转参考共享一个共同的水平R，它度量在公布参考下的实现程度，而二者之间的配对差距B度量结构性偏差；在信息注入机制中，外部信息会稀释参考，因此只有真实—翻转差距Delta仍可解释。在五个单指数LLM智能体市场上，公布目标路径会使实际实现路径在两种信息条件下、对两条公布参考均向公布目标偏移。相对于无参考路径，无新闻时的跟踪分数分别高出0.306和0.415，有新闻时分别高出0.183和0.329；在股票/现金扫描中，结构性偏差在70/30处最低（B=0.042）；实现程度在技术占比3:7时达到峰值（R=0.894，而仅技术时为0.358）；Delta在含基本面数据时为0.0341，含新闻时为0.0487。两个阶段使用相同的两个可观测分数，每个分数均在其可解释的机制下读取。

title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
summary: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

AI.title_zh: GameWM：迈向以交互为中心的下一代世界模型视频游戏
AI.abstract_zh: 半个多世纪以来，电子游戏一直在追求更好的画面、更自然的交互和更吸引人的玩法。生成式视频模型（VMs）如今对这三点都有影响。神经网络已经绘制了已发行游戏中大部分像素，而近期的世界模型使轻量级游戏引擎能够保留世界状态，同时由视频模型把引擎输出的粗糙代理视频转换为最终帧。然而，这些系统将视频模型视为一个渲染器，只对引擎已经编排好的运动进行风格化重绘，这使其大部分生成能力未被利用，也限制了游戏所能提供的多样性。我们提出 GameWM，一种基于明确分工构建下一代游戏的设计。GameWM-engine 保留必须精确的内容：规则、状态、相机以及世界的布局，这也使视频模型无需记忆这些内容。GameWM-VM 生成手工制作代价高昂的内容：世界的外观以及玩家交互的细节。于是，一项游戏机制可以以多种在视觉和物理上各不相同的实现方式呈现，而其结果仍严格保持为引擎所计算的结果。为实现这种分工，我们将 GameWM 构建为一个完整系统：一个以交互而非探索为中心的数据引擎；一个接口，通过它让已创作的角色设定表、场景美术和技能描述进入模型；以及一个从 5B 到 33B 参数、并带有用于游玩的实时因果变体的模型家族。它们共同为每位玩家提供同一款游戏的全新版本：每位玩家自己的角色、世界和技能将相同的引擎机制转化为新的体验，同时每个事件都保持 GameWM-engine 所计算的时间安排与结果。

title: Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World
summary: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. In two exposure-matched history conditions, increasing the budget from eight to 32 updates raises joint success from 6.25% to 94.79% and 91.15%, respectively, while exact obsolete-value outputs fall from 174/192 and 166/192 to zero. Constant32, which matches preparation steps but repeatedly trains on unchanged content during the first 32 events, achieves higher early joint success at eight steps (53.65%); at 32 steps, it reaches 85.42%, below both changing-history conditions. These results distinguish rapid correction under a small budget from simultaneous correctness of the new fact and the other three facts after further training. For both changing histories, most cases remain jointly correct at all subsequent measured points from step 16 onward. Output analysis shows that short-budget failures primarily retain the old value; repeated training on the new fact together with the other current facts progressively replaces these obsolete answers.

AI.title_zh: 智能体能否重新审视其所知？变化世界中的选择性场景记忆更新
AI.abstract_zh: 工厂、仓库和日常物理环境中的任务配置会随时间变化。因此，物理AI系统需要将新事实纳入场景记忆，同时保留关于设备、物体和运行约束的有效信息。我们研究这一参数化语义记忆层的更新，并在有限更新预算下对纠正与保持进行联合评估。在固定当前事实数量和记忆参数数量的条件下，该协议结合了独立的单事实更新、预算轨迹、从旧答案到新答案的诊断以及首次稳定成功。使用带有后层LoRA的冻结4B语言模型，我们在四字段合成语义配置上评估了七种准备条件和六种更新预算。在两个曝光匹配的历史条件下，将预算从八次更新增加到32次更新，联合成功率分别从6.25%提升到94.79%和91.15%，而精确输出过时值的次数从174/192和166/192降至零。Constant32匹配准备步数，但在前32个事件中反复训练于未变化的内容，其在八步时取得了更高的早期联合成功率（53.65%）；在32步时达到85.42%，低于两个变化历史条件。这些结果区分了小预算下的快速纠正与进一步训练后新事实和其他三个事实同时正确这两种情形。对于两个变化历史，从第16步开始，大多数案例在所有后续测量点上都保持联合正确。输出分析表明，短预算下的失败主要保留了旧值；在新事实与其他当前事实上一起重复训练，会逐步取代这些过时答案。

title: Mem2Fair: Online Fairness Control for Text-to-Video Generation via Fair Memory
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce systematically unfair demographic outcomes when prompts leave protected attributes unspecified. For example, prompts describing nurses without specifying gender may disproportionately generate videos depicting female nurses. Mitigating unfairness in T2V generation is particularly challenging: training-based methods that modify model internals require architecture-specific access and risk disrupting temporal consistency, while sampling-based methods often incur costly pre-deployment video generation. We present the first conditional online approachability formulation of attribute-level fairness for T2V generation. Building on this formulation, we introduce Mem2Fair, a plug-and-play framework that maintains concept-conditioned Fair Memory. Using generated videos at inference time as feedback, Mem2Fair selects prompt-level attribute interventions based on the deviation from each concept's prescribed fairness target, without training or separate pre-deployment sampling. Experiments demonstrate that Mem2Fair consistently improves fairness over the unmodified generator and existing baselines across multiple demographic attributes, prompt settings, and target distributions, while maintaining comparable prompt-video alignment and video quality. We further demonstrate its effectiveness on commercial black-box T2V models.

AI.title_zh: Mem2Fair：基于公平记忆的文本到视频生成在线公平性控制
AI.abstract_zh: 当提示词未指定受保护属性时，文本到视频（T2V）生成模型可能产生系统性的不公平人口学结果。例如，描述护士但未指定性别的提示词可能会不成比例地生成描绘女性护士的视频。缓解 T2V 生成中的不公平性尤其具有挑战性：基于训练的方法通过修改模型内部结构来实现，需要针对特定架构的访问权限，并有破坏时间一致性的风险；而基于采样的方法往往需要在部署前进行成本高昂的视频生成。我们提出了首个针对 T2V 生成的属性层面公平性的条件在线可达性（conditional online approachability）形式化表述。在此表述的基础上，我们提出了 Mem2Fair，一个即插即用（plug-and-play）框架，用于维护以概念为条件的公平记忆（Fair Memory）。Mem2Fair 以推理时生成的视频作为反馈，根据每个概念与其规定公平性目标之间的偏差来选择提示词层面的属性干预，无需训练，也无需单独的部署前采样。实验表明，在多种人口学属性、提示词设置和目标分布下，Mem2Fair 相对于未修改的生成器和现有基线均能持续提升公平性，同时保持相当的提示词—视频对齐度和视频质量。我们进一步证明了其在商业黑盒 T2V 模型上的有效性。

title: Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \& Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.

AI.title_zh: 视觉语言模型真的在看路吗？面向自动驾驶的诊断性评估
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地通过问答基准被评估用于自动驾驶，然而较高的基准准确率并不一定反映具有视觉基础的推理。我们提出了一个诊断性评估框架，系统地探查 VLM 是否将安全关键的驾驶决策建立在视觉证据之上，还是转而依赖语言先验、答案偏置和数据集规律。我们的基准包含两个任务类别——恶劣天气（Adverse Weather）与路口和交叉口（Junctions & Intersections），并带有 nuScenes 空间推理扩展，沿着四种诊断协议评估开源（通用、驾驶和空间推理）VLM：有图像与无图像评估、反事实天气敏感性、释义与否定条件下的语言鲁棒性，以及空间推理。所有真实标签均由 BDD100K 和 DriveLM 标注以程序化方式导出，从而实现无需人工标注的可复现评估。在所有模型中，我们发现具有竞争力的总体准确率掩盖了系统性的失效模式，包括强烈的肯定性偏置、对反事实场景变化的敏感性有限、在否定问题上表现接近随机水平（尽管释义一致性很高），以及即使没有视觉输入也能给出自信的驾驶决策。这些结果表明，当前的开源 VLM 对于安全关键的自动驾驶而言仍缺乏足够的视觉基础，并凸显了超越总体准确率的诊断性评估的必要性。

title: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA
summary: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA.

AI.title_zh: WA-JEPA：面向世界-动作模型的目标感知预测反馈动作细化
AI.abstract_zh: 基于JEPA的世界模型在隐空间中预测动作的后果，但具有代表性的规划方法依赖候选动作搜索，需要对动作序列进行重复评估，并带来可观的在线计算开销。直接动作生成避免了这种搜索，然而，如何在给定任务目标的情况下利用隐空间预测来引导动作生成，仍是将所学到的物理动力学转化为有效决策的一个关键挑战。我们提出WA-JEPA，一种世界-动作模型（world-action model），它将动作生成、动作条件隐空间预测与目标感知反馈相耦合。该模型首先生成一个动作提议，并预测由此产生的未来场景与本体感受状态，随后以任务目标为参照，通过两条互补的反馈路径对该提议进行细化。目标差异残差反馈（goal-discrepancy residual feedback, GDRF）利用预测场景的隐表示与任务目标之间的差异来引导分块（chunk-wise）动作细化。未来场景上下文反馈（future-scene context feedback, FSCF）保留细粒度的预测场景表示，以引导后续的动作细化。该过程从离线示教数据中联合学习，并在执行前对同一计划进行迭代更新，使未来预测直接参与动作生成而无需候选动作搜索。我们评估了短时域目标到达、长时域任务以及完整任务执行。结果表明，目标感知的预测反馈在保持模型紧凑和低在线计算开销的同时，支持具有竞争力的任务性能。代码见 https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA。

title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ICC
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.

AI.title_zh: 面向物理AI中视觉-语言-动作模型的无线边缘辅助自适应潜在推理
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将视觉观测和语言指令转化为机器人动作，使具身人工智能（AI）成为可能。物理AI中新兴的应用场景预计将推动对高效推理与通信的需求，因为VLA模型的计算需求给机载资源受限条件下的实时控制带来了挑战。通过潜在推理实现的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）使这些模型能够在不生成显式思维链（CoT）token的情况下精化隐藏表示，但这会在任务成功率、推理时延和能耗之间引入权衡。本文研究真实通信场景下的高效协同推理。我们提出了一种无线边缘辅助的自适应潜在推理框架（WEALR），利用边缘计算增强机载计算。一个决策智能体联合选择执行位置和潜在推理收敛阈值。我们将这一联合自适应问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。一种拉格朗日约束深度强化学习（CDRL）方法，即信赖域策略优化拉格朗日方法（TRPO-Lag），学习在不断变化的无线条件和任务需求下平衡任务性能与资源消耗。我们使用LIBERO操作任务、经性能分析的VLA推理开销以及射线追踪无线信道对该框架进行了评估。实验结果表明，与基准CDRL方法相比，TRPO-Lag的可行性加权任务成功率最高可提升23%。

title: Large language models as oncology world models
comment: 63 pages (main text 35, Supplementary Information 28), 6 figures, 9 Extended Data figures. Code: https://github.com/julienvibert/llm-oncology-world-models. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24137512
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

AI.title_zh: 大语言模型作为肿瘤学世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能够合成癌症患者病例，但其对肿瘤学的内部表征，即世界模型（world model），尚未得到系统性探索。仅指定肿瘤类型时，我们发现大语言模型倾向于为每种癌症生成相似的患者：平均而言，某一种癌症的患者中有81.0%至93.2%在每个基线特征上共享最常见取值。通过在12个临床场景中系统性地改变患者特征，我们发现，在36项模型-场景评估中有29项遵循生物标志物与治疗逻辑，而当既往治疗或衰弱状况（frailty）起重要作用时，12项中仅有1项遵循。在延续真实患者轨迹时，一个大语言模型预测的12个月生存率为89.9%，在提供相似患者作为示例时为79.2%，而观察值为72.2%。为表征这些轨迹，我们开发了临床状态空间（Clinical State Space），这是一个动态表征框架，我们也将其应用于真实患者。尽管我们展示了上述局限，改进后的世界模型仍可能支持数字孪生（digital twins），而我们的框架可对此进行评估。

title: Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models
summary: Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. Our results reveal that global and localized judgments can diverge in both directions: global aggregation can either obscure correct localized discrimination or produce apparent discrimination without corresponding localized evidence. During continued pretraining on developmental egocentric videos, agreement between global and localized judgments changes non-monotonically, while confidence in localized judgments increases despite modest improvements in accuracy. Together, these findings establish localized VOE evaluation as a complementary diagnostic for assessing intuitive physics in video world models and demonstrate that global prediction errors do not necessarily reflect the spatiotemporal evidence of physical violations.

AI.title_zh: 探究惊讶发生之处：视频世界模型的局部化期望违背评估
AI.abstract_zh: 期望违背（violation-of-expectation, VOE）基准通过检验物理上不可能的事件是否比匹配的可能事件产生更大的预测误差，来评估视频世界模型中的直觉物理。然而，传统的 VOE 评估在空间和时间上对预测误差进行聚合，使得我们难以判断成功的判别究竟是否反映了模型对物理违背在其发生的位置和时间上的理解。为解决这一局限，我们引入局部化 VOE 评估，这是一个在与物理违背相关的空间区域和时间区间内测量可能事件与不可能事件之间预测误差差异的框架。我们比较了对在发展性自我中心视频或大规模自然视频数据集上预训练的 V-JEPA 模型所进行的全局、时间局部化以及时空局部化评估。我们的结果揭示，全局判断与局部判断可能在两个方向上出现分歧：全局聚合既可能掩盖正确的局部判别，也可能在缺乏相应局部证据的情况下产生表面上的判别。在发展性自我中心视频上继续预训练期间，全局判断与局部判断之间的一致性呈非单调变化，而对局部判断的置信度上升，尽管准确率的提升有限。综合而言，这些发现确立了局部化 VOE 评估作为评估视频世界模型中直觉物理的一种补充性诊断手段，并表明全局预测误差不一定反映物理违背的时空证据。

title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

AI.title_zh: 让语言回归动作：通过参数合并恢复 VLA 模型中的 VLM 能力
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-Language-Action models, VLAs）是通过在机器人演示数据上微调预训练的视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）而得到的，从而能够根据视觉观察和语言指令进行动作预测。然而，这种微调会引发灾难性遗忘，显著削弱原始 VLM 的语义与视觉基础（grounding）能力。我们通过合并 VLM 及其 VLA 衍生模型的参数来解决这一问题，且无需对任一模型进行重新训练。具体而言，我们提取任务向量（即 VLA 与 VLM 权重之差），并通过奇异值分解（Singular Value Decomposition）对其进行分解。对于每个分量，我们学习一个标量混合系数，用以控制保留多少 VLA 适配，并对其加以优化，以同时保持动作预测和视觉-语言能力。实验表明，我们的合并模型在两个方面同时表现良好，始终优于已有的合并基线方法。

title: Découpage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. To enable fine-grained cinematic control, we present DECOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework for long-form, multi-shot, and multi-character joint audio-video generation. Rather than coupling modality boundaries by default, DECOUPAGE uncouples generation into independently bounded visual and acoustic tracks governed by persistent character identities. DECOUPAGE builds on a joint audio-video diffusion model with dual-schedule temporal cross-attention, incorporating a directorial Lip-sync mechanism that selectively decouples speech conditioning from visual facial dynamics during off-screen dialogue. On multi-shot conversational benchmarks, DECOUPAGE achieves precise control over shot transitions, audio timing, and visibility-aware lip synchronization, directing 15- to 60-second screenplay-driven audio-video generation with multimodal coherence.

AI.title_zh: Découpage：面向长时多镜头视频生成的导演式视听控制
AI.abstract_zh: 在电影化叙事中，声音与画面的转场并不总是同步一致：对白常常跨越剪辑点以揭示反应，或通过J-cut和L-cut引入新场景，而刻意的静默则用于控制场景节奏。然而，现有的视听生成框架缺乏在长时程上协调彼此独立的视觉与声音时序的显式机制。随着叙事时长与镜头复杂度的增加，这些系统难以维持长程的对白节奏，往往在原本意图静默的段落中虚构出语音，或错误地驱动静默听者的嘴部运动。为实现细粒度的电影化控制，我们提出DECOUPAGE，一个由剧本驱动的框架，用于长时程、多镜头、多角色的联合音视频生成。DECOUPAGE并非默认将各模态边界耦合在一起，而是将生成解耦为受持久角色身份约束的、边界相互独立的视觉轨与声音轨。DECOUPAGE构建于具有双调度时序交叉注意力的联合音视频扩散模型之上，并引入一种导演式唇形同步（Lip-sync）机制，在画外对白期间选择性地将语音条件与视觉面部动态解耦。在多镜头对话基准上，DECOUPAGE实现了对镜头转场、音频时序以及可见性感知唇形同步的精确控制，能够导演生成15至60秒、由剧本驱动的音视频内容，并保持多模态一致性。

title: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
summary: Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. We systematically examine video patch embeddings, register tokens, and adaptive layer normalization to identify design choices that balance generation quality and computational efficiency. The resulting JVT design achieves generation quality competitive with latent diffusion baselines in both class-conditioned and unconditional settings. The pixel-space formulation of JVT also naturally supports joint generation of pixel-aligned modalities. We demonstrate this capability through camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation, which improves camera following relative to RGB-only baselines and yields explicit scene geometry without an additional reconstruction model at inference. These results highlight the potential of simple DiT-style Transformers for pixel-space video diffusion, and we hope our findings offer useful insights and practical guidance for future research.

AI.title_zh: JVT：仅仅一个视频 Transformer 就能让像素空间视频扩散变得简单
AI.abstract_zh: 对高维原始视频数据进行直接的扩散建模具有挑战性，而现有的像素空间方法往往依赖专门的架构。我们提出 JVT（Just Video Transformer），一个用于像素空间视频扩散的、简单的大 patch DiT 风格 Transformer，不使用预训练自编码器、辅助细节增强模块（detailers）、级联阶段或 U-Net 风格跳跃连接。我们系统地考察了视频 patch 嵌入、register token 以及自适应层归一化，以确定在生成质量与计算效率之间取得平衡的设计选择。由此得到的 JVT 设计在类别条件与无条件两种设定下的生成质量均可与潜空间扩散（latent diffusion）基线相竞争。JVT 的像素空间形式还天然支持像素对齐模态的联合生成。我们通过相机条件 RGB-视差（RGB-disparity）生成展示了这一能力，相对于仅 RGB 的基线，它改善了相机跟随效果，并在推理时无需额外重建模型即可给出显式的场景几何。这些结果凸显了简单 DiT 风格 Transformer 在像素空间视频扩散中的潜力，我们希望我们的发现能为未来研究提供有益的见解与实践指导。

title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 Technical Report
summary: Recent advances in audio-driven avatar video generation have enabled increasingly realistic synthesis, yet achieving precise lip-audio synchronization, natural, human-like motion, and visual consistency over long sequences remains challenging. We present LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, which builds on LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 to improve expressive naturalness and reduce error accumulation during extended generation, e.g., exaggerated lip movements and overly red, temporally unstable lip coloration, enhance the naturalness of facial expressions and coordinated head and body movements. These improvements are driven by a refined post-training pipeline that integrates reinforcement learning, improved classifier-free guidance strategies for DMD-based few-step distillation, long-video rollouts, and on-policy distillation. Together, these refinements improve expressive realism and enable the generation of videos exceeding 10 minutes while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Arena evaluations show that LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 outperforms its predecessor and competing commercial audio-driven avatar models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the improved post-training pipeline.

AI.title_zh: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 技术报告
AI.abstract_zh: 近年来，音频驱动数字人视频生成领域的进展使合成效果日益逼真，然而在长序列生成中实现精确的唇音同步、自然且类人的动作以及视觉一致性仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6，它基于 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5，提升了表现的自然度并减少了长时生成过程中的误差累积，例如夸张的唇部动作以及过度发红、时间上不稳定的唇部着色，增强了面部表情与协调的头身运动的自然性。这些改进由一套精细化的后训练流程驱动，该流程整合了强化学习、针对基于 DMD 的少步蒸馏所改进的无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）策略、长视频 rollout 以及 on-policy 蒸馏。这些改进共同提升了表现的真实感，并使得生成时长超过 10 分钟的视频成为可能，同时保持视觉质量与时间一致性。Arena 评测表明，LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 优于其前代版本以及竞争性的商业音频驱动数字人模型，证明了改进后的后训练流程的有效性。

title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
summary: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with recorded actions at 81.0% decision coverage, compared with 55.0% agreement and 99.5% coverage for an ungated ensemble agent. Component ablations show lower factual risk with joint gating than with either gate alone.These results characterize a reliability--coverage trade-off in selective clinical simulation; they do not identify individualized treatment effects or establish improved patient outcomes.

AI.title_zh: 何时信任模拟的患者反应：用于血管加压药决策支持的支持度门控世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 临床世界模型让语言模型智能体接触到预测的患者反应，但对于支持不足的治疗或陌生的医院，模拟可能不可靠。我们提出支持度门控世界模型（Support-Gated World-Model）决策支持，这是对"提议—模拟—精炼"（propose--simulate--refine）智能体的一种轻量级扩展。一个循环动力学集成模型预测对已记录的去甲肾上腺素剂量类别的短时程生理反应，同时一个行为模型估计观察性动作支持度。该接口会扣留支持度不足或集成模型分歧过大的预测，并在没有候选者符合条件时弃权。在 eICU-CRD 上的评估涵盖 70 家医院和 30,700 个决策转移，其中 14 家医院被留出用于测试。在 62.0% 的事实转移覆盖率下，联合门控得到的 MAP 平均绝对误差为 7.3 mmHg，而相同覆盖率下随机选择为 9.2 mmHg。门控智能体在 81.0% 的决策覆盖率下与记录动作达到 60.0% 的一致率，而无门控集成智能体的一致率为 55.0%、覆盖率为 99.5%。组件消融显示，联合门控比单独使用任一门控具有更低的事实风险。这些结果刻画了选择性临床模拟中的可靠性—覆盖率权衡；它们并未识别个体化治疗效果，也未确立患者结局的改善。

title: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
summary: Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the ECMWF ensemble. Precipitation, cloud-top height and solar irradiance, never inputs at inference, are inferred with skill matching or exceeding operational products at short leads. Against the first guess of NOAA's Gridpoint Statistical Interpolation (GSI) DA system, WeatherDreamer's short-range departures are within 10% of GSI's at surface stations and within 25% for moisture-sensitive microwave channels, but up to five times larger for temperature-sounding channels. Never given observation errors, its learned update assumes errors close to known instrument and retrieval errors of microwave sounders and scatterometer winds. WeatherDreamer also separates viewing geometry from atmospheric state, recovering 83-96% of observed limb darkening and producing seamless nadir-view imagery. Producing an hourly global analysis in about 1.5 minutes on one GPU, WeatherDreamer shows that assimilation and forecasting can be learned together directly from observations.

AI.title_zh: WeatherDreamer：从多模态地球观测中学习世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 机器学习天气模型如今已可与业务运行的全球预报相媲美，但它们仍然从由独立的、昂贵的数据同化（DA）系统生成的分析场出发，而这些全球模型的分析场通常每六小时更新一次。观测到观测（observation-to-observation）模型避免了这一依赖，但其中大多数省略了递归滤波循环——正是这一循环使 DA 系统能够在稀疏、不规则的观测中携带背景状态。我们提出 WeatherDreamer，一个从 18 个全球观测系统中端到端学习该循环的世界模型，且不使用再分析数据。它从观测中推断潜在状态，以学习到的动力学逐小时向前携带该状态，每小时用新观测对其进行校正，并且能够预测其任一观测系统在任意位置将会测量到什么。在留出站点上，其集合预报在温度、露点和风方面至 12 小时优于 NOAA 的全球集合预报系统（GEFS），并且校准优于 GEFS 和 ECMWF 集合预报。降水、云顶高度和太阳辐照度在推理时从不作为输入，却在短期预报时效内以匹配或超过业务产品的技巧被推断出来。相对于 NOAA 的格点统计插值（GSI）DA 系统的初猜场，WeatherDreamer 的短期偏差在地面站点处于 GSI 的 10% 以内，对湿度敏感的微波通道处于 25% 以内，但对温度探测通道则高达五倍。在从未获得观测误差的情况下，其学习到的更新所假定的误差接近微波探测仪和散射计风的已知仪器误差与反演误差。WeatherDreamer 还能将观测视角几何与大气状态分离，恢复了 83–96% 的观测到的临边昏暗（limb darkening），并生成无缝的天底视角图像。WeatherDreamer 在单块 GPU 上约 1.5 分钟内生成逐小时全球分析，表明同化与预报可以直接从观测中联合学习。

title: Objectives as Policies: Vision-Language Model Cost Programs for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong semantic and spatial reasoning capabilities in 3D environments. Recently, connecting VLMs with model-predictive controllers (MPC) has emerged as a paradigm for combining strong semantic reasoning with physics-based planning. However, connecting these two for contact-rich robotic manipulation requires a task representation that bridges the two and captures how physical interactions can be reasoned by VLMs. In this work, we introduce Objectives as Policies (OaP), a framework that connects a pretrained VLM to a shared sampling-based MPC through an editable objective program. Each program specifies a sequence of stages for completing a task, combining running and terminal costs from a cost library with stage completion conditions. Given a natural-language task instruction and scene observation, we build a simulation-based digital twin through real-to-sim, and the VLM generates an objective program that is executed by the MPC in the simulation. The program is iteratively updated by the VLM based on MPC rollouts, before being deployed in the real world. We evaluate our framework in both simulation and the real world on four tabletop manipulation tasks, and show that it outperforms strong baselines. Additional videos and examples are available on the project website: https://zihaolu001.github.io/oap-project/

AI.title_zh: 目标即策略：用于富接触操作的视觉-语言模型代价程序
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已在三维环境中展现出强大的语义与空间推理能力。近来，将VLM与模型预测控制器（MPC）相连接，已成为一种将强语义推理与基于物理的规划相结合的范式。然而，要将二者连接起来用于富接触的机器人操作，需要一个能够桥接两者、并刻画VLM如何推理物理交互的任务表示。在本工作中，我们提出"目标即策略"（Objectives as Policies，OaP）框架，它通过可编辑的目标程序将预训练的VLM与一个共享的基于采样的MPC相连接。每个程序为完成一项任务指定一系列阶段，将来自代价库的运行代价与终端代价同阶段完成条件结合起来。给定自然语言任务指令与场景观测，我们通过real-to-sim构建基于仿真的数字孪生，VLM生成一个目标程序，并由MPC在仿真中执行。该程序由VLM基于MPC的推演（rollouts）迭代更新，随后部署到真实世界。我们在仿真和真实世界中在四项桌面操作任务上评估了我们的框架，并表明其优于强基线。更多视频与示例见项目网站：https://zihaolu001.github.io/oap-project/

title: Recovered or Memorized? Investigating Dynamical Consistency and Faithfulness in World Model Latents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability for Discovery (Interp4Discovery)
summary: World models develop internal simulators that can learn the structure and dynamics of an environment. It has been demonstrated that their internal representations are both meaningful and causal, but are these representations faithful to the governing dynamics of the environment they are learning? We introduce Anchored Recovery Certification (ARC), a procedure that utilizes a discrete Fréchet distance calculation with ground truth to evaluate dynamical consistency on candidate world models up to an affine gauge. We use the procedure on TD-MPC2 (decoder-free world model) that has learned the pendulum swing on an observation lift under varying hyperparameters at k = 5, 10, 25 steps. The model is then steered within a PCA-derived intervention subspace and compared against a ground-truth simulator using relative error to investigate dynamical faithfulness. ARC sufficiency held for TD-MPC2 most consistently at k = 10, with six of seven constraints statistically significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction, while the relative error between the simulator and the causal latent remained substantial. Further research could be conducted with decoder world models such as DreamerV3 (reconstruction loss) to investigate whether the results differ.

AI.title_zh: 恢复还是记忆？探究世界模型潜在表示的动力学一致性与忠实性
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型会发展出内部模拟器，能够学习环境的结构与动力学。已有研究表明，其内部表示既有意义又具有因果性，但这些表示是否忠实于其所学习环境的支配动力学？我们提出锚定恢复认证（Anchored Recovery Certification, ARC），该流程利用与真实值之间的离散 Fréchet 距离计算，在相差一个仿射规范（affine gauge）的意义上评估候选世界模型的动力学一致性。我们在 TD-MPC2（无解码器世界模型）上使用该流程，该模型在不同超参数下、于 k = 5、10、25 步时学习了观测升维（observation lift）上的单摆摆动。随后，模型在由 PCA 导出的干预子空间内被引导，并使用相对误差与真实值模拟器进行比较，以探究动力学忠实性。ARC 充分性在 k = 10 时对 TD-MPC2 最为一致地成立，七项约束中有六项在 Holm-Bonferroni 校正后具有统计显著性，而模拟器与因果潜在表示之间的相对误差仍然很大。未来可对诸如 DreamerV3（重建损失）之类的解码器世界模型开展进一步研究，以考察结果是否有所不同。

title: Any Channel Count, One Token Stream: Incorporating Spatial Audio Understanding and Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/Konoyo-014/SpheraQA. Dataset: https://modelscope.cn/datasets/Konoyo/SpheraQA. Paper experiments use the 20,492-question SpheraQA version; the public release contains 22,197 questions
summary: Audio phase relations encode source locations, yet existing large audio-language models (LALM) reduce audio to single-channel content to stabilise general audio understanding, leaving spatial information for direction, distance, and source-relation questions unused. We present SpheraAudio, which accepts recordings with any channel count -- mono, stereo, First-Order Ambisonics (FOA), or higher -- and maps them into a single token stream. A spatial encoder turns complex multichannel spectra into spatial tokens interleaved with audio tokens at corresponding temporal positions. Spatial Multimodal RoPE (SMRoPE) makes each token's modality identity and temporal slot visible to rotary attention without altering the language model's original RoPE. Training runs in three stages -- spatial-encoder pretraining, projector alignment, and joint supervised-and-reinforcement learning -- progressing from geometric supervision to language-based spatial decisions, with answers trained as explicit spatial chain-of-thought: step-by-step geometric reasoning over the heard scene. Current benchmarks tie questions to a fixed channel-count format and score answers without spatial reasoning evidence. We introduce SpheraQA, which spans mono, stereo, and FOA recordings and organises questions hierarchically from single-attribute perception through cross-source relations to multi-step reasoning, scored programmatically against simulated scene geometry and real-recording annotations with step-by-step solution references. Across SpheraQA and public spatial-audio benchmarks, SpheraAudio sets a new performance standard for spatial audio understanding. It supports high-precision localisation, tracking, and reasoning over static and moving sound sources while preserving strong general-audio capabilities. We will release code, SpheraQA, and evaluation metrics to support reproducibility.

AI.title_zh: 任意通道数，单一 token 流：将空间音频理解与推理融入大型音频-语言模型
AI.abstract_zh: 音频相位关系编码了声源位置，然而现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALM）将音频简化为单通道内容以稳定通用音频理解，从而使关于方向、距离和声源关系的空间信息未被利用。我们提出 SpheraAudio，它接受任意通道数的录音——单声道、立体声、一阶 Ambisonics（FOA）或更高阶——并将其映射为单一 token 流。空间编码器将复数多通道频谱转换为空间 token，并在相应的时间位置上与音频 token 交错排列。空间多模态 RoPE（SMRoPE）使每个 token 的模态标识与时间槽位对旋转注意力可见，同时不改变语言模型原有的 RoPE。训练分三个阶段进行——空间编码器预训练、投影器对齐，以及监督学习与强化学习的联合训练——从几何监督逐步推进到基于语言的空间决策，并以显式空间思维链（spatial chain-of-thought）训练答案：对所听到场景进行逐步的几何推理。现有基准将问题绑定到固定的通道数格式，并在评分答案时不考察空间推理证据。我们引入 SpheraQA，它涵盖单声道、立体声和 FOA 录音，并将问题从单属性感知，经跨声源关系，到多步推理进行层次化组织，依据模拟场景几何与真实录音标注以程序化方式评分，并提供逐步解答参考。在 SpheraQA 与公开空间音频基准上，SpheraAudio 为空间音频理解树立了新的性能标准。它支持对静态与移动声源进行高精度定位、跟踪和推理，同时保持强大的通用音频能力。我们将发布代码、SpheraQA 和评估指标以支持可复现性。

title: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet they remain prone to object hallucination---generating answers that are linguistically fluent but visually ungrounded. This issue is especially severe in low-resource languages, where weaker cross-modal alignment causes models to rely more on language priors than on image evidence. Existing remedies either require costly multilingual annotations or external translation/reward models, or intervene at inference time in ways that can distort the output language. We propose VEPO(Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization), a training-time method that transfers reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models. VEPO first localizes key visual evidence using English queries via mid-layer cross-modal attention, then constructs preference pairs that share the same correct answer but differ in evidence sufficiency (full image vs.\ key-region masked image). Direct preference optimization on these pairs encourages low-resource inputs to prefer answers supported by complete visual evidence. Experiments on multilingual POPE and MME with Chinese, French, and Hindi show consistent hallucination reduction and perception gains, with the largest improvements on the lowest-resource language. Analyses further confirm that VEPO sharpens question-relevant attention and that evidence-guided masking outperforms random masking.

AI.title_zh: VEPO：通过视觉证据引导的偏好优化缓解 LVLM 中的多语言幻觉
AI.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）取得了强劲的多模态性能，但仍易出现物体幻觉——即生成语言上流畅但缺乏视觉依据的答案。这一问题在低资源语言中尤为严重，因为较弱的跨模态对齐使模型更多地依赖语言先验而非图像证据。现有补救方法要么需要昂贵的多语言标注或外部翻译/奖励模型，要么在推理阶段进行干预，而这类干预可能扭曲输出语言。我们提出 VEPO（Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization，视觉证据引导的偏好优化），这是一种训练时方法，可将可靠的视觉依据从英语迁移到其他语言，且无需外部模型。VEPO 首先通过中间层跨模态注意力，使用英语查询定位关键视觉证据，然后构建偏好对，这些偏好对共享同一正确答案，但在证据充分性上有所不同（完整图像 vs.\ 关键区域被掩码的图像）。在这些偏好对上进行直接偏好优化，促使低资源输入偏好由完整视觉证据支持的答案。在中文、法文和印地语的多语言 POPE 与 MME 上的实验显示，幻觉持续减少且感知能力提升，其中在资源最低的语言上改进最大。分析进一步证实，VEPO 使与问题相关的注意力更加锐化，且证据引导的掩码优于随机掩码。

title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
summary: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.

AI.title_zh: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体式重建
AI.abstract_zh: 直接的图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，从而排除了持久的3D力学平衡、rollout中途干预以及反事实力控制的可能性。反之，从一张未标定照片进行单遍程序化3D重建，会使单目深度与支撑间隙（support clearance）约束不足，导致重建场景相互穿插或在重力作用下坍塌。我们提出TelePhysica，一个闭环框架，它从单张照片重建出可执行的、多物理机制的世界，以驱动有状态的3D交互与以轨迹为依归的视频合成。一个视觉-语言编码智能体在两阶段验证循环中合成可分离的视觉网格与声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓评判与零力重力平衡预检相结合。经验证的世界被编译进一个统一求解器，该求解器耦合刚体、铰接链、同维布料壳（co-dimensional cloth shells）与3D四面体弹性动力学，其模拟rollout通过像素对齐的结构流对预训练视频扩散模型进行条件化。在一个100场景的单图像基准上，闭环执行将平衡验证的世界恢复率从单遍合成的$0\%$提升至$81\%$。受控的本构消融实验显示，有限元布料中的局部角点位移与面外褶皱比匹配的刚性板替代品大一个数量级以上。以模拟轨迹对视频扩散模型进行条件化，可将动态运动掩码重叠度提高$2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$，并在直接图像到视频模型失败的反事实力反转情形下保持运动方向。

title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
summary: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.

AI.title_zh: 从图像到接地编辑：面向手写作文的中文语法错误纠正真实世界基准
AI.abstract_zh: 中文语法错误纠正（Chinese Grammatical Error Correction, CGEC）通常被形式化为一个文本到文本（text-to-text）的问题。这种形式化方式虽然适用于数字文本，但在真实的 K-12 教育场景中却力有不逮——在该场景中，AI 辅助批改被期望直接作用于作文图像之上，而这些作文主要是手写的，并呈现出许多不规范之处。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了接地中文语法错误纠正（Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction, G-CGEC），这是一个图像到接地编辑（image-to-grounded-edit）任务，要求系统同时预测纠正内容及其在作文图像上的位置。我们提出了 G-CGEC-Eval，这是一个包含带有细粒度标注的 K-12 中文作文真实世界图像的基准。在评估方面，我们采用了来自目标检测的基于 IoU 的指标，并提出了一种基于中心距离匹配、更为宽容的替代指标。利用该基准，我们在直接单次通过（single-pass）设置下，以及通过流水线（pipelining）或智能体式封装（agentic harnessing）协调辅助组件（OCR 与字符接地）的设置下，评估了开源与专有的视觉-语言模型。结果表明，即便是顶尖的专有模型在单次通过设置下也表现得惊人地差，而流水线与智能体式封装则带来了有意义的提升。值得注意的是，一种基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得了最佳性能，从而确立了其作为未来 G-CGEC 研究最强基线的地位。通过消融实验与细粒度分析，我们发现该任务仍远未解决，语言错误发现与字符级接地是主要的瓶颈。这凸显了对能够更好地将视觉感知与语言推理及视觉接地相结合的需求。

title: Toward Universal Translatability: On the Statistical Ontology of Generative AI
summary: This paper argues that the problem of translation functions both as a point of origin and as a normative horizon for contemporary generative AI. In current discourse around ''world models,'' their attainment is framed as the achievement of internal consistency, cross-modal alignment, and physical grounding. Taken together, these demands converge on an ideal of the model as a universal translation machine capable of establishing lossless correspondences across linguistic, visual, and physical representation spaces. I show that this ideal presupposes a metaphysical commitment that I call a statistical ontology: the belief that reality has an underlying, computable statistical structure that can be recovered through sufficient data and modeling, rather than being shaped and accessed through situated human interpretation and labor. Tracing this commitment back to Warren Weaver's 1949 Memorandum on machine translation, I outline how translation was historically recast as code deciphering and, later, as the alignment of probability distributions across structured outputs. Finally, I contrast this paradigm with approaches in Translation Studies that foreground opacity, power asymmetries, and the translator's positionality. I argue that generative AI's statistical ontology is pre-Kantian, pre-critical and obscures the infrastructures and human labor that make machine translatability---as alignment---possible in the first place.

AI.title_zh: 走向普遍可译性：论生成式人工智能的统计本体论
AI.abstract_zh: 本文论证，翻译问题既是当代生成式人工智能的起点，也是其规范性视域。在当前围绕"世界模型"的讨论中，世界模型的实现被表述为达到内部一致性、跨模态对齐与物理 grounding（物理基础）。综合来看，这些要求汇聚于一种理想：将模型视为一台能够跨越语言、视觉与物理表征空间建立无损对应关系的普遍翻译机器。本文表明，这一理想预设了一种我称之为"统计本体论"的形而上学承诺：即相信实在具有某种底层的、可计算统计结构，该结构可通过充分的数据与建模被还原，而非由处境化的人类解释与劳动所塑造和通达。本文将这一承诺追溯至 Warren Weaver 1949 年关于机器翻译的备忘录，并勾勒出翻译如何先后被重新界定为密码破译，以及此后被界定为跨结构化输出的概率分布对齐。最后，本文将这一范式与翻译研究（Translation Studies）中凸显不透明性、权力不对称以及译者位置性的进路相对照。本文认为，生成式人工智能的统计本体论是前康德式的、前批判的，并且遮蔽了那些从一开始就使机器可译性——作为对齐——得以可能的基础设施与人类劳动。

title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
comment: Main paper + Supplementary paper Under submission at a journal
summary: Text-to-video generation runs at commercial scale, but its broader environmental impacts remain, to our knowledge, understudied. Providers rarely disclose video volumes or energy needs; we measured the yearly video output of two commercial platforms and built a prospective model of such services' absolute footprint from training to storage. Our projections suggest that reducing emissions depends on both limiting growth in video generation and achieving substantial efficiency gains. Under continued growth, emissions rise nearly seventy-five-fold by 2030 despite technological improvements. When usage remains at 2026 levels, the same improvements reduce emissions by about two-fifths. These estimates are a conservative lower bound: they cover one AI service among many; other services and uses would push the total higher.

AI.title_zh: 从信息流中测算：AI 视频生成不可持续的增长
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到视频生成已在商业规模上运行，但据我们所知，其更广泛的环境影响仍研究不足。服务提供商很少披露视频生成量或能源需求；我们测量了两个商业平台的年度视频产出，并构建了一个前瞻性模型，用以估算此类服务从训练到存储的绝对足迹。我们的预测表明，减少排放既取决于限制视频生成量的增长，也取决于实现大幅度的效率提升。在持续增长的情形下，尽管有技术进步，到 2030 年排放量仍将上升近七十五倍。若使用量维持在 2026 年的水平，同样的改进可使排放量减少约五分之二。这些估计是保守的下限：它们只涵盖众多 AI 服务中的一项；其他服务与用途会使总量更高。

title: Token2Tile: Token-Wise Sparse Attention with Tile Execution through a Low-Rank Space for Video DiTs
summary: Attention is essential for modeling spatio-temporal dependencies in video diffusion transformers, but its quadratic cost makes it a major inference bottleneck. Its high sparsity offers an opportunity to accelerate generation by focusing computation on important interactions. However, accuracy and execution favor different granularities: each query attends to its own key tokens, whereas GPU kernels work on tiles. We present Token2Tile, a training-free sparse attention operator that combines per-query scoring and a per-query residual with tile execution. An online low-rank space, computed directly from queries and keys to preserve attention logits, makes clustering, scoring, and residual approximation efficient. Token2Tile unites query-specific selections to allocate exact work across query clusters, then packs the selected keys into GPU tiles. On MiniMax-H3 and Wan2.1-14B, Token2Tile delivers 1.48-1.54x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention-3 with VBench scores within 0.5 points of dense. At comparable speeds on H3, it improves PSNR over SOL and SubBlock by 5.5-6.8 dB; on Wan, it exceeds SOL by 4.6-4.8 dB while running faster.

AI.title_zh: Token2Tile：面向视频 DiT 的、通过低秩空间进行 Tile 执行的逐 Token 稀疏注意力
AI.abstract_zh: 注意力对于视频扩散 Transformer 中的时空依赖建模至关重要，但其二次方开销使其成为主要的推理瓶颈。其高度稀疏性为通过将计算集中于重要交互来加速生成提供了机会。然而，精度与执行各自偏好不同的粒度：每个查询关注其自身的键 token，而 GPU 内核则以 tile 为单位工作。我们提出 Token2Tile，一种免训练的稀疏注意力算子，它将以每个查询为单位的打分与以每个查询为单位的残差同 tile 执行相结合。一个在线低秩空间直接由查询和键计算得到，以保持注意力 logits，从而使聚类、打分和残差近似变得高效。Token2Tile 将查询特定的选择统一起来，在查询簇之间分配精确的工作量，随后将选中的键打包成 GPU tile。在 MiniMax-H3 和 Wan2.1-14B 上，Token2Tile 相比稠密 FlashAttention-3 实现了 1.48-1.54 倍的端到端加速，VBench 分数与稠密结果相差在 0.5 分以内。在 H3 上于相当的速度下，它相比 SOL 和 SubBlock 将 PSNR 提升了 5.5-6.8 dB；在 Wan 上，它在运行更快的同时相比 SOL 高出 4.6-4.8 dB。

title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
summary: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: https://github.com/kkt94/Llama-V-JEPA-LM.

AI.title_zh: V-JEPA-LM：能够读取超越静态、文本对齐表征的动态信息的视频-语言模型
AI.abstract_zh: 诸如 V-JEPA 之类的世界模型视频编码器仅从视频中学习场景如何变化（方向、速度、顺序、状态）。为了回答问题，它们会与在字幕和问答对上训练的语言模型相连接。但每条字幕或问题只命名一个片段的少数属性，因此模型学到的是检索这些属性，而不是读取片段本身，编码器所承载的动态信息因而未被利用：在相同的样本上，线性探针（linear probe）从冻结的 V-JEPA 特征中读取速度的准确率为 87%，而 VLM 的回答仅处于随机水平。我们展示了动态信息在冻结编码器中的所在之处：对于 V-JEPA 这类预测式编码器，它位于跨视频共享的子空间中；而对于 SigLIP 这类逐帧、文本对齐的编码器，它并不作为共享成分存在。随后我们构建反事实监督（counterfactual supervision），使语言模型能够读取这一信息：像素变换将公开视频转化为答案均衡的变体，其答案由该变换决定，且仅在变化上有所不同。在单阶段训练中，使用 4.53M 个公开样本、每帧 32 个视觉 token（而开放视频 LLM 使用多个阶段、9M 至 172M 个样本、平均每帧 64 至 256 个 token），所得的 V-JEPA-LM 模型（1B 至 8B，Qwen3 与 Llama）在十一个视频基准上的平均得分领先于每个规模类别；我们的 4B 模型得分为 72.1，而最佳开放 4B 模型为 61.1，最佳开放 8B 模型为 64.8。一项受控的编码器 × 监督研究（encoder × supervision study）表明，编码器决定哪些信息可被读取，而监督决定哪些信息被读取：在匹配的预算下，反事实监督平均提升 4.5 分，在自然基准的速度问题上提升 38 分。代码与模型：https://github.com/kkt94/Llama-V-JEPA-LM。

title: CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation
summary: Edge AI increasingly relies on specialized accelerators for low-latency inference under tight resource and energy constraints, yet their efficiency remains limited by data movement. Prior work, CHARM, mitigates this overhead by overlapping data movement with computation. We observe that in-memory computing can further supplement tensor processing as a parallel accelerator while eliminating certain data movements entirely. We present CHARMING, a heterogeneous edge AI architecture that uses accuracy- and quantization-aware partitioning to distribute and concurrently execute inference workloads across tensor processing and in-memory computation. CHARMING partitions attention heads between an AIE array and an in-DRAM compute unit, balancing execution according to model architecture, sequence length, and precision while selecting heads to minimize accuracy degradation. CHARMING also integrates quantization into the AIE projection stage to further reduce data movement. We validate CHARMING end-to-end in hardware on AMD Versal VCK5000 and Alveo U200 platforms and evaluate LLM and video-generation models across multiple precisions using measured hardware results and simulation of the latest in-memory compute hardware. CHARMING improves prefill performance by up to 23.6 percent and decode performance by up to 44 percent over AIE-only acceleration. With int4 x int4 fixed-point in-memory computation, CHARMING reduces per-layer energy by up to 7.6 percent and improves energy-delay product by up to 24.7 percent, while maintaining accuracy similar to a 32-bit floating-point baseline.

AI.title_zh: CHARMING：跨张量处理与存内计算的并行边缘AI加速
AI.abstract_zh: 边缘AI日益依赖专用加速器，以在严格的资源与能耗约束下实现低延迟推理，然而其效率仍受限于数据移动。已有工作CHARM通过将数据移动与计算重叠来缓解这一开销。我们观察到，存内计算可以作为一种并行加速器进一步补充张量处理，同时完全消除某些数据移动。我们提出CHARMING，一种异构边缘AI架构，采用精度感知与量化感知的划分方法，将推理工作负载分布到张量处理与存内计算之上并并发执行。CHARMING将注意力头划分到AIE阵列与DRAM内计算单元之间，根据模型架构、序列长度和精度来平衡执行，同时选择注意力头以最小化精度下降。CHARMING还将量化集成到AIE投影阶段，以进一步减少数据移动。我们在AMD Versal VCK5000和Alveo U200平台上对CHARMING进行了端到端的硬件验证，并利用实测硬件结果以及对最新存内计算硬件的仿真，评估了多种精度下的LLM与视频生成模型。与仅使用AIE加速相比，CHARMING将预填充（prefill）性能最多提升23.6%，解码（decode）性能最多提升44%。在int4 x int4定点存内计算下，CHARMING将每层能耗最多降低7.6%，并将能量延迟积最多提升24.7%，同时保持与32位浮点基线相近的精度。

title: Beyond Prediction Gain: LASR as a Metric for Action-Grounded Latents in World Models
summary: World models that support planning, control, and interpretable reasoning require latent representations that genuinely encode action. Yet the large-scale video data from which such models are learned overwhelmingly lack action annotations. Latent-action models infer action-like variables from observation sequences, enabling action-aware learning from unlabeled videos or trajectories. A fundamental concern, however, remains: a latent that improves future prediction may simply encode the current state, episode progress, task identity, or other predictive shortcuts. Existing evaluation practices---reconstruction loss, rollout fidelity, action recovery, or downstream performance---cannot isolate this distinction. We introduce the Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR), a dimensionless metric that measures, under offline evaluation on held-out data, whether a learned latent provides predictive support for action-related targets beyond the current state and non-action alternatives. LASR provides two complementary summaries: GeoLASR captures typical support, while WorstLASR identifies the weakest case. We instantiate the LASR benchmark with recorded actions and corresponding physical state changes as targets, episode-held-out splits, one predictor type for all comparisons, and positive and negative controls. Experiments on recorded robot manipulation data and a matched multi-task panel demonstrate that LASR detects known action information, rejects representative non-action shortcuts, and enables graded comparisons among imperfect latent representations. We further use LASR to train and audit a lightweight residual adapter, obtaining descriptively better point estimates whose uncertainty is assessed with paired comparisons. LASR thus provides a principled offline protocol for measuring action-related predictive support in world-model latents.

AI.title_zh: 超越预测增益：LASR 作为世界模型中动作锚定潜变量的度量指标
AI.abstract_zh: 支持规划、控制与可解释推理的世界模型要求潜表示能够真正编码动作。然而，用于学习此类模型的大规模视频数据绝大多数缺乏动作标注。潜动作模型（latent-action models）从观测序列中推断类动作变量，从而能够从无标注视频或轨迹中进行动作感知学习。然而，一个根本性的担忧依然存在：一个能改进未来预测的潜变量，可能仅仅编码了当前状态、回合进度、任务身份或其他预测性捷径。现有的评估实践——重建损失、推演保真度、动作恢复或下游性能——无法将这一区别分离出来。我们提出潜动作支持比（Latent Action Support Ratio, LASR），这是一个无量纲指标，在留出数据上的离线评估中度量所学潜变量是否在超出当前状态与非动作替代变量之外，为动作相关目标提供预测支持。LASR 提供了两种互补的汇总方式：GeoLASR 刻画典型支持度，而 WorstLASR 识别最弱情形。我们以记录的动作及相应的物理状态变化作为目标、以回合留出的方式划分数据、对所有比较使用同一种预测器类型，并设置正对照与负对照，来构建 LASR 基准。在记录的机器人操作数据与一个匹配的多任务面板上的实验表明，LASR 能够检测出已知的动作信息、拒绝具有代表性的非动作捷径，并能够对不完美的潜表示进行分级比较。我们进一步使用 LASR 来训练并审计一个轻量级残差适配器（residual adapter），获得了在描述意义上更好的点估计，其不确定性通过配对比较进行评估。因此，LASR 为度量世界模型潜变量中与动作相关的预测支持提供了一个有原则的离线协议。

title: AI-guided robotic in situ fabrication of curvature- and tissue-adaptive wireless bioelectronics
summary: Personalized bioelectronic devices for wound therapy require not only conformal fabrication on complex body surfaces but also functional adaptation of their electrical characteristics to individual wound geometries. Here, we present an AI-guided robotic in situ printing platform for fabricating wireless wound electrotherapy devices directly on transparent wound dressings. The system integrates a 3D vision camera, a six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm, direct-ink-writing, and geometry-aware RF design optimization. AI-based wound segmentation is used to determine wound dimensions and local surface curvature, while the reconstructed three-dimensional geometry is incorporated into the electromagnetic design of the receiving coil and interdigitated electrodes. In contrast to conventional approaches that use surface geometry only for trajectory generation, the proposed method accounts for both anatomical curvature and tissue dielectric loading to compensate for geometry-induced shifts in resonant behavior. A printable silver ink was characterized in terms of rheology, dimensional reproducibility, electrical resistance, and electromechanical stability, and was used to fabricate multilayer wireless devices directly on curved polyurethane dressings. Wireless power transfer, impedance characteristics, and electric-field delivery were evaluated experimentally and numerically. Finally, robotic in situ fabrication was demonstrated on an anthropomorphic tissue-equivalent forearm phantom, where the measured dielectric properties of the phantom were incorporated into the RF optimization, enabling resonant operation near the target frequency of 25 MHz. This work establishes a perception-to-design-to-fabrication framework for geometry-adaptive wireless bioelectronics and provides a technological foundation for future physical-AI-enabled manufacturing of personalized on-body electrotherapy devices.

AI.title_zh: AI引导的机器人原位制造曲率与组织自适应无线生物电子器件
AI.abstract_zh: 用于伤口治疗的个性化生物电子器件不仅需要在复杂体表上进行共形制造，还需要其电学特性能够针对个体伤口几何形状实现功能自适应。在此，我们提出了一种AI引导的机器人原位打印平台，用于直接在透明伤口敷料上制造无线伤口电疗器件。该系统集成了3D视觉相机、六自由度机械臂、直写打印（direct-ink-writing）以及几何感知的射频设计优化。基于AI的伤口分割被用于确定伤口尺寸与局部表面曲率，而重建的三维几何结构则被纳入接收线圈与叉指电极的电磁设计中。与仅将表面几何用于轨迹生成的传统方法不同，所提出的方法同时考虑解剖曲率与组织介电负载，以补偿几何形状引起的谐振行为偏移。对一种可打印银墨水的流变学、尺寸可重复性、电阻以及机电稳定性进行了表征，并将其用于在曲面聚氨酯敷料上直接制造多层无线器件。通过实验与数值方法评估了无线功率传输、阻抗特性以及电场递送。最后，在拟人组织等效前臂体模上演示了机器人原位制造，其中体模实测的介电特性被纳入射频优化，从而实现了接近25 MHz目标频率的谐振工作。本工作建立了一个面向几何自适应无线生物电子的"感知—设计—制造"框架，并为未来由物理AI赋能的个性化在体电疗器件制造提供了技术基础。

title: Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization
summary: Joint world action models (WAMs) generate future actions and states together, modeling world-action trajectories rather than actions alone. However, trajectory imitation does not ensure that these trajectories are task-effective or consistent with dynamics. We present \textbf{world action trajectory optimization (WATO)}, which optimizes generated actions and future states jointly for control. WATO uses both as references in a dynamics-constrained trajectory optimization problem and differentiates the task loss through the optimized trajectory to train the generator. This makes generated trajectories task-aware and dynamics-consistent while using trajectory optimization only during training. At deployment, WATO directly generates candidate trajectories and ranks them with a world model, without iterative trajectory optimization. Across $7$ visual control environments, WATO improves average success from $79.9\%$ for the imitation joint WAM to $91.7\%$, outperforming strong model-based, goal-conditioned RL, and generative control baselines. Compared with cross-entropy method (CEM), WATO is on average $11.5\times$ faster and uses $600.5\times$ fewer world model evaluations at deployment.

AI.title_zh: 通过可微轨迹优化的联合世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 联合世界动作模型（joint world action models, WAMs）同时生成未来动作与状态，对世界-动作轨迹而非仅对动作进行建模。然而，轨迹模仿并不能保证这些轨迹在任务上有效或与动力学一致。我们提出\textbf{世界动作轨迹优化（world action trajectory optimization, WATO）}，它针对控制任务联合优化生成的动作与未来状态。WATO 将二者作为受动力学约束的轨迹优化问题中的参考，并将任务损失通过优化后的轨迹进行微分，以训练生成器。这使得生成的轨迹具有任务感知性且与动力学一致，同时仅在训练期间使用轨迹优化。在部署时，WATO 直接生成候选轨迹并用世界模型对其排序，无需迭代轨迹优化。在 $7$ 个视觉控制环境中，WATO 将平均成功率从模仿式联合 WAM 的 $79.9\%$ 提升至 $91.7\%$，优于强基线，包括基于模型的方法、目标条件强化学习（goal-conditioned RL）以及生成式控制基线。与交叉熵方法（cross-entropy method, CEM）相比，WATO 在部署时平均快 $11.5\times$，且世界模型评估次数少 $600.5\times$。

title: Learning Latent Goal Costs for Visual World-Model Planning with an Expanding Curriculum
summary: Image-goal planning with a frozen visual world model depends on how predicted observations are scored against the goal. Mean-squared error (MSE) between embeddings from a pretrained visual encoder can provide a useful signal near a goal, yet favor states across an obstacle that are visually similar to the goal and difficult to reach. We fit a small residual adapter on top of frozen I-JEPA embeddings to improve this latent goal cost. Starting near each goal, a planner collects trajectories from progressively wider regions of initial states. The adapter learns from the order of observations along successful trajectories, with additional comparisons inferred from failed rollouts. No task-specific progress labels are used for fitting, so the procedure can be applied to other goal-reaching tasks. DotWall and PointMaze are used in this work. In paired 50-case evaluations with identical starts, goals, world models, and planner settings, success increases from 54% to 98% in DotWall and from 82% to 96% in PointMaze. On 16 unseen DotWall layout-goal cases, the adapter fitted on one fixed layout improves agreement between latent-cost ordering and shortest legal-path ordering from 71.9% to 85.8%. The results indicate that planning experience can improve a frozen visual representation's goal cost without retraining the encoder or the world model.

AI.title_zh: 为视觉世界模型规划学习潜在目标代价：一种扩展式课程方法
AI.abstract_zh: 使用冻结的视觉世界模型进行图像目标规划，取决于如何将预测观测与目标进行打分比较。来自预训练视觉编码器的嵌入之间的均方误差（MSE）可以在目标附近提供有用的信号，却会偏好那些位于障碍物另一侧、在视觉上与目标相似但难以到达的状态。我们在冻结的 I-JEPA 嵌入之上拟合一个小型残差适配器，以改进这一潜在目标代价。规划器从每个目标附近开始，从逐步扩大的初始状态区域中收集轨迹。适配器从成功轨迹上观测的先后顺序中学习，并利用失败 rollout 推断出的额外比较进行学习。拟合过程不使用任务特定的进展标签，因此该流程可应用于其他目标到达任务。本工作使用 DotWall 和 PointMaze。在起点、目标、世界模型与规划器设置均相同的成对 50 例评估中，DotWall 的成功率从 54% 提升至 98%，PointMaze 从 82% 提升至 96%。在 16 个未见过的 DotWall 布局-目标案例上，于某一固定布局上拟合的适配器使潜在代价排序与最短合法路径排序之间的一致性从 71.9% 提升至 85.8%。结果表明，规划经验可以在不重新训练编码器或世界模型的情况下改进冻结视觉表示的目标代价。

title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

AI.title_zh: 回到像素：将潜空间视频扩散提升至像素空间
AI.abstract_zh: 前沿视频生成模型在 VAE 潜空间（latent space）中工作，该潜空间在空间和时间两个维度上对视频进行压缩。这种压缩使得训练变得可行，但如今限制了高分辨率、可控以及交互式的生成——分辨率翻倍会使 token 数量变为四倍，条件作用于帧组而非单帧，且每个响应都必须等待其多帧块中的其余部分。我们提出 PixVid，一种简单而有效的方法，可将预训练的潜空间视频模型提升为在像素空间中直接生成每一帧。PixVid 保留扩散 transformer，并将 VAE 解码器替换为一个卷积头（convolutional head），由其将输出渲染为像素。我们发现，预测干净视频而非速度（velocity），并结合更大的噪声偏移（noise shift），是保证质量的关键。基于 Wan2.1-14B 微调，PixVid 在约 $\sim 1.3$M 个训练片段内即可与潜空间基线相竞争。以逐帧方式在像素空间中工作时，它在每帧 token 数相同的情况下生成 $2\times$ 更高分辨率的视频，在快速运动下保持深度条件视频编辑对齐，并在下一帧对每个动作作出响应。项目主页：https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

AI.title_zh: K2V：面向物理合理视频生成的生成式关键帧方法
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散模型能够生成具有高质量外观与纹理品质的样本。然而，已知这些方法生成的内容会表现出显著的物理错误。这是因为在经典的视频生成设定中，所有物理推理都必须在扩散过程内部同时且唯一地进行。我们提出通过将物理推理任务重新分配给一个由语言模型支持的关键帧生成模块来解决这些问题，该模块允许以语言进行显式推理，并对视频在关键时刻的外观进行细粒度控制。随后，我们以这些关键帧作为视频生成模型的条件，从而将扩散模型的作用降为更简单的任务，即在物理正确的中间状态之间进行插值，而非用扩散推断整个序列。结果表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，在Physics-IQ Verified基准和PhyGenBench上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

AI.title_zh: 空间铸造厂：面向空间智能的多模态数据集
