AI.abstract_zh: 在缺乏外在奖励或任务监督的情况下，人类行为由内在动机（intrinsic motivation）引导——这些神经信号驱动好奇心、创造力、玩耍以及智能的其他基本方面。内在动机在构建能够实现泛化与适应的鲁棒世界模型方面发挥着关键的发展性作用。然而，现有研究尚未明确广泛的各类内在动机如何与世界模型表征学习相互作用以支持下流控制。这限制了我们对哪些由内在动机收集的经验能够构建可复用模型的理解。为弥补这些空白，我们将24种内在目标——包括已有方法以及涵盖好奇心、熵和胜任力（competency）的显式变体——整合到一个共同的基于模型的强化学习框架中。我们在运动（locomotion）、操作（manipulation）和开放式游戏环境中通过零样本、少样本和多任务控制来评估它们所构建的世界模型，并采用三种表征学习策略：观测重建、潜空间预测和冗余缩减。以观测重建驱动的好奇心探索产生了最强的总体族系表现，尽管最佳的具体配对取决于实验。在组合式视觉任务中，源自情节性新颖性和终生新颖性两者——为世界模型的通用循环状态提供互补记忆——的内在动机实现了最佳的零样本迁移和少样本适应。这些发现支持将内在动机与表征学习进行联合设计。我们的结果证明，世界模型是衡量内在动机驱动经验质量的有力工具，并将内在动机定位为自主构建世界模型的关键要素。

title: DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander
summary: Soft powered descent landings are becoming evermore important in the field of space exploration and scientific advancement, because of their ability to deliver mission critical payloads, both highly accurately and safely. The high efficiency restriction on planetary landings due to the severely limited fuel supply results in the need for optimal guidance trajectories and control. Model based reinforcement learning is proving to be an important tool in simplifying the highly complex process of generating optimal guidance trajectories and control. In this work, we present DreamLander, a state of the art model based reinforcement learning algorithm based on DreamerV3, to generate optimal guidance and control for a realistic 6 degree of freedom entry descent landing problem. The model based approach creates a sample efficient and highly generalizable model that can be applied to a variety of scenarios whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy, landing within 2 meters of the designated landing zone, and with velocity norm less than 0.3 meters per second. DreamLander makes use of state sensor observations, making progress toward End-to-End solutions of the Entry Descent Landing problem.

AI.title_zh: DreamLander：一种基于6自由度世界模型的强化学习行星着陆器
AI.abstract_zh: 软动力下降着陆凭借其能够高精度且安全地投送任务关键载荷的能力，在太空探索与科学进步领域正变得愈发重要。由于燃料供应严重受限，行星着陆对高效性有严格限制，因而需要最优制导轨迹与控制。基于模型的强化学习正被证明是简化生成最优制导轨迹与控制这一高度复杂过程的重要工具。在本工作中，我们提出DreamLander，一种基于DreamerV3的先进基于模型的强化学习算法，用于为贴近实际的6自由度进入、下降与着陆（entry descent landing）问题生成最优制导与控制。该基于模型的方法构建出一个样本高效且高度可泛化的模型，可应用于多种场景，同时保持高精度，在距指定着陆区2米以内着陆，且速度范数小于0.3米每秒。DreamLander利用状态传感器观测，朝着进入、下降与着陆问题的端到端（End-to-End）解决方案迈出了进展。

title: Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Submitted to Plant Phenomics. 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
summary: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.

AI.title_zh: Plant Orbiter：基于视频扩散轨道相机与 3D 高斯泼溅的植物三维重建与生成
AI.abstract_zh: 现代数字表型流水线需要精确测量一系列三维形态学植物性状。对这些性状进行准确、高通量的采集，有助于育种者和研究人员加速新品种、新技术和新产品的开发。三维技术的最新进展使得从二维流水线向三维流水线快速过渡成为可能，但由于植物形态复杂、结构纤细以及存在遮挡，高通量获取植物的数字三维孪生仍是一项重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出 Plant Orbiter，这是一种生成三维植物的新方法，它利用视频扩散的最新进展，从单张图像生成高质量的植物三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splats）。我们表明，与其他最先进方法相比，我们的方法能更准确地重建植物形态，在所有基线方法中取得了最高的 3D F-score，同时由于更容易对齐且相机布置成本更低，对高通量流水线而言更具实用性。结合二维扩散模型，我们表明我们的方法在根据文本提示生成三维植物模型方面也取得了最先进的结果。

title: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
summary: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

AI.title_zh: $Σ$-LeWM：通过 S-信息学习世界模型以实现机器人控制
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用作一种基于模型的控制方法，应用于操作与运动等机器人任务。虽然早期的世界模型架构依赖解码器来防止模式崩溃并学习可预测的潜在空间，但近期关于世界模型的工作，例如联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture）或 LeWorldModel，越来越倾向于在没有接地解码器（grounding decoder）的情况下学习嵌入，仅利用一个潜在前向动力学预测器和一个起稳定作用的熵项。在本文中，我们旨在证明，向 LeWorldModel 进一步引入两个额外的潜在损失——一个反向动力学预测器和一个逆动力学动作预测器——会在潜在嵌入上施加更多结构，从而在性能与规划效率两方面带来进一步的提升。这些是提高此类方法在真实机器人实时基于模型控制中适用性的关键特性。我们在标准世界模型基准和两个模拟机器人操作任务上展示了这些提升。

title: Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model
summary: A world model predicts how a scene changes after an action, and a planner uses it to search for actions that reach a goal. If the camera moves or the controller changes, the same command moves the robot differently: when its commands are turned by 90 degrees, a frozen planner with the LeWM world model that succeeds in 77.5% of episodes succeeds in only 7.8%. Current fixes retrain the model, need training data, or forget a set-up when it returns. We propose Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects only the map from commands to applied actions, which we call the hand. LoH reads the hand through the frozen model, with no extra sensor: it finds the action that best explains the change between two camera images (a reading). It stores every hand it identifies, so a returning set-up is recognised rather than re-learnt. In closed-loop tests, LoH more than doubles success on three simulated tasks, from 28.6% to 62.3%, and loses only 0.6 percentage points when nothing changes. It also works, unchanged, with two other world models and on two of three models pretrained on real robot data, and its gain grows with the quality of its readings.

AI.title_zh: 手之库：修正手，而非世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型预测场景在动作之后如何变化，规划器则利用它搜索能够达成目标的动作。若相机移动或控制器改变，同一指令会使机器人产生不同的运动：当其指令被旋转 90 度时，使用 LeWM 世界模型的冻结规划器在 77.5% 的回合中成功，此时却仅在 7.8% 的回合中成功。当前的修复方法需要重新训练模型、需要训练数据，或者在某一设置再次出现时将其遗忘。我们提出手之库（Library of Hands, LoH），这是一种无需训练的方法，它保持世界模型冻结，只修正从指令到实际施加动作的映射，我们将该映射称为“手”（hand）。LoH 通过冻结模型读取“手”，无需额外传感器：它找出最能解释两幅相机图像之间变化（一次读取，reading）的动作。它存储其识别出的每一只“手”，因此再次出现的设置会被识别出来，而不是被重新学习。在闭环测试中，LoH 在三个模拟任务上将成功率提升一倍以上，从 28.6% 提升至 62.3%，而在无任何变化时仅损失 0.6 个百分点。它还能保持不变地在另外两个世界模型上工作，并在三个基于真实机器人数据预训练的模型中的两个上工作，且其收益随着读取质量的提高而增大。

title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
summary: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

AI.title_zh: WanderBench：世界模型能否从视频中探索动态世界？
AI.abstract_zh: 以输入视频为条件的视频世界模型使得探索真实录制的动态场景成为可能，从而支持素材重拍（re-shooting of footage）、自由视点回放（free-viewpoint replay），以及面向具身智能体的真实到仿真（real-to-sim）环境。此类用途要求生成的 rollout 忠实于所录制的世界，然而现有基准从单张图像或文本提示出发，而以视频为条件的生成主要依据感知质量和相机跟随来评估。这些评估并不能直接衡量探索是否在重访某一位置时保持了主体身份、事件进程和场景一致性。我们提出 WanderBench，一个用于从视频探索动态世界的基准。它包含 745 段真实与 AI 生成内容的单镜头源视频，分为三个难度层级（3-25 秒），配以以键盘动作给出的相机路线，并用 24 个人工验证的子指标评估六个维度。在对八个模型进行基准测试后，我们发现，随着片段变长，模型能够保持静态场景和视觉质量，但会失去相机控制和源动态，并且没有一个模型能让重访地点保持一致。我们进一步提出 WanderLand，一个免训练框架，它将冻结模型的每一帧条件化于同一时刻的源内容，并在重访时条件化于其自身先前的静态内容。WanderLand 在每一个维度上提升了五个模型，在源动态保真度上最高提升 8.3 分。

title: EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). 26 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://jenspars.github.io/EditJudge-Bench/
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

AI.title_zh: EditJudge-Bench：以合成真值审计 VLM 图像编辑评判器
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被用作图像编辑基准的自动评判器，但其可靠性却鲜为人知。审计这些评判器十分困难，因为真实编辑图像缺乏受控的真值，并且会将所请求的修改与模型伪影、非预期的副作用以及模棱两可的成功程度纠缠在一起。在本文中，我们提出了 EditJudge-Bench，这是一个包含 1,382 对合成前后图像对的诊断性基准，这些图像对在 Blender 中渲染，其编辑依据源于真实用户请求的九个类别进行参数化，并具备来自已知 3D 场景参数的精确真值。由于每一次编辑都是通过对受控场景施加已知干预而生成的，EditJudge-Bench 将 VLM 评判器评估为判断指令是否正确执行的二元验证器，从而将评判器的感知能力与编辑器的质量隔离开来。在 25 种评判器配置中，我们发现了显著的可靠性差距：(a) 被广泛采用的 VIEScore 模板在使用 GPT-4o 时仅达到 69.0% 的 AUROC；(b) 微调后的评判器得分为 51.7-66.3%；诸如旋转和形状之类的空间编辑仍然颇具挑战性；(c) 诸如图文顺序之类的提示格式选择会使性能最多偏移 14.1 个百分点。尽管仅使用了合成数据，EditJudge-Bench 上的评判器排名与两个真实图像人类偏好基准高度相关（$ρ$=0.95 和 $ρ$=0.71），这表明受控审计能够揭示与真实评估相关的失效模式。

title: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.

AI.title_zh: PhysOPSD：以代码作为特权信息实现物理上合理的视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管现代视频生成模型取得了显著的视觉保真度，但它们在生成物理上合理的动力学与复杂交互时仍明显脆弱。有针对性的后训练至关重要，然而监督微调受到离线状态失配的困扰，强化学习则受制于稀疏且定义不良的物理奖励函数。同策略（自）蒸馏（On-Policy (Self-)Distillation, OPSD）将同策略 rollout 与稠密纠正反馈相协调，从而将核心挑战转移到设计有效的特权上下文（privileged context）上。然而，传统模态难以胜任：文本提示本质上是陈述性的，而真实参考视频则将物理规律与视觉外观紧密纠缠，且不具备参数化控制能力。为此，我们提出 PhysOPSD，引入可执行代码作为视频生成的特权物理上下文。与静态视觉观测不同，可执行代码实例化了一个可编辑的物理世界，具有内在的抽象性与可控性。在 PhysOPSD-Engine 的支持下，我们将真实世界的物理场景转化为可验证的仿真程序。随后，PhysOPSD 纳入 (i) 双层物理特权（dual-level physical privilege），通过一个中间瓶颈弥合信息差距；以及 (ii) 在共享 rollout 噪声下的受控物理变化，以暴露因果动力学变化。大量实验表明，PhysOPSD 在多种骨干网络上大幅提升了物理合理性，仅用 $3$K 样本即优于 SFT 和 RL 基线，同时保持了一般的视频生成质量。

title: QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction
summary: A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation. Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions. On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.

AI.title_zh: QCC-WM：通过商式因果构造连接宏观状态动力学与视觉生成
AI.abstract_zh: 动作条件世界建模中的一个关键挑战是：从高维观测中构造出宏观状态，使其支持在动作条件下的递归预测，同时保持其预测演化与生成观测中的视觉变化相一致。我们提出 QCC-WM，一种基于商式因果构造（Quotient-based Causal Construction）的视觉世界模型。QCC-WM 利用动作响应来引导宏观变量的构造，以进行动作条件下的递归预测。一种共享的参考商测度（reference quotient measurement）约束预测状态与观测变化之间的一致性，使宏观层面的预测能够为未来的视觉生成提供结构化约束。利用平移和旋转动作及其预测响应，该模型通过因果抽象将局部视觉特征聚合为具有空间对应关系的宏观节点（macro-nodes），并在共享参考测度下递归预测节点内容与运动。宏观层面的预测引导未来观测的生成，而预测的运动则搬运历史外观信息。随后，生成观测与宏观层面目标之间的节点级误差被映射回相应的空间区域进行校正，从而提升视觉生成与宏观层面预测之间的一致性。在 US-VLA 数据集上，QCC-WM 的四步预测取得了 0.01861 的 ROI-MSE。与各预测步长上的最佳基线相比，其在四步预测以及八步和十六步递归外推中分别将 LPIPS 降低了 48.59%、41.68% 和 30.23%。消融研究和机制分析表明，运动引导的参考搬运主要改善像素重建，而节点级误差反馈进一步提升了感知质量以及生成观测与宏观层面预测之间的一致性。

title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
comment: 31 pages, 21 figures, 12 tables. ARC Prize 2026 Paper Track. Code and weights: https://github.com/third-intelligence/WARC
summary: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.

AI.title_zh: 世界模型需要多少次曝光？在测试时学习未见过的游戏机制
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够进行规划并从想象的经验中学习，但在不熟悉的环境中，它必须通过有限的交互来学习该环境的机制。机制是关于某个动作或某种交互如何改变环境某一部分的规则。模型观察到的机制的每一次发生即为一次曝光（exposure）。我们研究世界模型需要多少次曝光才能预测新环境机制所产生的效果。我们在 ARC-AGI-3 上研究这一问题，该基准由交互式游戏构成，并以游戏程序定义。我们提出 MechEval，它依据这些程序为 20 个游戏中的 69 个反复出现的机制进行标注。它在每次曝光时针对机制所改变的单元格对每个预测进行评分。作为测试平台，我们构建了 WARC（World model for ARC-AGI-3），这是一个具有 3500 万参数的视觉 Transformer，在其他游戏上进行预训练，并在每次转移后更新其全部参数。在留出的游戏上，WARC 学会以至少在所改变单元格上 80% 的准确率预测五分之四的机制，并将该准确率保持到记录结束。其中一半的机制在一次游戏的单局游玩中约 80 次曝光内达到该准确率，而在不进行更新的情况下，仅七分之一能达到该准确率。在公开游戏上的闭环游玩中，WARC-Agent 将 WARC 与一个固定的图探索器（graph explorer）配对，将该探索器的官方效率分数从 0.15 提升至 0.46，提高到三倍，这主要归功于测试时训练。在 Kaggle 排行榜的隐藏游戏上，我们的参赛方案得分为 0.20。

title: Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS variants. Averaged per scene, it accelerates alpha blending by up to 2.93x on a large-scale urban scene, and by up to 5.6x on its most imbalanced frames, while retaining the original alpha blending formulation.

AI.title_zh: 缓解 GPU 上 3D 高斯泼溅中 SM 级负载不均衡
AI.abstract_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）使商用 GPU 上能够实现照片级真实感的实时渲染，并日益被应用于生成式世界模型和自动驾驶模拟器中。然而，现有优化依赖于往往需要重新训练的算法改动，或依赖于在演进的 3DGS 变体之间缺乏灵活性的专用加速器。在本文中，我们识别出基于 GPU 的 3DGS 渲染中的一个根本性低效问题：由屏幕瓦片（tile）之间工作负载不均衡所导致的严重 SM 级负载不均衡。这种不均衡产生了较长的执行尾部，使大多数 SM 处于空闲状态，而少数 SM 却在处理计算密集型瓦片，这在大规模城市场景中尤为明显。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种软件定义的 GPU 调度方法，以缓解执行尾部。我们的方法使用持久化内核（persistent kernel）优先调度重型瓦片，并有选择地将离群瓦片跨多个 CTA 进行分块（chunk）。一个轻量级的逐帧策略利用渲染管线中已有的瓦片统计信息来决定何时分块以及分块的程度。我们的方法既不需要重新训练，也不需要专用硬件，并且可以与跨多种 3DGS 变体的现有优化正交地结合使用。按场景平均，它在大规模城市场景上将 alpha 混合加速至多 2.93 倍，在其最不均衡的帧上加速至多 5.6 倍，同时保留原始的 alpha 混合公式。

title: HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories. We only include items that pass five inclusion gates: question clarity, answer uniqueness, visual grounding, human solvability, and text-only shortcut filtering. According to the protocol, errors are defined as incorrect answers on human-validated visual tasks with the evaluated interface. The inclusion gates are intended to reduce confounds from ambiguity and external knowledge. The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs. No evaluated model exceeds 27.5% on Counting. These results identify capability gaps that are hidden by overall scores and can help future training experiments and held-out evaluation.

AI.title_zh: HumanSightBench：面向多模态大语言模型人类视觉感知的基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在知识密集型与基于推理的视觉-语言基准数据集上表现出强劲性能，但仍然难以解答人类可以轻松解决的视觉问题。由于端到端评估会组合多种能力，或者由于我们无法确定单个题目是否有效，评估 MLLMs 与人类水平视觉感知之间的差异颇具挑战性。具体而言，观察到的错误可能反映视觉感知、语言先验、背景知识、问题歧义以及答案未充分明确等因素。HumanSightBench 的构建准则是：我们构建在构造上对人类容易、在评估上对模型困难的题目。HumanSightBench 包含 2,876 个视觉问题，答案为简短形式，覆盖 7 个顶层感知类别和 21 个子类别。我们仅纳入通过五项纳入门槛（inclusion gates）的题目：问题清晰性、答案唯一性、视觉依据（visual grounding）、人类可解性以及纯文本捷径过滤。根据该协议，错误被定义为在经人类验证的视觉任务上、使用所评估的接口给出错误答案。这些纳入门槛旨在减少来自歧义与外部知识的混淆因素。在八个被评估的 MLLMs 中，最佳 pass@3 得分为 65.6%。在 Counting 上，没有受评估模型超过 27.5%。这些结果揭示了被总体得分所掩盖的能力差距，并可为未来的训练实验与留出评估提供帮助。

title: Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next
comment: 65 pages, 19 figures. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/nuskonghou/wm-ppo
summary: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.

AI.title_zh: 通过对后续结果的估值，借助世界模型学习行动
AI.abstract_zh: 稀疏的终端奖励几乎无法告诉智能体其每一步的好坏。大量缺失的信息隐含在环境的动态之中，因为每一次状态转移都可能在奖励到来之前很久就改变成功的条件。在真实转移上训练的世界模型可以学习预测每个动作所改变的内容，但一个预测出的观测本身并不能表明成功是否变得更有可能。在二值终端奖励下，PPO 的评论家（critic）通过估计当前策略的成功概率来做出这一判断，但只针对智能体实际到达的状态。我们的方法 WM-PPO 优雅地将二者结合起来。对于策略采样出的每个动作，无论是否被执行，世界模型都预测下一个观测，评论家则对预测出的后继状态进行估值。在策略通道中，这些估值之间的比较为策略提供辅助优势；在价值通道中，它们的均值为评论家提供辅助目标。一个共享门控根据训练早期中具有相似间隔的比较在多大程度上可靠地预测了真实结果，对两个通道进行加权。策略、评论家和世界模型都从智能体自身的交互中学习，无需教师或特权信息，且推理时只使用策略。在真实环境步数相当的情况下，WM-PPO 将 ALFWorld 上的成功率从 PPO 的 63.5% 提升到 87.5%，将 ScienceWorld 上的成功率从 39.3% 提升到 52.9%。在 ALFWorld 上，它与我们测试过的最强 PPO 改进方法相当；在 ScienceWorld 上，它比其中最好的方法高出 6.5 个百分点。训练后的策略更经常在放置物体或确定答案之前完成前置步骤。

title: GeoMind: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation has advanced rapidly in mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, reliable manipulation in open-world environments requires robust spatial understanding: the ability to identify targets in complex layouts (spatial reasoning) and adapt to scenes that continuously evolve through interaction (spatial memory). Yet existing embodied benchmarks fall short in evaluating spatial understanding: they often introduce strong visual cues that bypass spatial reasoning, and focus on static scenes that offer little insight into an agent's capacity for spatial memory. To address this gap, we introduce GeoMind, a systematic benchmark for structured spatial understanding through tabletop manipulation. GeoMind comprises 54 evaluated task variants organized around spatial reasoning and spatial memory. It also incorporates a scalable pipeline that automates the generation and annotation of task instances with verified targets and executable interactions. Extensive evaluations across diverse embodied agents reveal their consistent weaknesses in spatial understanding. Our findings highlight that these agents struggle to track identities after spatial changes and convert relational or geometric constraints into executable actions. We release the GeoMind benchmark at https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git.

AI.title_zh: GeoMind：面向机器人操作中空间理解的基准
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人操作在将视觉观测与语言指令映射为动作方面已取得快速进展。然而，在开放世界环境中实现可靠的操作需要稳健的空间理解：既包括在复杂布局中识别目标的能力（空间推理），也包括适应随交互不断演变的场景的能力（空间记忆）。然而，现有的具身基准在评估空间理解方面存在不足：它们往往引入强烈的视觉线索，从而绕过了空间推理，并且聚焦于静态场景，难以揭示智能体的空间记忆能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 GeoMind，一个通过桌面操作对结构化空间理解进行系统评估的基准。GeoMind 包含 54 个经过评估的任务变体，围绕空间推理与空间记忆组织。它还包含一个可扩展的流水线，能够自动生成并标注带有已验证目标与可执行交互的任务实例。对多种具身智能体的广泛评估揭示了它们在空间理解方面的一致弱点。我们的发现表明，这些智能体难以在空间变化后追踪对象身份，也难以将关系性或几何性约束转化为可执行的动作。我们在 https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git 发布了 GeoMind 基准。

title: DisasterVLG: Vision-Language Grounding and Evidence-Based Reasoning for Disaster Scene Understanding
summary: General-purpose vision-language models struggle with crisis imagery due to its inherent noise, ambiguity, and high variability across disaster events - yet timely, accurate scene understanding is critical for humanitarian response. To address this, we introduce DisasterVLG, a large-scale multi-task dataset containing 1.24 million disaster images from 142 countries paired with 33 million structured annotations spanning dense captioning with localization, incident assessment, relational scene descriptions, and crisis-grounded visual question answering (VQA) across diverse hazard types and scene contexts worldwide. Unlike prior disaster benchmarks that focus narrowly on classification, DisasterVLG unifies recognition, grounded reasoning, and uncertainty-aware interpretation. A distinguishing feature is its evidence-grounded annotation design: each VQA instance includes supporting evidence text that links visual observations to answers, alongside positive and negative question pairs, multiple answer formats, and difficulty labels. Visual grounding layer links caption phrases to image regions and relationship statements to subject-object boxes, with explicit labels for visual supports and clues. To support rigorous evaluation, we construct a human-verified test set of 38K images (1.15M annotations) spanning broad geographic regions and disaster types. Experiments with domain-adapted vision-language models demonstrate strong performance across disaster captioning, incident recognition, and grounded VQA, while also exposing the limitations of general-purpose models in crisis-specific reasoning. DisasterVLG establishes a scalable, reproducible benchmark for vision-language models that must reason reliably under real-world uncertainty. We will publicly release the dataset, trained models, and code.

AI.title_zh: DisasterVLG：面向灾害场景理解的视觉-语言定位与基于证据的推理
AI.abstract_zh: 通用视觉-语言模型难以处理危机影像，因为此类影像本身含有噪声、存在歧义，且在不同灾害事件之间具有高度变异性——然而，及时、准确的场景理解对于人道主义响应至关重要。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 DisasterVLG，这是一个大规模多任务数据集，包含来自 142 个国家的 124 万张灾害图像，并配对有 3300 万条结构化标注，涵盖带定位的密集描述（dense captioning with localization）、事件评估、关系性场景描述，以及危机场景下的视觉问答（VQA），覆盖全球多样的灾害类型与场景语境。与以往仅局限于分类的灾害基准不同，DisasterVLG 统一了识别、基于定位的推理（grounded reasoning）与不确定性感知的解释。其显著特点是基于证据的标注设计：每个 VQA 实例都包含将视觉观察与答案相联系的支撑证据文本，并配有正、负问题对、多种答案格式以及难度标签。视觉定位层将描述短语与图像区域相链接，将关系陈述与主体-客体边界框相链接，并对视觉支撑（visual supports）与线索（clues）给出显式标签。为支持严格评估，我们构建了一个经人工核验的测试集，包含 3.8 万张图像（115 万条标注），覆盖广泛的地理区域与灾害类型。针对领域适配的视觉-语言模型开展的实验表明，其在灾害描述、事件识别与基于定位的 VQA 上均表现强劲，同时也揭示了通用模型在危机特定推理方面的局限。DisasterVLG 为必须在真实世界不确定性下可靠推理的视觉-语言模型建立了一个可扩展、可复现的基准。我们将公开发布该数据集、训练好的模型与代码。

title: Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos
summary: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

AI.title_zh: Compass 1：面向开放世界的单目 RGB 视频持久具身导航
AI.abstract_zh: 具身导航要求智能体在开放世界环境中实现持久的空间感知与长时程执行的稳定性。然而，现有的导航架构难以同时维持这两种能力，仅在最近的少数帧上保持有效。我们提出 Compass 1，这是首个将语言理解与视频生成统一起来、并能够回溯近 2 分钟视觉历史记忆的具身导航基础模型。在不改变底层架构的前提下，我们引入历史表征（History Representation），它将稀疏的视觉关键帧与显式的历史表征图（History Representation Map）相结合，以保留长期的时空上下文。为有效利用这一历史，我们进一步引入历史利用（History Utilization），一种结构化的 VQA 监督协议，包含三类：（任务阶段定位）、探索一致性和时空目标检索，从而实现基于地图的推理与稳定的持久长时程导航。为支撑该系统，我们建立了一套面向单目 RGB 视频的完整标注流水线，并开源了一个大规模数据集，包含超过 500 小时的高质量真实世界交互数据和超过 2,000 小时的已标注网络视频。Compass 1 主要在 1m 高度相机的数据分布上训练，能够无缝泛化到多样的具身形态与场景，从室内环境到行人密集的街道，涵盖 0.35m 的轮式机器人、0.5m 的四足机器狗、0.85m 的人形机器人以及 1.5m 的空中无人机。Compass 1 在开放世界评测中取得了 79.4% 的总体成功率，占据主导地位，而最强基线为 17.8%。它在基础任务上展现出超过 90% 的卓越零样本执行能力，探索能力提升 250%，并在具有挑战性的持久历史回溯上实现了从 0% 到 58% 的无与伦比的飞跃。

title: MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate realistic videos, but their heavy computational cost limits broader real-world applications. Mixed-resolution generation reduces this cost by generating the visually important region at high resolution (HR) and the rest at low resolution (LR), yet existing methods suffer a severe quality drop on videos and require knowing the HR region in advance. We show that these failures are not inherent to mixed resolution, and propose $\textbf{MPEG-Diffusion}$ to address their three root causes: (1) dual-resolution attention to mitigate the curse of mixed resolution, where each query reads the K/V of its own resolution, (2) a mixed-resolution decoder to blend the HR and LR latents before decoding and resolve distortion, and (3) a self-selected HR region using the DiT's knowledge to find the visually important region without requiring it in advance. Processing only $30\%$ of full-resolution tokens, MPEG-Diffusion speeds up denoising by $4.8\times$ on Wan2.1 14B ($3.8\times$ on 1.3B), outperforming prior methods on nearly every metric. In the user study, we demonstrate the high quality of MPEG-Diffusion, with raters preferring it over prior mixed-resolution methods in over $90\%$ of pairs and rating it close to full resolution.

AI.title_zh: MPEG-Diffusion：混合分辨率视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）能够生成逼真的视频，但其沉重的计算开销限制了更广泛的实际应用。混合分辨率生成通过以高分辨率（HR）生成视觉上重要的区域、以低分辨率（LR）生成其余区域来降低这一开销，然而现有方法在视频上会出现严重的质量下降，并且需要预先知道HR区域。我们表明，这些失败并非混合分辨率所固有的，并提出$\textbf{MPEG-Diffusion}$来解决其三个根本原因：（1）双分辨率注意力，以缓解混合分辨率之弊，其中每个查询读取其自身分辨率的K/V；（2）混合分辨率解码器，在解码前融合HR与LR潜变量并消除失真；（3）利用DiT的知识自选HR区域，以在无需预先给定的情况下找到视觉上重要的区域。MPEG-Diffusion仅处理$30\%$的全分辨率token，在Wan2.1 14B上将去噪加速$4.8\times$（在1.3B上为$3.8\times$），在几乎所有指标上均优于先前方法。在用户研究中，我们展示了MPEG-Diffusion的高质量，评分者在超过$90\%$的成对比较中更偏好它而非先前的混合分辨率方法，并给出接近全分辨率的评分。

title: Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
summary: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.

AI.title_zh: 面向演化材料实验室中科学推理的语言模型与智能体基准评测
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型以及围绕其构建的多智能体系统，有望通过将科学知识与实验决策相连接来加速材料发现。现有基准确立了在领域知识、多模态解读和科学工具使用方面的能力。随着语言模型日益支撑材料研究工作流程，其区分密切相关的材料状态并依据定量证据进行准确推理的能力仍未得到充分评估。这些能力对于比较材料响应、评估机制以及在实验证据不断积累的过程中保持可靠判断至关重要。我们提出 MatScope，用以评估三项相互关联的能力。M1 通过涵盖十项研究功能的 200 项任务，测试无辅助的、特定条件下的推理，并以铝合金和高熵合金作为代表性材料体系。M2 测试智能体辅助下将相关知识迁移至尚未解决的材料问题。MatEvoBench-20 测试沿科学依赖链的初始预测，以及在观测不断积累时对仍处于隐藏状态的响应的修正。在包括 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.1 在内的十一种模型部署中，给定输入的计算和许多物理解释都处理良好。细粒度的响应估计、相似状态之间的比较以及有定量支持的抉择仍然明显较弱。相关文献改善了部分估计，但条件与基线的失配限制了迁移。逐步积累的观测会校准部分下游响应，同时也会使先前准确的预测变得不稳定。MatScope 为在未来自我演化的材料实验室和具有材料意识的世界模型中发展可靠的科学推理确立了可度量的目标。

title: An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models
summary: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.

AI.title_zh: 表格基础模型作为免训练世界模型的评估
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型被广泛认为是基于模型的强化学习和机器人规划的潜在关键组成部分，但通常需要在大量交互数据上进行任务特定的训练。我们研究预训练的表格基础模型（tabular foundation model, TabFM）能否通过将下一状态预测构建为对转移对的上下文内回归（in-context regression）来充当免训练的世界建模动力学模型，以及这种模型在何处有帮助、在何处失效。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准上，TabFM 在几乎所有设置中都比在相同的有限转移数据上从零训练的 LSTM 和 MLP 模型更准确；在拟合于相同数据的回归器中，它在运动任务上最准确，而高斯过程在平滑的低维系统上更准确。然而，在大多数系统上，用完整数据集训练的模型仍然明显更好。当进行多步自回归展开（rollout）时，TabFM 的准确率强烈依赖于其获得的上下文量。在短上下文下，其展开会迅速退化到平凡基线的水平；而在长上下文下，其表现显著提升，并在某一运动任务上超过了训练过的 LSTM。其推理速度也比 LSTM 慢约三个数量级。总体而言，在其当前状态下，我们发现免训练先验在数据稀缺且上下文充足时可作为有用的预测器，但它们尚不能替代规划中经过训练的世界模型。

title: LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting
summary: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose \textbf{LO-World}, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding $25$~FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World.

AI.title_zh: LO-World：面向联合4D占用与LiDAR预测的统一BEV隐空间建模
AI.abstract_zh: LiDAR点云与3D语义占用分别代表两种不同的模态，它们分别刻画细粒度的度量几何与稠密的体素语义，天然具有互补的潜力。然而，现有的世界模型通常独立地预测这两种模态，或以启发式方式将它们级联，从而错失了跨模态相互正则化的机会。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textbf{LO-World}，一个在共享BEV隐空间中同时预测这两种模态的统一4D世界模型。这种单流式建模使稠密语义与度量几何能够相互增强，同时消除了多流水线的冗余。具体而言，LO-World将高效混合的range-voxel自编码器与一个流匹配生成器相耦合，后者缓存历史上下文以降低迭代采样延迟。大量实验表明，LO-World优于先前的state-of-the-art基线，将占用预测IoU提升10.9%，并将LiDAR Chamfer Distance降低30.1%。同时，它在单张RTX 4090上保持着超过$25$~FPS的实时吞吐量。我们的代码可在https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World获取。

title: ShopMind: A Mental World Model for Personalized and Realistic E-commerce User Simulation
summary: Large language models are widely used in e-commerce user simulation, providing a foundation for understanding users and predicting human decisions. However, existing simulators still struggle to achieve both personalization and behavioral realism. Most methods predict the next action directly from interaction histories and the current context, without accounting for the evolving mental world that underlies user behavior. Theory of Mind suggests that behavior is driven by mental states, including beliefs, uncertainties, and intentions. Users may interpret the same information in distinct ways, leading to divergent behaviors, while an individual's mental state evolves through interaction and shapes subsequent actions. Ignoring this process prevents simulators from faithfully capturing individual differences and realistic behavior patterns, and undermines its effectiveness in downstream applications. To address this, we propose ShopMind, a Mental World Model for e-commerce user simulation that captures how consumers interpret shopping information and how their mental states evolve, better reflecting individual users and real-world behavior patterns. We further use behavior-mental state pairs synthesized by ShopMind to train a Mental State Reconstruction (MSR) model, which infers consumers' latent mental states from observable behavior. Experiments show that ShopMind improves personalization by 18.0% and behavioral realism by 19.6% over the strongest alternatives. Moreover, MSR improves performance on consumption value measurement and CTR prediction, showing the utility of ShopMind for understanding and predicting real user behavior.

AI.title_zh: ShopMind：面向个性化且真实电商用户模拟的心理世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被广泛用于电商用户模拟，为理解用户和预测人类决策提供了基础。然而，现有模拟器仍难以同时实现个性化与行为真实性。多数方法直接从交互历史和当前上下文预测下一动作，而未考虑支撑用户行为的、不断演化的心理世界（mental world）。心理理论（Theory of Mind）表明，行为由心理状态驱动，包括信念、不确定性和意图。用户可能以不同方式解读相同信息，从而导致行为分化；而个体的心理状态会通过交互而演化，并塑造后续动作。忽略这一过程会使模拟器无法忠实刻画个体差异与真实行为模式，并削弱其在下游应用中的有效性。为此，我们提出 ShopMind，一个用于电商用户模拟的心理世界模型，用以刻画消费者如何解读购物信息以及其心理状态如何演化，从而更好地反映个体用户与真实世界的行为模式。我们进一步利用 ShopMind 合成的行为—心理状态对（behavior-mental state pairs）训练心理状态重建（Mental State Reconstruction, MSR）模型，该模型从可观测行为推断消费者的潜在心理状态。实验表明，ShopMind 相比最强基线将个性化提升 18.0%，将行为真实性提升 19.6%。此外，MSR 在消费价值测量和 CTR 预测上均取得性能提升，显示出 ShopMind 在理解和预测真实用户行为方面的效用。

title: How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens
comment: 30 pages (12-page main text, appendices A-H). Code: https://github.com/thddydgnl/nearest-of-m-world-models
summary: One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

AI.title_zh: 一步式世界模型需要多少候选？冻结 DINO 令牌上 nearest-of-m 训练的随机码本解释
AI.abstract_zh: 一步式随机世界模型既能避免确定性特征预测器的模式平均（mode averaging），又无需扩散与流匹配每步所需的数十次网络评估。此类目标中最简单的是 nearest-of-m 匹配（条件隐式最大似然估计，IMLE）：抽取 m 个候选未来，只把其中最接近观测结果的那一个拉近。近期工作推测，对特征空间世界模型而言较小的 m 即已足够，并且应以严格恰当的能量得分（energy score）取代硬最小值。我们在冻结的 DINOv2/v3 图块（patch）令牌上，用一步式世界模型检验这两项主张，所用基准的未来可以枚举。在类模式（mode-like）不确定性下，m=16 的 nearest-of-m 比 50 步流匹配（延迟约为其 1/30）、参数量匹配的一步式流生成器和能量得分生成器更好地覆盖所枚举的未来，且其推演（rollout）保持在令牌流形上，而流推演则会漂移。有一个量支配着 m 的选择：nearest-of-m 目标就是从生成器抽取的 m 个样本所构成随机码本的期望失真。这一视角给出三项预测，且在相应实验运行之前即已记录：(i) 在永不重复的上下文中对已实现结果的记忆化，其强度由码本的未命中失真 I(m) 而非未命中概率决定，且能量得分生成器无法通过增大 m 来摆脱它；(ii) 模式概率随 m 增大而趋于平坦，与已知最优值的偏差在 0.01 以内；(iii) 在连续高维结果上出现分布过窄（under-dispersion），这限制了该方法在真实机器人视频上的应用。在随机 Push-T 变体上，对自身推演进行逐步匹配可将长时程误差削减三分之一；一项消融分离出其在流形与覆盖两方面的收益。尽管风险估计准确，规划成功率并未提升——我们报告这一负面结果并给出其诊断。

title: Action Representation for Spatial Generalization in Robot World Models
summary: Spatial generalization in robot world models depends on whether action representations capture the physical relationships that remain valid across changing spatial configurations. Yet different coordinates can describe the same interaction, whereas similar motions can produce different outcomes when local physical conditions change. How these distinctions affect learned prediction remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates matched action representations defined in world, object, and surface coordinate frames using a controlled robotic peeling benchmark. Global pose and contact relocation experiments reveal a cost associated with limited training data when equivalent interactions receive different spatial descriptions. Removing information about peel thickness creates an irreducible ambiguity because identical predictive inputs can correspond to different material removal outcomes. Coordinates defined relative to the surface improve consequence prediction and counterfactual action selection under accurate local observations, but learned predictors remain vulnerable to uncertainty in the coordinate frame. Joint centering of the surface and tool removes sensitivity to translation of their common origin, whereas incorrect contact geometry and actual execution deviations introduce different failure mechanisms. These results show that effective spatial generalization depends on preserving the relationships between actions and states that determine physical consequences, rather than simply minimizing coordinate variation. This perspective provides a principled basis for designing robot world models that reuse physical knowledge across spatial configurations while retaining the distinctions essential to prediction and planning.

AI.title_zh: 面向机器人世界模型中空间泛化的动作表示
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人世界模型中的空间泛化取决于动作表示能否捕捉在不同空间构型之间仍然有效的物理关系。然而，不同的坐标可以描述同一交互，而当局部物理条件改变时，相似的运动也可能产生不同的结果。这些区别如何影响学习到的预测，目前仍缺乏足够的理解。本研究使用一个受控的机器人剥离（peeling）基准，评估在世界、物体和表面坐标框架中定义的相匹配的动作表示。全局位姿与接触重定位实验揭示出：当等价的交互获得不同的空间描述时，会带来与训练数据有限相关的代价。移除关于剥离厚度的信息会造成本质性的歧义，因为相同的预测输入可能对应不同的材料去除结果。在局部观测准确的情况下，相对于表面定义的坐标能改善后果预测和反事实动作选择，但学习到的预测器仍然容易受到坐标框架不确定性的影响。将表面与工具联合居中可消除对其共同原点平移的敏感性，而错误的接触几何与实际执行偏差则会引入不同的失效机制。这些结果表明，有效的空间泛化取决于保留那些决定物理后果的动作与状态之间的关系，而非仅仅最小化坐标变化。这一视角为设计能够在不同空间构型之间复用物理知识、同时保留对预测与规划至关重要的区别的机器人世界模型提供了有原则的基础。

title: ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association
summary: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.

AI.title_zh: ACROSSVAM3.0：资源受限的4D场景构建与自适应表面关联
AI.abstract_zh: 将视频生成、动态重建与单目SLAM相结合，需要一致的坐标、对缺失输出的显式处理以及可预测的内存使用。我们提出AcrossVAM3.0，这是一个离线系统，可将文本、图像或单目RGB视频转换为带版本的点表示。冻结的组件在单个GPU上顺序运行；地图修正会同时更新相机、点和轨迹。协调层不添加任何神经参数。三次全新的输入模式运行完成，采样的任务进程树GPU占用峰值为17.14 GB。在一个冻结的16场景视频套件中，每个场景都产生了4D重建，其中15个产生了非空的SLAM地图。严格的跨窗口匹配降低了局部表面误差，但在TAP-Vid-DAVIS上损失了长程轨迹覆盖。因此我们开发了多假设自适应表面链接（MHAC），它保留多个候选匹配以及一个显式的缺失状态。在不相交的开发数据上完成选择后，MHAC在冻结的十个视频留出集上将Average Jaccard相较仅位置基线提高了0.1394（95% bootstrap区间[0.1074,0.1689]）。在265个RoboTAP视频上，平均配对增益为0.0610（[0.0510,0.0715]），其中215胜、1平、49负。这些结果支持资源受限的场景构建，以及在所测试协议下的外部跟踪增益。它们并未确立度量尺度、语义身份或高保真新视角渲染。

title: Planners Exploit Deterministic Error: Dithered Low-Bit World Models
summary: Sampling-based planners such as MPPI and CEM query a learned world model thousands of times per control step, so low-bit world models are an obvious way to make model-based control cheaper on a robot. With round-to-nearest activation quantization and no calibration, we find that planning can collapse, by up to 100 points of success, while the world model's latent one-step prediction error stays no larger than that of a stochastic rounding scheme that plans well. At the same bit width, what decides the outcome is not the size of the rounding error but whether it persists across planner iterations and is shared across candidates. Round-to-nearest leaves an error that persists, and an iterating planner drifts toward the candidates that this error favors; in TD-MPC2, holding the same dither fixed within a step or an episode brings the drift back. Dither shared by all candidates and redrawn at every iteration removes most of the damage at the same bit width and without training: at least half of it in all 19 affected Meta-World cells (task $\times$ bit width) of TD-MPC2 (median 95%), in 4 of 5 DINO-WM cells, and in all 8 affected tasks of a 317M-parameter multi-task TD-MPC2. Captured as CUDA graphs on an Ampere GPU, a W8A4 integer TD-MPC2 world model runs its planning rollouts 1.9-3.3$\times$ and the whole planning step 1.3-1.5$\times$ faster than FP32, though not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights; shared dither adds at most 2.3% latency. In TD-MPC2, block-scaled NVFP4 removes most of the damage and MXFP4 part of it, which ties the failure to coarse grids with a shared scale. Hypotheses, thresholds and analysis code were fixed before the data that test them, and the hypotheses that failed are reported.

AI.title_zh: 规划器利用确定性误差：抖动低比特世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 基于采样的规划器（如 MPPI 和 CEM）在每个控制步中要查询学习到的世界模型数千次，因此低比特世界模型显然是在机器人上降低基于模型控制成本的一种方式。在使用四舍五入（round-to-nearest）激活量化和不进行校准的情况下，我们发现规划可能崩溃，成功率下降多达 100 个百分点，而世界模型的潜空间一步预测误差并不大于一种能够良好规划的随机舍入方案。在相同比特宽度下，决定结果的因素不是舍入误差的大小，而是该误差是否在规划器迭代之间持续存在、以及是否在所有候选之间共享。四舍五入留下的误差会持续存在，而迭代式规划器会漂向该误差所偏好的候选；在 TD-MPC2 中，若在一个步内或一个回合内保持同一抖动固定不变，这种漂移便会重现。由所有候选共享、并在每次迭代时重新抽取的抖动，在相同比特宽度下且无需训练即可消除大部分损害：在 TD-MPC2 的全部 19 个受影响 Meta-World 单元（任务 $\times$ 比特宽度）中至少消除一半（中位数 95%），在 5 个 DINO-WM 单元中的 4 个中如此，在一个 317M 参数的多任务 TD-MPC2 的全部 8 个受影响任务中亦是如此。在 Ampere GPU 上以 CUDA graphs 捕获后，一个 W8A4 整数 TD-MPC2 世界模型的规划 rollout 运行速度比 FP32 快 1.9–3.3$\times$，整个规划步骤快 1.3–1.5$\times$，但并不比带有预转换权重的 BF16 更快；共享抖动至多增加 2.3% 的延迟。在 TD-MPC2 中，块缩放（block-scaled）NVFP4 消除了大部分损害，MXFP4 消除了其中一部分，这将该失败与具有共享尺度的粗粒度网格联系起来。假设、阈值和分析代码均在对检验它们的数据产生之前就已固定，且失败的假设也予以报告。

title: SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)
summary: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

AI.title_zh: SurgTAP-3D：一个具有接触感知三维运动跟踪的大规模跨手术视频数据集
AI.abstract_zh: 理解微创手术（MIS）中的三维场景动力学是迈向物理智能与自主手术系统的基础性一步。然而，现有的公开数据集在真实临床场景中的可扩展性和多样性有限。此外，标注通常仅聚焦于组织或器械中的一方，忽视了工具—组织交互。这一空白限制了诸如增强现实引导以及由视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型或世界模型驱动的自主手术等应用，而这些应用需要大规模、高质量的三维监督。在本工作中，我们构建了 SurgTAP-3D，一个大规模在体伪三维手术运动跟踪数据集与基准，包含来自多种机器人与手工操作流程的 520K 帧、4,549 个动作片段以及 1.4M 条二维/三维点轨迹，并采用统一的动作类别。为使标注具备可扩展性，我们设计了一个统一的手术三维点跟踪框架，通过接触区域提示、活动工具分割、动态光束法平差和全局四维精化，将未标定的单目手术视频转换为结构化的四维标注。该流程将基础先验适配到手术视频，并生成时间一致的轨迹、伪尺度几何、相机位姿和器械掩码。该数据集捕捉了手术环境固有的真实挑战，包括遮挡、烟雾、出血和器械快速运动。我们在 SurgPose、SurgT 和 STIR 上建立了一个全面的基准，涵盖器械跟踪和组织跟踪。我们展示了器械位移估计、可变形表面重建以及基础模型微调。大量实验与分析表明，我们的数据集与标注框架对三维手术点跟踪、重建和手术动作理解具有有效性。主页：https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

title: ScanDreamer: A Map-Grounded World Model for Quadrotor Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to AICAP 2027; decision pending
summary: Quadrotors inspecting buildings and tunnels must navigate unknown clutter with a forward-facing depth camera whose limited field of view constrains scene understanding and collision-avoiding navigation. Recent world-model agents learn navigation through imagined experience (e.g., AirDreamer), but remain data-intensive and often lack explicit geometric memory and awareness of what the camera can observe. We propose ScanDreamer, a map-grounded world model that constructs an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and vehicle pose. Our world model, actor, and critic are conditioned on this map, which also defines a geodesic progress reward. Moreover, a forward-cone penalty discourages horizontal motion outside the camera's viewing direction. During imagination, ScanDreamer propagates the quadrotor pose over a frozen map and derives progress and wall-contact signals from the mapped geometry. We train ScanDreamer for 0.8 million environment steps (5.5 h on one GPU) and evaluate it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim over 1560 episodes spanning unseen layouts and parameter ranges. Across three seeds (mean $\pm$ SD), ScanDreamer achieves 96.3 $\pm$ 0.3% success with 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3% collision, compared with 59.6 $\pm$ 3.0% success and 28.8 $\pm$ 2.8% collision for AirDreamer at the same online-interaction budget. Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 $\pm$ 3.1%. These results show that combining explicit map memory, map-grounded imagination, and perception-aware motion substantially improves navigation performance and data efficiency. The source code is available at https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer.

AI.title_zh: ScanDreamer：一种面向四旋翼导航的基于地图的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 用于巡检建筑和隧道的四旋翼必须借助前向深度相机在未知杂乱环境中导航，而该相机有限的视野限制了场景理解与避障导航。近期基于世界模型的智能体通过想象经验学习导航（例如 AirDreamer），但仍依赖大量数据，且往往缺乏显式的几何记忆以及对相机可观测范围的感知。我们提出 ScanDreamer，一种基于地图的世界模型，它根据深度图像和飞行器位姿构建在线二维扫描记忆地图。我们的世界模型、演员（actor）和评论家（critic）均以该地图为条件，该地图还定义了几何测地进度奖励。此外，前向锥惩罚（forward-cone penalty）抑制相机视线方向之外的水平运动。在想象过程中，ScanDreamer 在冻结的地图上传播四旋翼位姿，并从地图几何中导出进度信号与撞墙信号。我们训练 ScanDreamer 共 0.8 百万环境步（单块 GPU 上 5.5 小时），并在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中对跨越未见布局与参数范围的 1560 个回合进行评估。在三个随机种子下（均值 \(\pm\) 标准差），ScanDreamer 取得 96.3 \(\pm\) 0.3% 的成功率和 3.6 \(\pm\) 0.3% 的碰撞率，而在相同在线交互预算下，AirDreamer 的成功率为 59.6 \(\pm\) 3.0%，碰撞率为 28.8 \(\pm\) 2.8%。移除前向锥惩罚会使碰撞率上升至 9.9 \(\pm\) 3.1%。这些结果表明，将显式地图记忆、基于地图的想象以及感知感知的运动相结合，能够显著提升导航性能和数据效率。源代码见 https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer。

title: K-PWM: Control-Oriented Structured Bilinear World Models under Partial Observation
summary: World models learn internal simulators of environment dynamics for prediction, planning, and control, yet learning them from limited, noisy, and partial observations remains challenging. While much progress has focused on pixel-based observations, many physical systems instead provide vector-valued measurements that reveal only part of the underlying state. We introduce K-PWM, a probabilistic world model for prediction and control under partial observation. K-PWM couples Koopman-bilinear latent dynamics with a nonlinear observation decoder and performs probabilistic latent-state inference through the learned model via extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, without a separately trained inference network. Its bilinear structure enables exact propagation of the maintained Gaussian belief through the latent transition and efficient rollouts for uncertainty-aware model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. For training K-PWM, we present a generalized expectation conditional maximization (GECM) procedure with closed-form updates for the generators, noise covariances, and latent prior, complemented by gradient-based decoder learning. A Koopman-consistent initialization selects the latent dimension from data and initializes the action-dependent dynamics. With limited training data, K-PWM achieves lower long-horizon prediction error than the evaluated baselines on partially observed Gymnasium MuJoCo systems, while substantially reducing training time relative to the strongest prediction baseline. On high-dimensional MuJoCo Menagerie robots, it achieves competitive tracking accuracy with low per-step computation times, demonstrating potential for real-time deployment. These results support structured probabilistic dynamics as a data- and compute-efficient approach to world modeling and control under partial observation.

AI.title_zh: K-PWM：部分观测下面向控制的结构化双线性世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型学习环境动力学的内部模拟器，以用于预测、规划和控制，然而从有限、含噪且部分观测的数据中学习世界模型仍然具有挑战性。尽管许多进展集中于基于像素的观测，但许多物理系统提供的却是向量值测量，这些测量仅揭示底层状态的一部分。我们提出 K-PWM，一种用于部分观测下预测与控制的概率世界模型。K-PWM 将 Koopman 双线性潜动力学与非线性观测解码器相耦合，并通过扩展卡尔曼滤波与平滑在所学习的模型上进行概率潜状态推断，而无需单独训练的推断网络。其双线性结构使得所维护的高斯信念能够通过潜转移精确传播，并为不确定性感知的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制提供高效的 rollout。为训练 K-PWM，我们提出一种广义期望条件最大化（GECM）过程，对生成元、噪声协方差和潜先验给出闭式更新，并辅以基于梯度的解码器学习。一种 Koopman 一致的初始化方法从数据中选择潜维度，并初始化依赖动作的动力学。在有限的训练数据下，K-PWM 在部分观测的 Gymnasium MuJoCo 系统上取得了比所评估基线更低的长时程预测误差，同时相对于最强的预测基线大幅缩短了训练时间。在高维 MuJoCo Menagerie 机器人上，它以较低的每步计算时间取得了具有竞争力的跟踪精度，展示了实时部署的潜力。这些结果支持将结构化概率动力学作为部分观测下世界建模与控制的一种数据高效且计算高效的方法。

title: Breaking survivorship bias in driving world models
summary: World models allow autonomous vehicles to imagine the consequences of candidate actions before execution, but their reliability depends on the futures represented in their training data. We identify a survivorship bias in driving world models: because the futures recorded in prevailing driving datasets almost always end safely, existing models often imagine benign outcomes even when a collision is imminent. We introduce a neutral world model (NWM) that learns both routine and safety-critical futures from a mixture of routine driving and real accident videos with a bounding-box-guided objective. The NWM more faithfully anticipates imminent collisions, while maintaining a low false collision rate and competitive generation quality in routine driving. We further use the model as an imagination engine for decision-making. Given multiple ego trajectories, the NWM predicts the future associated with each candidate, and a reward function evaluates these imagined outcomes before selecting an action. On challenging NAVSIM scenarios, this procedure selects the better trajectory more reliably than the baseline world model. Zero-shot experiments with real-world pedestrian dummy crossing data collected using an autonomous research vehicle further demonstrate transfer to unseen sensor observations. These results show that correcting survivorship bias enables world models to more faithfully reason about futures and support safety-critical decision-making in autonomous driving.

AI.title_zh: 打破驾驶世界模型中的幸存者偏差
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型使自动驾驶车辆能够在执行候选动作之前设想其后果，但其可靠性取决于训练数据中所表征的未来。我们识别出驾驶世界模型中的一种幸存者偏差：由于主流驾驶数据集中记录的未来几乎总是以安全方式结束，现有模型即使在本应发生碰撞的情形下也常常设想出良性结果。我们提出一种中性世界模型（neutral world model, NWM），借助边界框引导的目标，从常规驾驶数据与真实事故视频的混合数据中学习常规未来与安全关键未来。NWM 能更忠实地预见即将发生的碰撞，同时在常规驾驶中保持较低的误碰撞率和具有竞争力的生成质量。我们进一步将该模型用作决策的想象引擎。给定多条自车轨迹，NWM 预测与每个候选轨迹相关的未来，奖励函数在选定动作之前评估这些想象出的结果。在具有挑战性的 NAVSIM 场景中，该流程比基线世界模型更可靠地选出更优轨迹。使用由自动驾驶研究车辆采集的真实世界行人假人横穿数据进行的零样本实验，进一步证明了向未见过传感器观测的迁移能力。这些结果表明，纠正幸存者偏差能够使世界模型更忠实地推理未来，并支持自动驾驶中安全关键的决策。

title: ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations
summary: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.

AI.title_zh: ForeAct：基于世界表示的几何引导动作学习
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人操作需要能够同时刻画场景几何及其在交互过程中演变的表示。现有方法在很大程度上将这两个方面分别处理。世界动作模型（world action models）通过将动作预测与未来视频生成相耦合来捕捉此类动态，但它们依赖迭代式扩散或整流流（rectified-flow）推理，导致计算成本高昂，且其表示缺乏显式空间结构。显式建模场景几何通常需要辅助模块，这既增加了参数量，也增加了计算成本。相反，以几何为中心的策略主要恢复观测到的空间结构，往往缺乏对交互过程中预期未来几何变化的显式监督。为解决这些局限，我们提出 ForeAct，它将预训练视频世界模型重新用作单次前向（single-pass）表示骨干，以实现低延迟控制。ForeAct 在一次前向传播中直接处理当前观测的干净潜在表示（clean latent），省去了未来帧合成与迭代去噪，同时保留了骨干网络预训练的时空先验。ForeAct 并未引入独立的几何骨干，而是使用由下一帧相对深度监督的可学习 token，通过双向自注意力塑造共享的视频表示。这一紧凑接口将骨干中已编码的空间知识转化为面向动作生成的、具备未来感知能力的表示，且参数开销很小。轻量级几何读出（geometry readout）仅在训练期间使用，并在部署时移除，从而无需深度输入或外部几何骨干即可实现低延迟、几何感知的控制。在无需额外大规模预训练的情况下，ForeAct 在 LIBERO 上取得 96.6% 的平均成功率，在 SimplerEnv-Bridge 上取得 63.5%，并在 90 次真实世界滚动测试（rollouts）中取得 74.4% 的成功率。

title: Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

AI.title_zh: 面向高效智能体自回归视频生成的语义对齐KV缓存压缩
AI.abstract_zh: 智能体自回归视频生成（agentic autoregressive video generation）结合语义规划、顺序生成与视觉验证以实现可控合成。不断增长的视觉历史会扩大键值（key-value, KV）缓存，从而增加在多个候选轨迹（candidate rollouts）中的内存占用与注意力开销。现有压缩方法主要针对单个生成器进行优化，而没有考虑规划器的语义约束，因而可能使支持所要求属性或动作的状态被赋予较低优先级。我们提出SemanticKV，一种无需训练的语义对齐KV缓存压缩方法。据我们所知，SemanticKV是首个针对智能体自回归视频生成、显式利用规划器提取的语义约束来指导保留的KV缓存压缩方法。文本交叉注意力用于识别与约束相关的视频位置，这些位置的自注意力查询被收集到各自独立的组中。注意力权重在每组内取平均，并在组间取最大值，从而使每个缓存条目在被任一有代表性的约束强烈使用时获得高分。在内存预算下通过一次top-k选择保留高分条目，其键、值与位置保持不变。在查询分组固定且各条目代价相等的条件下，该选择可最小化最差组被丢弃注意力上的一个加性上界。该方法在每个候选内部独立运行，无需重新训练或额外生成视频。我们在三个基准上针对5秒、30秒和60秒生成评估了四个自回归视频骨干网络。在Causal Forcing上，压缩比为0.7时，SemanticKV取得VBench总分84.10，而最强的压缩基线为84.05，完整KV（Full KV）为83.99。相比Full KV，它实现了1.22倍加速，并将KV缓存内存从6.04 GB降至1.81 GB，减少3.35倍。

title: How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 64 pages including appendices. Updated contact information. Project page: https://vitagent.github.io/
summary: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki and general-purpose visual grounding for surgical tasks. SurgAgentGym evaluates whether generalist agents can improve surgical understanding at inference time through tool-mediated evidence use, without additional surgical training. Our results show that agentic inference narrows the gap mainly for perception-heavy tasks, while fine-grained localization and expert-style assessment remain persistent bottlenecks. This opens a path toward future studies of agentic surgical understanding.

AI.title_zh: 如何"训练"一名外科医生？通用智能体在手术场景理解中的基准评测
AI.abstract_zh: 由于手术数据稀缺且评测协议碎片化，对用于手术场景理解的通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的评估仍然有限。我们通过一个两阶段的评估框架来应对这些挑战，以开展手术场景理解研究。在第一阶段，我们提出 SurgKnowBench，这是一个诊断性基准，它统一了跨不同术式和任务的公开手术数据集，并评估专有与开源 MLLMs，以刻画预训练手术能力的边界。SurgKnowBench 揭示，当前模型保留了部分视觉先验，但在关系性理解、过程性理解以及工作流评估方面仍然薄弱。基于这一失败边界，并受外科培训之支架式（scaffolded）特性的启发，我们提出 SurgAgentGym，这是一个智能体环境，通用 MLLM 智能体可在其中对 SurgWiki 进行有界知识搜索，并将通用视觉定位用于手术任务。SurgAgentGym 评估通用智能体能否在推理时通过工具中介的证据使用来提升手术理解，而无需额外的手术训练。我们的结果表明，智能体式推理主要缩小了感知密集型任务上的差距，而细粒度定位与专家式评估仍是持续存在的瓶颈。这为未来关于智能体式手术理解的研究开辟了一条路径。

title: GenRM-Flow: Generators are Process-aware Reward Models in Flow Matching
summary: Aligning video generation models with human preference depends critically on the quality of the reward model that scores generated videos. Current video reward models, however, source their reward signal from a model's representational rather than generative capacity: they either repurpose vision-language models as pixel-space scorers, or train auxiliary scoring heads on top of frozen generator features. The generator's actual ability to predict velocities, denoise latents, and produce videos plays no role in scoring its own generations. We argue that this overlooks a structural property of offline preference learning. Any preference optimization objective that approximates an offline preference dataset mathematically targets a strictly defined KL-constrained optimal policy. By isolating the reward term from this analytical solution and mapping the exact generation log-likelihood to its flow-matching surrogate, the empirical reward emerges deterministically as the relative difference in continuous-time velocity-prediction errors. We formalize this equivalence into GenRM-Flow, a framework where a preference-tuned video generator inherently operates as a process-aware reward model directly in the noisy latent space. We further show theoretically that distinct fine-tuning objectives, whether contrastive like DPO and IPO or non-contrastive like RWR, are alternative optimization pathways toward the same optimal policy, each inducing a reward readout from the generator's velocity-prediction errors. Furthermore, the extracted process reward seamlessly substitutes external VLM scorers in FlowAWR. Operating purely on native latent outputs without auxiliary reward networks, this generative reward drives measurable improvements in downstream video generation.

AI.title_zh: GenRM-Flow：在流匹配中生成器即过程感知奖励模型
AI.abstract_zh: 将视频生成模型与人类偏好对齐，关键取决于对生成视频进行评分的奖励模型的质量。然而，当前的视频奖励模型从模型的表征能力而非生成能力中获取奖励信号：它们要么将视觉语言模型改用作像素空间的评分器，要么在冻结的生成器特征之上训练辅助评分头。生成器在预测速度、对潜变量去噪以及生成视频方面的实际能力，在其对自身生成结果的评分中并不发挥作用。我们认为，这忽视了离线偏好学习的一个结构性属性。任何近似离线偏好数据集的偏好优化目标，在数学上都指向一个严格定义的 KL 约束最优策略。通过从该解析解中分离出奖励项，并将精确的生成对数似然映射到其流匹配替代形式，经验奖励便确定性地呈现为连续时间速度预测误差的相对差异。我们将这一等价性形式化为 GenRM-Flow，这是一个使经偏好微调的视频生成器直接在含噪潜空间中充当过程感知奖励模型的框架。我们进一步从理论上表明，不同的微调目标——无论是 DPO 和 IPO 这类对比式目标，还是 RWR 这类非对比式目标——都是通向同一最优策略的替代优化路径，各自从生成器的速度预测误差中导出一个奖励读数。此外，所提取的过程奖励可无缝替代 FlowAWR 中的外部 VLM 评分器。该方法完全基于原生潜变量输出运行，无需辅助奖励网络，这种生成式奖励在下游视频生成中带来了可测量的提升。

title: Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines
summary: Spatial reasoning requires understanding how objects and observers are arranged in a scene and how their relations change with viewpoint or movement. Vision-language models (VLMs) typically perform both steps through model-internal reasoning, forming an implicit scene interpretation from partial views and imagining the consequences of spatial transformations. A misread scene can lead to a wrong answer, while even a correct interpretation does not ensure that imagined transformations satisfy spatial constraints. We introduce Spatial Harness, which represents scenes as explicit and executable world states to ground spatial reasoning in physics-engine feedback. A Perceiver integrates scene constraints extracted from the question with specialized visual estimates to place objects and cameras in a shared coordinate frame. The resulting state is instantiated in a physics engine, where a Reasoner executes viewpoint changes and uses computed measurements and rendered views to guide reasoning. We evaluate on MindCube, SAT, MMSI-Bench, and SpatialRGPT-Bench with open- and closed-weight VLMs. On MindCube, Spatial Harness improves Qwen3.5-27B from 52.70% to 71.14%, surpassing pySpatial by 7.52 percentage points. Given identical annotated object and camera poses, it reaches 98.25% versus 71.81% for model-internal reasoning. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tmlr-group/Spatial-Harness

AI.title_zh: 空间具架：以物理引擎将空间推理锚定于可执行世界状态
AI.abstract_zh: 空间推理需要理解场景中物体与观察者如何排布，以及它们之间的关系如何随视角或移动而变化。视觉语言模型（VLM）通常通过模型内部推理来完成这两个步骤，即从部分视角形成隐式的场景解释，并想象空间变换的后果。场景误读可能导致错误答案，而即便解释正确，也不能保证所想象的变换满足空间约束。我们提出空间具架（Spatial Harness），它将场景表示为显式且可执行的世界状态，从而以物理引擎反馈为空间推理提供依据。一个感知器（Perceiver）将从问题中提取的场景约束与专门的视觉估计相结合，将物体和相机置于共享坐标系中。由此得到的状态被实例化到物理引擎中，由推理器（Reasoner）执行视角变化，并利用计算得到的测量值和渲染视图来引导推理。我们在 MindCube、SAT、MMSI-Bench 和 SpatialRGPT-Bench 上使用开放权重与闭源权重的 VLM 进行评估。在 MindCube 上，Spatial Harness 将 Qwen3.5-27B 从 52.70% 提升至 71.14%，超过 pySpatial 7.52 个百分点。在给定相同的标注物体与相机位姿的情况下，它达到 98.25%，而模型内部推理为 71.81%。代码公开于：https://github.com/tmlr-group/Spatial-Harness

title: MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues
summary: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.

AI.title_zh: MoT3DVG：面向室外三维视觉定位的运动感知描述与时间线索基准
AI.abstract_zh: 三维视觉定位（3DVG）在三维场景中定位由语言指称的对象，在室内与室外环境中均有广泛适用性。然而，现有3DVG研究集中于静态室内对象，限制了其在动态室外自动驾驶中的应用。运动描述能够刻画运动对象的时间动态，为解决该挑战提供了有前景的途径。因此，我们提出MoT3DVG，一个面向动态感知室外3DVG的大规模数据集，包含随时间演化的运动描述。该数据集包含来自nuScenes数据集的850个场景、31,128帧，并提供144,568条语言提示，这些提示含有针对动态对象随时间变化的运动感知描述。我们进一步提出DynaVG，一个新颖的框架，能够有效利用时间线索进行室外3DVG。除标准的模态特定编码器外，DynaVG在语言—点云对齐之前引入短长融合动态编码（Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding, SLIDE）模块。SLIDE通过短期窗口编码与长期窗口移位，同时对局部运动线索和全局时间上下文进行建模。大量实验表明，该框架在MoT3DVG上取得了最先进的性能，验证了运动感知编码的有效性。我们的工作揭示了室外3DVG未来研究中的开放挑战与有前景的方向。

title: TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors
summary: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation.
