Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.

AI.title_zh: TransArt3D：从两个状态到借助视频过渡先验的铰接式3D重建
AI.abstract_zh: 从少量图像重建可交互的铰接式资产是机器人学与仿真领域的关键问题，但该问题高度欠约束。现有的基于优化的方法在静态3D先验下拟合铰接式资产，该先验独立地对每个状态打分，因此各状态的逐状态重建误差会泄漏到所估计的运动部件与关节中，形成虚假运动。视频扩散模型能够捕捉物体在状态之间的运动方式，但仅以隐式方式体现在2D中。为此，我们提出TransArt3D，这是一个基于优化的框架，它通过将这种视频过渡先验转化为显式的部件结构与关节运动学，从两张端点图像重建铰接式3D资产。该方法首先利用一种过渡耦合的3D共识（transition-coupled 3D consensus）提升在端点之间生成的帧，该共识跨帧联合地施加静态3D先验，从而稳定不变区域并初始化部件与关节。随后，一种整流流运动学细化（rectified-flow kinematic refinement）让视频先验在整个过渡过程中监督3D运动场，而部件分配与共享关节在优化全程约束该运动场，从而使逐状态误差不会进入铰接结构。最后，一种运动感知的规范外观融合（motion-aware canonical appearance fusion）利用恢复出的铰接结构将两张端点图像映射到同一个规范表面上，为仅由其中一个状态所显露的区域添加纹理。在PartNet-Mobility上，TransArt3D在几何与关节精度方面优于给定相同两张端点图像的方法，并且在铰接状态几何、关节定位与外观方面超过了给定六个观测状态的方法。

title: DynOLAT: OLAT Video Prediction for Controllable Dynamic Full-Body Relighting
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Journal Track). Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/DynOLAT
summary: Accurate lighting response is essential for realistic dynamic human relighting, because shadows, highlights, and color changes should follow the target illumination in both direction and relative strength. Current learning-based relighting methods can generate visually plausible videos, but they often exhibit imprecise lighting responses: shadows and highlights may drift away from the target direction, and the output brightness may not faithfully follow the relative intensities in the target environment, making the result closer to appearance harmonization than controllable relighting. To address this issue, we propose DynOLAT, a generalizable OLAT video prediction framework for dynamic full-body humans. Instead of directly synthesizing a single relit appearance, our method predicts temporally consistent One-Light-At-a-Time (OLAT) basis videos from flat-lit inputs, and then linearly combines the predicted bases according to the target environment map. This OLAT-based formulation makes the directional response explicit in the predicted bases, while the relative lighting strength is determined by the linear weights derived from the environment map. We further introduce a dynamic capture pipeline and the first large-scale dynamic full-body OLAT dataset, comprising over 24 million frames from 224 identity-outfit combinations, where different outfits of the same person define separate combinations. Experiments show that DynOLAT responds more faithfully to variations in target lighting direction and relative intensity than the tested baselines, enabling controllable video relighting while preserving fine appearance details and temporal coherence. The dataset and processing tools will be publicly released to foster future research.

AI.title_zh: DynOLAT：用于可控动态全身重光照的 OLAT 视频预测
AI.abstract_zh: 准确的光照响应对于逼真的动态人体重光照（relighting）至关重要，因为阴影、高光和颜色变化应当在方向和相对强度上都跟随目标光照。当前基于学习的重光照方法能够生成视觉上合理的视频，但往往表现出不精确的光照响应：阴影和高光可能偏离目标方向，输出亮度也可能无法忠实跟随目标环境中的相对强度，使得结果更接近于外观协调（appearance harmonization）而非可控重光照。为解决这一问题，我们提出 DynOLAT，一个面向动态全身人体的可泛化 OLAT 视频预测框架。我们的方法并不直接合成单一的重光照外观，而是从平光（flat-lit）输入中预测时间一致的单光源（One-Light-At-a-Time, OLAT）基视频，然后根据目标环境贴图（environment map）对预测得到的基进行线性组合。这种基于 OLAT 的表述使方向响应显式体现在预测的基中，而相对光照强度则由从环境贴图导出的线性权重决定。我们进一步提出了一套动态采集流程以及首个大规模动态全身 OLAT 数据集，包含来自 224 个身份-服装组合的超过 2400 万帧，其中同一人的不同服装被定义为不同的组合。实验表明，与所测试的基线方法相比，DynOLAT 对目标光照方向和相对强度的变化响应得更加忠实，在保留精细外观细节和时间连贯性的同时实现了可控的视频重光照。该数据集和处理工具将被公开发布，以促进未来研究。

title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest baseline. Project page https://dexforesight.github.io/

AI.title_zh: DexForesight：以隐式空间预见为灵巧策略奠定基础
AI.abstract_zh: 灵巧操作需要对周围场景和机器人手部具有丰富的空间预见能力。现有的世界-动作模型通常通过显式的未来预测来获取这类预测性知识。我们提出 DexForesight，这是一个通过将动态感知的世界表征注入灵巧策略的隐空间来隐式学习空间预见的框架。在训练过程中，DexForesight 从离线场景深度、运动学手部几何以及演示轨迹中学习一个以动作为条件的空间世界模型。该世界模型预测三维手部点运动与视觉特征变化，捕捉演示动作下的关节式手部动态与场景变化，包括摄像机视野中被遮挡的手指的运动。随后我们冻结该世界模型，并将策略查询与其预测性世界查询对齐，从而把学到的空间动态迁移到策略隐变量中，并用其来条件化动作生成。在部署时，仅保留策略，其基于 RGB 观测、语言和机器人状态运行，无需深度输入或显式的未来预测。在 11 个 DexJoCo 仿真任务上，DexForesight 将基础策略的总体成功率从 49.4% 提升至 60.5%。在三个真实机器人灵巧操作任务上，DexForesight 取得了 58.3% 的成功率，而最强基线为 50.0%。项目页面 https://dexforesight.github.io/

title: SurgWorld: Learning Surgical Representations Beyond Observation via Latent Prediction
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Surgical procedures are inherently partially observable, requiring surgeons to continuously infer evolving anatomical dynamics and future surgical states beyond the current observation. However, existing self-supervised learning methods primarily learn from observed surgical videos through masked reconstruction or predicting representations within the camera's current field of view, lacking the capability to explicitly model the out-of-sight surgical dynamics. Inspired by latent predictive world models, we introduce SurgWorld, a video-native, self-supervised framework for surgical representation learning, which treats a specified spatial or temporal shift as a pseudo-action and learns to predict the target latent representation from a partial observation. Specifically, we propose Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling (OSDM) as the pretraining objective for predicting representations conditioned on relative spatio-temporal shifts. We further regularize the learned latent dynamics from OSDM with a Geometric Visual Similarity (GVS) objective by aligning patch-level relational structures between predicted and target representations, preserving spatial geometry and local visual coherence for dense perception. These two objectives are integrated through an agglomerative training framework that consolidates complementary supervisory signals from multiple teachers to learn a unified latent representation of surgical dynamics and visual geometry. Extensive transfer learning experiments on 17 surgical benchmarks show that SurgWorld consistently outperforms existing vision foundation models across surgical workflow recognition, fine-grained action understanding, and dense visual perception. We further conduct tailored qualitative and quantitative analyses, demonstrating that SurgWorld effectively captures surgical dynamics beyond the directly observed context through latent prediction.

AI.title_zh: SurgWorld：通过潜在预测学习超越观测的手术表征
AI.abstract_zh: 外科手术过程本质上是部分可观测的，要求外科医生不断推断超越当前观测的、不断演变的解剖动态与未来手术状态。然而，现有的自监督学习方法主要通过掩码重建或在相机当前视野内预测表征，从所观测到的手术视频中学习，缺乏显式建模视野外手术动态的能力。受潜在预测世界模型（latent predictive world models）的启发，我们提出 SurgWorld，一个视频原生的、用于手术表征学习的自监督框架，它将指定的空间或时间偏移视为伪动作（pseudo-action），并学习从部分观测中预测目标潜在表征。具体而言，我们提出视野外动态建模（Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling, OSDM）作为预训练目标，用于在以相对时空偏移为条件的情况下预测表征。我们进一步通过几何视觉相似性（Geometric Visual Similarity, GVS）目标对 OSDM 所学到的潜在动态加以正则化，即在预测表征与目标表征之间对齐块级（patch-level）关系结构，从而为密集感知保留空间几何与局部视觉连贯性。这两个目标通过一个凝聚式训练框架（agglomerative training framework）整合，该框架汇集来自多个教师模型的互补监督信号，以学习手术动态与视觉几何的统一潜在表征。在 17 个手术基准上的大量迁移学习实验表明，SurgWorld 在手术流程识别、细粒度动作理解和密集视觉感知方面均持续优于现有的视觉基础模型。我们还开展了针对性的定性与定量分析，证明 SurgWorld 通过潜在预测有效捕捉了超越直接观测情境的手术动态。

title: SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables
summary: We present SoftPAT3D, a physics-augmented framework for text-to-3D scene generation in which deformable objects, such as cloth, stuffed toys and ropes, are generated as physically valid, simulation-ready bodies and placed in intersection-free contact with the furniture that supports them, with one another and with themselves. Existing physics-augmented pipelines simulate rigid bodies only and cannot accommodate a generated deformable object, which text-to-3D generation returns as a geometrically invalid mesh, sometimes self-intersecting, that has no rest shape, no material model and no admissible initial state. These are the inputs a deformable simulation requires, and we construct each from information already in the pipeline. The rest shape comes from how the object is manufactured rather than from the generated physically inconsistent deformed configuration, and a material library assigns each deformable object its initial elastic parameters, which can then be optimized. The occluded support is regenerated and converted into a watertight collision mesh, each object is released from an optimizable placement above the supporting part that the prompt specifies, and the complete scene is driven to static equilibrium under one unified contact model, with completion verified by geometric checks and a vision-language model. When a scene fails the prompt, a grid search over placements corrects it, and the adjoint of a differentiable simulation of the same contact energy reaches the targets the grid does not, places several bodies jointly and recovers and optimizes material parameters. Multi-body scenes equilibrate in a single simulation, and the pipeline also runs from the text prompt alone. On all sixty-five prompts, SoftPAT3D produces no undesired interpenetration of any kind, whereas every other system does, and its scenes directly support scene editing and robotic manipulation.

AI.title_zh: SoftPAT3D：基于物理增强的可变形物体文本到三维场景生成
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 SoftPAT3D，一个用于文本到三维场景生成的物理增强框架，其中可变形物体（如布料、毛绒玩具和绳索）被生成为物理有效、可直接用于仿真的实体，并与支撑它们的家具、彼此之间以及自身之间保持无交叠的接触。现有的物理增强流程仅仿真刚体，无法容纳生成的可变形物体——文本到三维生成所返回的是几何上无效的网格，有时存在自相交，既没有静止形状（rest shape），也没有材料模型，也没有可容许的初始状态。而这些正是可变形仿真所需的输入，我们利用流程中已有的信息来逐一构造它们。静止形状来自物体的制造方式，而非来自生成所得的物理上不一致的变形构型；材料库为每个可变形物体赋予初始弹性参数，随后可对这些参数进行优化。被遮挡的支撑体被重新生成并转换为水密碰撞网格，每个物体从提示词所指定的支撑部件上方一个可优化的放置位置释放，整个场景在一个统一的接触模型下被驱动至静态平衡，并通过几何检查与视觉语言模型验证完成情况。当场景不符合提示词时，通过对放置位置的网格搜索进行修正；而同一接触能量所对应的可微仿真的伴随方法能够达到网格搜索达不到的目标，联合放置多个物体，并恢复和优化材料参数。多物体场景在单次仿真中达到平衡，且该流程也可以仅从文本提示词运行。在全部六十五个提示词上，SoftPAT3D 不产生任何形式的不期望互穿，而其他所有系统都会产生；其场景可直接支持场景编辑与机器人操作。

title: ObjectWorld: Scaling Object-Centric World Models with A Large-Scale 3D Full-Object Flow Dataset
summary: Generative world modeling from large-scale visual data offers a promising path toward scalable robot manipulation. This calls for an intermediate representation that can be supervised at scale and remains actionable for downstream control. We propose 3D full-object flow, an object-centric motion representation that assigns dense 3D trajectories to points across the complete surface of a target object, including its occluded regions. By extending visible-surface object flow to the full object geometry, this representation makes complete object motion explicit and applies uniformly to both rigid and deformable objects. To realize the potential of this representation at scale, we introduce a 1210-hour full-object flow dataset that addresses the scarcity of large-scale supervision for complete 3D object motion. The dataset integrates diverse real-world videos and physical simulations, with a scalable annotation pipeline for recovering full-object motion from real-world observations and quality metrics for systematically assessing annotation quality. We then train a world model that takes an image and a task description as input and predicts dense full-object flow over the reconstructed object geometry. Experiments show reliable annotation quality, data-scalable flow prediction, and effective downstream manipulation across novel scenes and robot embodiments. Project website with additional results and videos: https://nus-lins-lab.github.io/ObjectWorld/.

AI.title_zh: ObjectWorld：以大规模三维全物体流数据集扩展以物体为中心的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 基于大规模视觉数据的生成式世界建模为可扩展的机器人操作提供了一条有前景的路径。这需要一种能够在规模化条件下获得监督、并且对下游控制仍然具备可操作性的中间表示。我们提出三维全物体流（3D full-object flow），这是一种以物体为中心的运动表示，为目标物体完整表面（包括其被遮挡区域）上的点赋予稠密的三维轨迹。通过将可见表面物体流扩展到完整的物体几何结构，该表示使完整的物体运动显式化，并统一适用于刚体与可变形物体。为在规模化条件下实现该表示的潜力，我们引入了一个时长 1210 小时的全物体流数据集，以缓解完整三维物体运动大规模监督数据的稀缺。该数据集整合了多样化的真实世界视频与物理仿真，并配有可扩展的标注流水线，用于从真实世界观测中恢复全物体运动，以及用于系统性评估标注质量的质量指标。随后，我们训练了一个世界模型，该模型以图像和任务描述为输入，在重建的物体几何结构上预测稠密的全物体流。实验表明标注质量可靠、流预测具有数据可扩展性，并且在新颖场景与不同机器人本体上能够实现有效的下游操作。包含额外结果与视频的项目网站：https://nus-lins-lab.github.io/ObjectWorld/。

title: Advancements in Cloud-Native Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study of Reliability and Scalability across Cloud-Native, Edge-Native and AI-Enabled Systems
summary: Cloud-native systems now extend to the network edge and host artificial-intelligence (AI) workloads, including AI agents, but evidence on their reliability and scalability is scattered and uneven. We report a PRISMA 2020 systematic mapping study with an evidence-graded synthesis. Five logged OpenAlex searches on 11 October 2026 covered cloud-native systems, edge AI, agentic AI for operations, reliability of agentic applications and physical AI; 189 records from an earlier exploratory search were added separately. After 301 duplicate removals and an automated peer-review venue rule, 4,611 records were screened against written criteria and a five-level relevance scale. The review includes 1,794 primary studies from 2017-2026 and 95 secondary studies, with every decision released in Dataset S1. Each primary study was assigned to a 13-category taxonomy and graded as simulation, prototype or testbed, production data, production deployment, or not determinable from the abstract. Of 1,003 studies with a determinable level, 66.2% used prototypes or testbeds, 18.0% simulations and 15.8% production data or deployments. A 93-study synthesis core, appraised from indexed abstracts, shows production deployments of cascading-failure prevention, trace- and graph-based root-cause analysis and predictive autoscaling, and production-trace evaluations of cold-start mitigation. Edge reliability and physical AI rely mainly on simulations and testbeds. AI-agent reliability uses tool-grounded diagnosis, explicit safety properties, trace-driven repair and workload-aware scheduling, while empirical studies show that agent frameworks remain fragile. Conclusions are limited to the documented corpus. The principal gaps are production evidence for edge-native systems, shared resilience benchmarks and dependable agentic operations.

AI.title_zh: 云原生系统的进展：跨云原生、边缘原生与AI赋能系统的可靠性与可扩展性系统性映射研究
AI.abstract_zh: 云原生系统如今已延伸至网络边缘，并承载人工智能（AI）工作负载（包括AI智能体），但关于其可靠性与可扩展性的证据分散且不均衡。我们报告一项遵循PRISMA 2020的系统性映射研究，并附带按证据分级的综合。2026年10月11日进行的五次已记录的OpenAlex检索涵盖云原生系统、边缘AI、用于运维的智能体式AI、智能体应用的可靠性以及物理AI；来自早先探索性检索的189条记录被单独加入。在去除301条重复记录并应用自动化同行评审发表场所规则后，依据书面标准与五级相关性量表对4,611条记录进行了筛选。本综述纳入2017—2026年的1,794项原始研究和95项二次研究，所有判定均在Dataset S1中公开。每项原始研究被归入一个13类分类法，并被分级为模拟、原型或测试床、生产数据、生产部署，或无法从摘要中确定。在1,003项可确定等级的研究中，66.2%使用原型或测试床，18.0%使用模拟，15.8%使用生产数据或部署。一个由93项研究组成的综合核心（依据索引摘要进行评估）显示了级联故障预防、基于追踪与图的根因分析以及预测性自动扩缩容的生产部署，以及针对冷启动缓解的基于生产追踪的评估。边缘可靠性与物理AI主要依赖模拟与测试床。AI智能体可靠性采用基于工具的接地诊断、显式安全属性、追踪驱动的修复以及工作负载感知调度，而实证研究表明智能体框架仍然脆弱。结论仅限于所记录的文献集。主要空白在于边缘原生系统的生产证据、共享的韧性基准以及可靠的智能体式运维。

title: WARP-JEPA: World-Model-in-the-Loop Amortized Rollout Planning for Frozen Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
summary: Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (H-JEPA) enable long-horizon visual control but rely on costly test-time gradient descent for planning. Our analysis reveals that iterative optimization consumes up to 97.7% of episode runtime and that low predicted rollout costs do not necessarily translate into successful control. We further identify a planning-horizon asymmetry between long-horizon top-level composition and short two-step subordinate planning. To address these challenges, we propose WARP-JEPA, a hierarchical amortized planning framework that replaces online gradient optimization with learned multi-candidate trajectory proposers while keeping the world models frozen. WARP-JEPA combines a lightweight world-model-in-the-loop causal Transformer at the top level with parallel residual MLPs at subordinate levels. The proposers are trained using model-based rollout costs and best-of-K behavior cloning, enabling efficient candidate selection without test-time gradient optimization. Across 30 frozen H-JEPA models on four benchmarks, WARP-JEPA achieves 9.6-18.8x faster episode inference on long-horizon tasks (2.9-3.0x on Cube) and improves task success by up to 33.3 percentage points. These results demonstrate that amortized planning can substantially improve both inference efficiency and control performance without retraining the world models. Code is available at https://github.com/hideinsewer/WARP-JEPA.

AI.title_zh: WARP-JEPA：面向冻结分层联合嵌入预测架构的世界模型在环路摊销式推演规划
AI.abstract_zh: 分层联合嵌入预测架构（Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures，H-JEPA）能够实现长时程视觉控制，但依赖代价高昂的测试时梯度下降来进行规划。我们的分析表明，迭代优化最多消耗了每个回合运行时长的 97.7%，并且较低的预测推演代价并不必然转化为成功的控制。我们进一步识别出长时程顶层组合与短两步下层规划之间的规划时域不对称性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 WARP-JEPA，一个分层摊销式规划框架，它以学习到的多候选轨迹提议器替代在线梯度优化，同时保持世界模型冻结。WARP-JEPA 在顶层结合一个轻量级的世界模型在环路因果 Transformer，在下层各级结合并行的残差 MLP。这些提议器使用基于模型的推演代价和 best-of-K 行为克隆进行训练，从而无需测试时梯度优化即可实现高效的候选选择。在四个基准上的 30 个冻结 H-JEPA 模型上，WARP-JEPA 在长时程任务上实现了 9.6-18.8 倍的回合推理加速（在 Cube 上为 2.9-3.0 倍），并将任务成功率最多提升 33.3 个百分点。这些结果表明，摊销式规划能够在不重新训练世界模型的情况下显著提升推理效率和控制性能。代码见 https://github.com/hideinsewer/WARP-JEPA。

title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
comment: 39 pages, 10 figures. This technical report will be updated periodically
summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

AI.title_zh: WorldFoundry：迈向世界智能的统一基础设施
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉生成模型日益模糊了合成观测与模拟环境之间的界限。然而，仅凭视觉上的合理性并不能构成成功的世界建模：令人信服的输出可能缺乏持久状态、物理动力学，或对交互的因果一致响应。我们将生成式世界模型定义为一个预测性动力系统，它维护环境的持久且以历史为条件的表示，在响应动作或干预时更新该表示，并生成时间上连贯的轨迹，以反映在观测干预与反事实干预下的结果。基于这一定义，我们推导出一个面向智能的框架，涵盖感知基础（perceptual grounding）、持久状态建模、可控变换、动力学感知预测以及闭环交互。我们提出 WorldFoundry，这是一个开源基础设施，用于跨视频、3D 与 4D、具身动作以及交互式世界系统的可复现推理与评估。WorldFoundry 统一了模型与基准发现、运行时与资产准备、执行编排、产物管理以及交互式可视化，同时模态特定的适配器保留原生输入、执行语义、输出表示与评估协议。显式清单（manifests）、持久产物契约（durable artifact contracts）以及证据感知评分卡（evidence-aware scorecards）将执行就绪性与评估性主张区分开来，使每项主张都可追溯至其支撑产物。该目录包含 270 个模型条目、74 个基准以及 62 个注册指标条目，其中就绪性证据与执行证据分别记录。WorldFoundry 使得跨异构系统对持久、可控动力学的可复现比较成为可能，推动该领域从感知合成迈向可度量的世界智能。

title: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, including references, appendix, and checklist. Project page: https://sensetime-fvg.github.io/BlenderFORGE/
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents, yet precise, programmatic 3D graphics editing remains difficult to train because existing systems largely rely on closed-source model APIs and lack deterministic, state-verifiable execution environments. We present BlenderFORGE, a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit explicit Blender scenes through Blender Python (bpy) code generation. BlenderFORGE targets four fundamental state-verifiable editing task families: object placement, shape-key editing, lighting adjustment, and material modification. It integrates three components: (1) a scalable perturbation-based data generation pipeline built from curated assets and large-scale 3D scene repositories; (2) an isolated Blender Sandbox for deterministic code execution, structured state export, and closed-loop reward computation; and (3) a two-stage training pipeline that uses offline teacher trajectories for cold-start Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and sandbox-computed rewards for multi-turn tool-agentic Reinforcement Learning (AgentLoop-RL). Experiments across the four task families show that the resulting open-weight Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE agents substantially improve over their base models and achieve competitive performance with several zero-shot proprietary MLLM baselines on selected metrics. Additional cross-benchmark evaluations and camera-reframing experiments provide evidence of transfer beyond the original training setting.

AI.title_zh: BlenderFORGE：面向 MLLM 反应式 3D 图形编辑能力优化的框架
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已展现出作为交互式智能体的潜力，然而精确的、程序化的 3D 图形编辑仍然难以训练，因为现有系统在很大程度上依赖闭源模型 API，且缺乏确定性的、状态可验证的执行环境。我们提出 BlenderFORGE，这是一个面向开放权重 MLLM 智能体的可训练的数据—环境—优化框架，其智能体通过生成 Blender Python（bpy）代码来编辑显式的 Blender 场景。BlenderFORGE 针对四个基本的、状态可验证的编辑任务族：物体放置、形态键（shape-key）编辑、光照调整和材质修改。它集成了三个组件：（1）一个由精选资产和大规模 3D 场景仓库构建的可扩展的基于扰动的数据生成流水线；（2）一个隔离的 Blender 沙箱，用于确定性代码执行、结构化状态导出和闭环奖励计算；（3）一个两阶段训练流水线，使用离线教师轨迹进行冷启动监督微调（SFT），并使用沙箱计算得到的奖励进行多轮工具型智能体强化学习（AgentLoop-RL）。在四个任务族上的实验表明，由此得到的开放权重 Qwen3-VL-8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE 智能体相较其基座模型有显著提升，并在部分指标上达到与若干零样本专有 MLLM 基线相当的性能。额外的跨基准评测和相机重构图实验为超出原始训练设置的迁移能力提供了证据。

title: Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning
summary: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.

AI.title_zh: 面向目标条件潜空间规划的动力学知情动作学习
AI.abstract_zh: 潜空间世界模型通过在紧凑表示空间中规划动作序列来实现视觉控制，但潜空间动力学的学习方式与其在规划中的使用方式之间仍存在差距。第一，教师强制（teacher-forced）训练不会使动力学模型接触到规划过程中遇到的递归预测潜状态。第二，基于采样的规划器通常从与目标无关的候选提议中初始化动作搜索，而没有利用世界模型所学到的动作条件动力学。我们提出动力学知情动作学习（Dynamics-Informed Action Learning, DIAL）来弥合这两处差距。在训练期间，rollout 对齐使前向模型接触到其自身的自回归潜预测，而多步逆监督训练一个轻量级逆动力学头，以从潜状态转移中推断动作。我们进一步将逆动力学头应用于模型生成的转移上，并保持其参数固定，以促使预测的 rollout 保留与动作相关的信息。在测试时，DIAL 自回归地耦合逆动力学与前向动力学，以构建朝向目标的动力学知情动作序列，并用其初始化交叉熵方法（Cross-Entropy Method, CEM）提议分布的均值。随后的 CEM 搜索则使用标准的采样与更新过程对这一初始化进行细化。在四个视觉控制基准上的实验表明，DIAL 在标准场景和长时程场景中均优于现有的潜空间世界模型和规划基线。

title: The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies
summary: Cellular world models aim to predict how cells respond to genetic perturbations, analogous to world models in reinforcement learning. Perturbation response models are evaluated almost exclusively by global Pearson correlation between predicted and observed transcriptomes. We show this metric is dominated by thousands of non-responsive genes and severely inflates apparent performance. On the Replogle K562 screen (509 unseen perturbations, 5000 genes), GEARS achieves global Pearson 0.977, but its delta Pearson is only 0.076. A trivial baseline predicting mean training delta achieves 0.267, which is 3.5x better than GEARS. Our primary contribution is methodological: we identify and quantify this delta gap as a systematic evaluation artifact, and propose delta-space evaluation as the primary benchmark. We provide two post-hoc corrections (RWR on co-expression graphs and kNN matching) and show that 2.8x of the remaining gap lies in perturbation representation geometry, not decoder capacity. We further show the gap is partially addressable end-to-end: delta-aligned training (lambda = 3.0) raises delta Pearson to 0.179 on Replogle (2.35x over GEARS) and surpasses the trivial baseline on direction accuracy (0.680 vs 0.567) and gene recovery (1.52 vs 1.19); combined with kNN it reaches 0.217. An amplitude-calibration variant (eta = 0.3) further raises gene recovery to 2.16 while reaching 0.218. Critically, these representations transfer zero-shot across cell lines: from Replogle K562 to unseen Norman A549, the delta-aligned model reaches 0.328 on 741 shared genes, 4.7x a trivial baseline and 2.1x standard GEARS. This is the first systematic quantification of the delta gap, and the first diagnostic framework localizing the residual gap to perturbation representation geometry via an oracle upper bound.

AI.title_zh: Delta 差距：用于扰动响应预测的细胞世界模型远比全局相关性所暗示的困难得多
AI.abstract_zh: 细胞世界模型旨在预测细胞对遗传扰动的响应，类似于强化学习中的世界模型。扰动响应模型几乎完全通过预测转录组与观测转录组之间的全局 Pearson 相关性来评估。我们表明，该指标被数千个无响应基因所主导，并严重夸大了表观性能。在 Replogle K562 筛选数据（509 个未见扰动，5000 个基因）上，GEARS 达到全局 Pearson 0.977，但其 delta Pearson 仅为 0.076。一个预测训练集平均 delta 的平凡基线（trivial baseline）达到 0.267，比 GEARS 好 3.5 倍。我们的主要贡献是方法学层面的：我们识别并量化了这一 delta 差距，将其作为系统性的评估假象，并提出 delta 空间评估作为主要基准。我们提供了两种事后校正（在共表达图上的 RWR 和 kNN 匹配），并表明剩余差距中有 2.8 倍位于扰动表示几何中，而非解码器容量中。我们进一步表明，该差距可部分地以端到端方式解决：delta 对齐训练（lambda = 3.0）将 Replogle 上的 delta Pearson 提升至 0.179（为 GEARS 的 2.35 倍），并在方向准确率（0.680 对 0.567）和基因恢复（1.52 对 1.19）上超过平凡基线；与 kNN 结合后达到 0.217。一个幅度校准变体（eta = 0.3）进一步将基因恢复提升至 2.16，同时达到 0.218。关键在于，这些表示可跨细胞系零样本迁移：从 Replogle K562 到未见的 Norman A549，delta 对齐模型在 741 个共享基因上达到 0.328，为平凡基线的 4.7 倍，为标准 GEARS 的 2.1 倍。这是对 delta 差距的首次系统性量化，也是首个通过 oracle 上界将残余差距定位到扰动表示几何的诊断框架。

title: VisProve: Learning Typed Visual Provenance for Scientific Document Question Answering
summary: Visual citations show where an answer is supported, but not how the cited content contributes to it. In scientific document question answering, a model may read a value directly, compress several observations, or combine evidence to infer a conclusion. We study typed visual provenance, where a system generates an answer together with source regions and explicit support relations. We introduce ReViE, a dataset of 3,941 questions over complete scientific documents, with page, section, and region annotations labeled as Quotation, Compression, or Inference. We further propose VisProve, which augments joint answer and provenance generation with differentiable Spatial Evidence Reading and Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback. VisProve conditions next-token prediction on localized visual evidence and its estimated support relation through a gated norm-bounded residual. On the document-disjoint ReViE test set, VisProve improves Typed-F1 from 3.52 to 5.48 and Section-F1 from 45.99 to 53.24 over joint supervised fine-tuning with the same backbone, while Page-F1 changes only marginally. These results suggest that coupling visual grounding with support relation modeling mainly improves fine-grained provenance, while the low absolute Typed-F1 reveals a substantial gap between answer generation and precise visual evidence attribution.

AI.title_zh: VisProve：为科学文档问答学习带类型的视觉溯源
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉引用显示了答案在何处得到支持，但并未显示被引内容如何对答案作出贡献。在科学文档问答中，模型可能直接读取某个数值、压缩若干观察结果，或结合证据以推断出一个结论。我们研究带类型的视觉溯源（typed visual provenance），即系统在生成答案的同时给出源区域以及明确的支持关系。我们引入 ReViE，这是一个包含 3,941 个问题、覆盖完整科学文档的数据集，其页码、章节和区域标注被标记为 Quotation（引述）、Compression（压缩）或 Inference（推断）。我们进一步提出 VisProve，它通过可微的空间证据读取（Spatial Evidence Reading）与证据—答案关系反馈（Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback）来增强答案与溯源的联合生成。VisProve 通过一个带门控的范数有界残差（gated norm-bounded residual），将下一词元预测条件化于局部化视觉证据及其估计的支持关系之上。在与文档不相交的 ReViE 测试集上，与采用相同骨干网络的联合监督微调相比，VisProve 将 Typed-F1 从 3.52 提升至 5.48，将 Section-F1 从 45.99 提升至 53.24，而 Page-F1 仅有边际变化。这些结果表明，将视觉定位与支持关系建模相耦合主要改善了细粒度的溯源，而较低的绝对 Typed-F1 则揭示出答案生成与精确视觉证据归因之间仍存在显著差距。

title: Agentic discrete-event simulation for manufacturing system design: an open 3D simulator, a benchmark and an industrial case
summary: The design of manufacturing systems relies on discrete-event simulation (DES) models that experts still build in tool-specific interfaces. AI agents can now write simulation code, but every model they write from scratch is new, unverified software. We present SimuLean, an open-source 3D DES simulator on the Unity engine designed to be programmed by AI agents: its modelling semantics are verified once, in the platform, and the agent builds and studies one model through domain-level commands, in the 3D scene or headless; physically simulated durations are calibrated for fast headless studies. We evaluated it on 18 manufacturing modelling tasks, from single machines to published production lines. A frontier agent built valid models in 93 of 108 attempts (86%), in about two minutes each; on the benchmark's interface version, two frontier agents built 105 of 108 models through domain commands alone, so that each comes with a record of how it was built. Every residual failure was silent - a model that builds and runs but answers wrongly - and only comparison with reference models revealed them all. In an industrial case, one agent working alone rebuilt, verified and studied a robotised welding workshop from a published study, in SimuLean and in SimPy. Comparing them with the published, expert-built model exposed an error in it; against the corrected model, the agent-built models agree within 1%. One agent can already build complete, realistic and traceable models for the design of manufacturing systems; independent reference models are what make them trustworthy.

AI.title_zh: 面向制造系统设计的智能体驱动离散事件仿真：一个开放3D仿真器、一个基准与一个工业案例
AI.abstract_zh: 制造系统的设计依赖于离散事件仿真（DES）模型，而专家至今仍在特定工具的界面中构建这些模型。AI智能体如今能够编写仿真代码，但它们从零编写的每一个模型都是全新的、未经校验的软件。我们提出SimuLean，一个基于Unity引擎的开源3D DES仿真器，其设计目标是可由AI智能体编程：其建模语义在平台中一次性完成校验，智能体则通过领域级命令在3D场景中或无头模式下构建并研究单个模型；物理仿真的时长经过校准，以支持快速的无头研究。我们在18项制造建模任务上对其进行了评估，任务范围从单台机器到已发表的产线。一个前沿智能体在108次尝试中构建了93个有效模型（86%），每个模型耗时约两分钟；在该基准的界面版本上，两个前沿智能体仅通过领域命令就构建了108个模型中的105个，因此每个模型都附带其构建过程的记录。所有剩余的失败都是静默的——即模型能够构建并运行，但给出错误答案——且只有与参考模型进行比较才能将其全部揭示出来。在一个工业案例中，一个单独工作的智能体在SimuLean和SimPy中重建、校验并研究了一项已发表研究中的机器人焊接车间。将它们与已发表的、由专家构建的模型进行比较，暴露了该模型中的一个错误；相对于修正后的模型，智能体构建的模型在1%以内一致。一个智能体已经能够为制造系统设计构建完整、真实且可追溯的模型；独立参考模型正是使其可信的基础。

title: OneReel: Efficient Multi-Scene Video Generation with Scene-Structured Attention
summary: Multi-scene video generation must follow scene-specific prompts while preserving consistency across scenes. Dense joint generation enables cross-scene information exchange but incurs quadratic attention cost, whereas separate generation avoids this cost at the expense of cross-scene consistency. We present OneReel, a training-free system that exploits scene structure to enable efficient multi-scene generation. Our key insight is that multi-scene generation can preserve complete intra-scene attention while restricting cross-scene information exchange to a bounded shared memory. OneReel uses scene prompts and durations to establish scene-specific attention scopes and dynamically selects a bounded set of representative latent frames for cross-scene sharing. This reduces video attention complexity from quadratic to linear in the number of scenes. To translate these savings into execution speedups, OneReel packs scene-local and shared K/V into dense variable-length attention and employs work-balanced multi-GPU partitioning with communication-aware selection between K/V gathering and Ulysses-style parallelism. Our evaluations across four video generation models show that OneReel achieves 1.7-4.9x end-to-end speedup over dense attention and 1.2-2.2x over existing sparse-attention advances, while improving text-following accuracy by 34-37 percentage points and maintaining cross-scene consistency.

AI.title_zh: OneReel：基于场景结构化注意力的高效多场景视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 多场景视频生成必须遵循各场景特定的提示词，同时保持跨场景的一致性。稠密联合生成能够实现跨场景信息交换，但会带来二次方的注意力开销；而分开生成虽避免了这一开销，却牺牲了跨场景一致性。我们提出 OneReel，一个无需训练的系统，它利用场景结构实现高效的多场景生成。我们的关键洞见是：多场景生成可以保留完整的场景内注意力，同时将跨场景信息交换限制在一个有界的共享记忆中。OneReel 利用场景提示词和时长来建立场景特定的注意力范围，并动态选择一组有界的代表性潜在帧用于跨场景共享。这将视频注意力的复杂度从随场景数量的二次方降低为线性。为了将这些节省转化为执行速度的提升，OneReel 将场景局部的和共享的 K/V 打包为稠密的变长注意力，并采用负载均衡的多 GPU 划分，在 K/V 聚集与 Ulysses 式并行之间进行通信感知的选择。我们在四个视频生成模型上的评估表明，OneReel 相比稠密注意力实现了 1.7-4.9 倍的端到端加速，相比现有稀疏注意力进展实现 1.2-2.2 倍加速，同时将文本遵循准确率提升 34-37 个百分点，并保持跨场景一致性。

title: Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Gregory and Minh contributed equally
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit strong textual reasoning capabilities from their language backbones and text pretraining, but often fail to apply the same level of competency to visual inputs. We show that this degradation cannot be attributed to only perception failures, by evaluating models on semantically-equivalent text and rendered-text image inputs: models can accurately read text in the images and recover near-text performance when provided their own transcriptions, but just cannot reason well on the images directly. We characterize this discrepancy as a modality reasoning-access gap, where models fail to route perceived visual content into existing reasoning machinery accessible with text. To bridge this, we propose TIGER (Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning), which first mines synthetic modality counterfactuals where a model succeeds on a text problem but fails when provided the corresponding rendered image, and post-trains the model on the image input via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), along with SFT and DPO variants. Importantly, although trained exclusively on synthetic rendered-text images with no multimodal annotations, TIGER results in model performance improvements across diverse real-world visual benchmarks including geometric diagrams (MathVerse), multi-disciplinary sciences (EMMA, MMMU), complex charts (ChartQAPro), and embodied spatial reasoning (RoboSpatial-Home). TIGER also complements existing state-of-the-art RLVR visual reasoning methods, yielding further performance gains. Analysis involving reasoning-subspace activation and activation patching provide support indicating that TIGER helps to align visual-to-reasoning pathways toward text reasoning states. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/minhngh/Tiger.

AI.title_zh: 看见还不够：弥合推理—获取差距以释放视觉推理能力（TIGER）
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从其语言主干网络与文本预训练中继承了强大的文本推理能力，但往往无法将同等水平的胜任力应用于视觉输入。我们通过在语义等价的文本输入与渲染文本图像输入上评估模型，表明这种性能退化不能仅归因于感知失败：模型能够准确读出图像中的文本，并在提供其自身转写文本时恢复到接近文本输入的性能，但就是无法直接对图像进行良好推理。我们将这一差异刻画为模态推理—获取差距（modality reasoning-access gap），即模型未能将所感知的视觉内容导入到可通过文本访问的既有推理机制中。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 TIGER（Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning，面向弥合文本—图像差距的增强推理性训练），它首先挖掘合成的模态反事实样本——即模型在某个文本问题上成功、但在给定相应渲染图像时失败的情形——并借助组相对策略优化（GRPO）以及 SFT 和 DPO 变体，在图像输入上对模型进行后训练。重要的是，尽管 TIGER 仅使用无多模态标注的合成渲染文本图像进行训练，它却在多种真实世界视觉基准上带来模型性能提升，包括几何图形（MathVerse）、多学科科学（EMMA、MMMU）、复杂图表（ChartQAPro）以及具身空间推理（RoboSpatial-Home）。TIGER 还能与现有最先进的 RLVR 视觉推理方法互补，带来进一步的性能增益。涉及推理子空间激活与激活修补的分析提供了支持性证据，表明 TIGER 有助于将视觉到推理的通路对齐到文本推理状态。我们的实现见 https://github.com/minhngh/Tiger。

title: Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters
summary: Latent-action world models learn actions from video without labels, and recent methods aim to share these actions across bodies. Transfer between 2D characters with different body structures remains underexplored. In this paper, we study whether an action learned from one character can make a character with a different body perform the same action. A cat, a blob and a human can all jump, but each moves its body in its own way. The usual transfer gain mixes body motion with screen movement and can assign a perfect score to a model that ignores its action. To address this, we introduce a transfer score that compares the correct action with wrong ones from the same source. We test five training objectives on a new synthetic benchmark of 2D cartoon characters with six body plans, the standard Sprites benchmark, and 431 selected animal and human animations from DeformingThings4D. With a fixed camera, a baseline that only copies the source's screen movement scores 0.71, as high as most learned models. In contrast, with a camera that follows the body, the best model reaches only 0.46 for an unseen animal family and 0.20 for humans. With this camera, a linear probe identifies the action class of unseen animal families with 66% to 86% balanced accuracy (chance 17%). The learned actions therefore retain information about which action is performed, but the correct action closes only part of the prediction error gap for a new character.

AI.title_zh: 潜动作世界模型中跨角色身体形态的动作迁移：一项关于动画角色的实证研究
AI.abstract_zh: 潜动作世界模型无需标签即可从视频中学习动作，而近期的方法旨在将这些动作跨身体共享。具有不同身体结构的2D角色之间的迁移仍研究不足。本文研究从一个角色学到的动作能否使具有不同身体的角色执行相同的动作。猫、团块和人都会跳，但各自以自身的方式移动身体。通常的迁移增益将身体运动与屏幕运动混在一起，可能给一个忽略其动作的模型打满分。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种迁移分数，它将正确的动作与来自同一来源的错误动作进行比较。我们在一个新的2D卡通角色（包含六种身体形态）合成基准、标准的Sprites基准，以及从DeformingThings4D中选出的431个动物和人类动画上测试了五种训练目标。在固定相机下，仅复制来源屏幕运动的基线得分为0.71，与大多数学习到的模型一样高。相比之下，在跟随身体的相机下，最佳模型对未见过的动物科仅达到0.46，对人类仅达到0.20。在此相机下，线性探针以66%至86%的平衡准确率识别出未见过的动物科的动作类别（随机水平为17%）。因此，学习到的动作保留了关于所执行的是何种动作的信息，但正确的动作只能弥合新角色预测误差差距的一部分。

title: SRA: Spatial Reasoning Adapter via Evolving Social Interaction Graphs for Trajectory Prediction
summary: Predicting where multiple agents will move next is fundamental to autonomous driving, robotics, and any system that must share space with people safely. Modern stochastic predictors read off inter-agent interactions once from the observed past and keep that view fixed throughout the generative rollout, so the reciprocal geometric constraints that emerge as the joint future sharpens are not re-examined. We address this gap with SRA (Spatial Reasoning Adapter), a modular graph denoiser that is integrated into existing diffusion and flow-matching predictors without redesigning their generative cores. At every reverse step, SRA reads the host's current future estimate, builds a sparse Euclidean interaction graph on the predicted trajectories, and returns a residual correction to the host's decoding path. Our adapter consists of three core components: a sparse neighborhood retrieved with a learned query-key score and a geometric bias, a future-conditioned relational feature recomputed on the evolving prediction, and uncertainty-weighted message passing where confident agents act as anchors for uncertain ones. We instantiate SRA on three structurally different hosts (LED, MID, and MoFlow) across four multi-agent benchmarks: SDD, NBA, Soccer, and Football. SRA improves ADE for every host on every dataset, with average gains of 5.8% in ADE and 7.0% in FDE. A cumulative ablation shows that the three components act as one mechanism: only together do they improve every host on every sports dataset, indicating that spatial reasoning over the model's own evolving future, weighted by how far that future can be trusted, is broadly useful across denoising architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoo97/SRA.

AI.title_zh: SRA：通过演化社会交互图实现轨迹预测的空间推理适配器
AI.abstract_zh: 预测多个智能体下一步将移动到何处，是自动驾驶、机器人技术以及任何必须与人类安全共享空间的系统的基础问题。现代随机预测器仅从观测到的过去中一次性读取智能体间的交互，并在整个生成式推演（generative rollout）过程中保持这一视角固定不变，因此，随着联合未来逐渐明确而出现的相互几何约束不会被重新审视。我们通过 SRA（空间推理适配器，Spatial Reasoning Adapter）来弥补这一差距。SRA 是一种模块化图去噪器，可集成到现有的扩散与流匹配（flow-matching）预测器中，而无需重新设计其生成核心。在每一个反向步骤中，SRA 读取宿主模型当前的未来估计，在预测轨迹上构建稀疏欧氏交互图，并向宿主的解码路径返回残差修正。我们的适配器由三个核心组件构成：以学习到的查询-键（query-key）得分和几何偏置检索出的稀疏邻域；在演化预测上重新计算的未来条件关系特征；以及不确定性加权消息传递，其中置信度高的智能体作为置信度低的智能体的锚点。我们在三种结构不同的宿主模型（LED、MID 和 MoFlow）上实例化 SRA，并覆盖四个多智能体基准：SDD、NBA、Soccer 和 Football。SRA 在每个数据集上均改善了每个宿主模型的 ADE，平均增益为 ADE 5.8%、FDE 7.0%。累积消融实验表明，这三个组件作为一个机制共同起作用：只有当三者结合时，它们才能在每一个体育数据集上改善每一个宿主模型，这表明，在模型自身不断演化的未来之上进行空间推理，并以该未来可被信任的程度为权重，在各类去噪架构中都具有广泛的适用性。代码可在 https://github.com/Jaewoo97/SRA 获取。

title: They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification
summary: The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes_of_SKR-ID.

AI.title_zh: 他们能看见却说不出来：视觉推理相对位姿识别中的迭代式自我知识再表达
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉推理相对位姿识别（VRRPI）任务暴露了现代视觉语言模型（VLM）在多视图三维空间推理能力上的关键弱点。我们对 VLM 在 VRRPI 中的行为进行了系统分析，揭示了稳定的输出偏差：无论视觉证据如何，VLM 都会不成比例地预测特定的运动模式。为缓解这些固有偏差，我们提出了迭代去偏的自我知识再表达（SKR-ID），这是一种无需标注的流程，仅使用随机抽取的未标注图像对即可使 VLM 适配 VRRPI。SKR-ID 将 VLM 的输出机制从通用的下一词元预测转变为面向任务优化的分类头。该流程分两个阶段进行：（1）使用去偏的以对象为中心的提示进行冷启动初始化，以将运动推断锚定在二维视觉证据上；（2）递归的 logit 排序机制，通过使用 logit 中位数作为动态阈值来强制实现统计均等。在标准基准上对前沿 VLM 进行的实验评估表明，SKR-ID 显著缓解了系统性偏差。我们的方法在未使用任何标注数据的情况下，将开源 VLM 的 Macro-F1 分数从 35.0-45.4% 提升至 53.7-58.0%。这些结果表明，SKR-ID 能够从严重崩塌的基线出发有效提升三维推理性能。代码已公开于 https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes_of_SKR-ID。

title: ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but attention over long spatiotemporal sequences makes inference computationally expensive. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of query-key interactions exactly, and recent training-free methods further approximate the remaining interactions. These methods, however, degrade quickly at high sparsity, which limits the achievable speedup. We present ESTRA (Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention), a training-free acceleration method that preserves generation quality even at extreme sparsity. ESTRA concentrates exact attention computation on a small set of important key-value tokens and approximates the remaining contributions with cluster representatives. To identify these tokens efficiently, it groups similar queries and uses their representatives to score individual keys. A variance-based correction further refines the attention weights of the cluster representatives, improving the accuracy of the approximation. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B show that ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention, achieving $3.26\times$ and $4.71\times$ end-to-end speedups at 5% attention density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in fidelity to dense generation and on most VBench dimensions. Even at 1% density, ESTRA remains more faithful to dense generation than Sol-Attn at 12.5%, while reaching up to $5.39\times$ speedup.

AI.title_zh: ESTRA：面向免训练视频扩散加速的极端注意力稀疏化
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散Transformer能够生成高质量视频，但在长时空序列上的注意力计算使推理的计算开销十分高昂。稀疏注意力通过仅精确计算一部分查询-键（query-key）交互来降低这一开销，而近期的一些免训练方法进一步对剩余交互进行近似。然而，这些方法在高稀疏度下性能迅速下降，从而限制了可实现的加速比。我们提出ESTRA（Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention，通过精细化注意力实现极端稀疏），这是一种即使在极端稀疏度下仍能保持生成质量的免训练加速方法。ESTRA将精确注意力计算集中于一小部分重要的键-值（key-value）token上，并用聚类代表来近似其余贡献。为了高效地识别这些token，它先将相似的查询分组，并利用其代表对各个键进行打分。基于方差的校正进一步细化聚类代表的注意力权重，从而提升近似的准确性。在Wan2.1-14B和HunyuanVideo-13B上的实验表明，ESTRA为免训练稀疏注意力建立了新的质量-效率前沿：在5%注意力密度下实现了$3.26\times$和$4.71\times$的端到端加速，同时在相对于稠密生成的保真度以及大多数VBench维度上超过了Sol-Attn和SVG-EAR。即使在1%密度下，ESTRA对稠密生成的保真度仍高于12.5%密度下的Sol-Attn，同时可实现高达$5.39\times$的加速。

title: Spatial Representation Distillation and Knowledge Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Understanding three-dimensional physical structure has become essential for vision-language-action models (VLAs). However, existing approaches either rely on explicit geometric inputs at inference time or adopt a single visual pathway, potentially compromising the visual-semantic knowledge inherited from pre-trained models. We present SPARK-VLA, Spatial Representation distillation and Knowledge routing for VLAs, a preserve-specialize-route framework for spatially adapting VLAs without requiring external 3D inputs or experts at inference. SPARK-VLA consists of two key components: (1) spatial representation distillation, which transfers 3D understanding from a frozen 3D expert to a LoRA-adapted visual branch by aligning attention responses while preserving the original visual pathway, and (2) a lightweight knowledge router, which selectively forwards action-relevant visual tokens to the language model using routing supervision derived from action-loss gradients. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation, SPARK-VLA achieves strong performance with only a 0.5B language backbone and approximately 53M trainable parameters, providing an effective and parameter-efficient approach to 3D-aware VLA learning. Code is available at https://github.com/park-jungin/spark-vla.

AI.title_zh: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型的空间表征蒸馏与知识路由
AI.abstract_zh: 理解三维物理结构已成为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的必备能力。然而，现有方法要么在推理时依赖显式的几何输入，要么采用单一的视觉通路，这可能损害从预训练模型继承的视觉-语义知识。我们提出 SPARK-VLA，即面向 VLA 的空间表征蒸馏与知识路由（Spatial Representation distillation and Knowledge routing for VLAs），这是一个“保留-专门化-路由”（preserve-specialize-route）框架，用于在推理时无需外部 3D 输入或专家模型的情况下对 VLA 进行空间适配。SPARK-VLA 由两个关键组件构成：（1）空间表征蒸馏，通过在对齐注意力响应的同时保留原始视觉通路，将 3D 理解从冻结的 3D 专家模型迁移到经 LoRA 适配的视觉分支；（2）轻量级知识路由器，利用由动作损失梯度导出的路由监督，选择性地将与动作相关的视觉 token 转发给语言模型。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN 以及真实世界操作任务上，SPARK-VLA 仅凭 0.5B 的语言主干和约 53M 可训练参数即取得强劲性能，为 3D 感知的 VLA 学习提供了一种有效且参数高效的方法。代码见 https://github.com/park-jungin/spark-vla。

title: Multi-Objective Adaptation After Deployment: A Position on World Models for Remote Robot Teams
summary: Autonomous robot teams deployed in remote, unstructured environments may face changes in the environment, hardware, and team composition that degrade previously effective policies. Shifting mission objectives can be handled by selecting a different solution from an existing Pareto set, but shifting deployment conditions can reorder the set itself, making previously dominated policies competitive or new policies necessary. However, evaluating these policies in new contexts while minimizing risk to the hardware remains an open problem. We argue that, although largely untested in this domain, world models merit investigation for post-deployment multi-objective adaptation. By predicting policy outcomes under updated estimates of current conditions, world models could enable teams to re-evaluate existing policies without physically executing each candidate, provided predicted performance changes reflect those realized on deployed systems. We identify research priorities for model-based policy re-evaluation, validation of predicted against realized performance, and incorporating shared information into world models to support coordinated team adaptation.

AI.title_zh: 部署后的多目标适配：关于面向远程机器人团队的世界模型的一种立场
AI.abstract_zh: 部署在偏远、非结构化环境中的自主机器人团队可能面临环境、硬件和团队构成的变化，这些变化会使先前有效的策略性能下降。任务目标的改变可以通过从已有 Pareto 集中选择不同的解来应对，但部署条件的变化可能使该集合本身重新排序，从而使先前被支配的策略变得具有竞争力，或使新策略成为必要。然而，在降低硬件风险的同时在新情境中评估这些策略，仍是一个未解决的问题。我们认为，尽管在这一领域基本未经检验，世界模型值得针对部署后的多目标适配进行研究。通过对当前条件的更新估计来预测策略结果，世界模型可以使团队无需物理执行每个候选策略即可重新评估已有策略，前提是预测的性能变化能够反映在已部署系统上实际实现的变化。我们确定了以下研究重点：基于模型的策略重评估、对预测性能与实际实现性能的验证，以及将共享信息纳入世界模型以支持协同的团队适配。

title: Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models
comment: 33 pages, including appendix and references. Code: https://github.com/UWMILab/Tiresias
summary: World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

AI.title_zh: Tiresias：迈向语言条件世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型通过内部模拟实现规划，而自然语言则提供了直观的任务指定方式。然而，语言条件世界建模仍分散于各领域，其动作空间、数据集和评估协议各不相同。我们提出 LCWM，这是一个共享任务：将初始的智能体视角观测和语言指令映射为一条完成该指令的动作序列。其配套基准 LCWM-Bench 在共享的动作接口与评估协议下整合了导航、机器人、3D 游戏和驾驶四个领域的 15 个数据集，将 142,987 个回合（episodes）与 428,961 条指令配对，指令包含三种风格。我们进一步提出 Tiresias，一个通过选择性想象进行规划的智能体：一个语言条件扩散策略生成候选轨迹，一个轨迹排序器对其进行初筛，而一个视频预训练的世界模型想象它们的视觉后果。一个视觉排序器评估这些推演（rollouts），与轨迹分数互补以选出最终计划。Tiresias 在 LCWM-Bench 上取得了具有竞争力的规划与想象性能。消融实验证明了轨迹排序与视觉验证的互补收益，而使用替代候选生成方法的实验表明，训练得到的排序器在我们提出的扩散策略之外依然有效。总之，LCWM-Bench 与 Tiresias 为通过世界模型研究语言引导的规划提供了一个统一的评估设置和一个有效的起点。

title: RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

AI.title_zh: RefineSplat：面向开放词汇查询的重建引导式以对象为中心的高斯泼溅
AI.abstract_zh: 开放词汇三维场景理解旨在使用自然语言查询对三维场景中的任意对象进行分割与检索。大多数现有方法通常遵循"先泼溅、后分割"（splat-then-segment）的范式，即先重建三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting），再为其附加标签或语言特征以进行后续分割。然而，该流程往往存在视图不一致、对象边界模糊以及对象级对应关系薄弱的问题，在复杂的静态与动态场景中尤为明显。在我们此前提出的"先分割、后泼溅"（Segment-then-Splat）框架的基础上，我们提出 RefineSplat，这是一个保留其以对象为中心范式的重建引导式扩展：它首先在二维中跟踪对象，然后使用一组专用的三维高斯对每个对象进行重建，从而保留显式的对象—高斯对应关系，以支持统一的开放词汇分割与检索。为提升鲁棒性，我们进一步闭环了二维跟踪与三维重建之间的联系。由于现成的视频跟踪器可能产生不可靠的掩码，并将误差传播至对象重建中，我们引入了一种重建引导的反馈机制，利用渲染掩码与多视图一致性来细化对象跟踪。此外，我们不再为每个对象分配单一语言嵌入，而是提出一种视角感知的嵌入分配策略，其中每个对象维护多个按视图聚类的嵌入，以捕捉依赖视角的语义线索。我们还引入了 Blender-OVS，这是一个包含静态与动态序列、并带有精确对象网格与点云的合成基准，可用于直接评估所提取的几何。在静态与动态基准上的实验表明，渲染视图分割效果有所提升，对象级 Chamfer 距离更低，同时场景重建质量具有竞争力。

title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

AI.title_zh: SituRecBench：在3D环境中评估前沿模型作为情境化推荐助手
AI.abstract_zh: 推荐系统正从静态检索引擎转变为扎根于物理环境的交互式助手。然而，当前研究在很大程度上忽视了空间导航、视觉 grounding 与多轮社交交互的综合复杂性。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 SituRecBench，这是一个交互式基准，用于在高保真3D环境中评估前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）作为情境化推荐助手的能力。我们将推荐重新表述为一个情境化协助过程，在这一过程中，助手在共享用户自我中心视角的同时与用户进行交互。我们的基准模拟真实世界的购物环境（例如超市和家居用品店），要求助手引导出偏好、将推荐 grounding 于环境中，并通过对话引导用户前往相关位置。该基准通过统一的交互协议评估对话质量、推荐效用和导航有效性。大量实验揭示了在空间 grounding 和偏好引导方面持续存在的挑战，凸显了其在将全局上下文信息与局部观察相结合方面的局限。SituRecBench 为推进真实世界中情境化助手的发展提供了严谨的基础。

title: The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics
summary: Embedded AI is moving from perception to prediction. Robots now use world models$\unicode{x2014}$learned simulators that predict the outcome of candidate actions in a compressed latent space before any is executed. Every predicted step must be computed on board within a tight power and thermal budget, yet the energy these steps fundamentally require, and how far real hardware sits from it, have not been characterized. We derive lower bounds on the arithmetic operations and the CMOS dynamic energy of a latent state transition from information theory and Boolean circuit complexity. Profiling a DreamerV3-style Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) shows that every rollout operation is memory-bandwidth bound and that a GPU consumes at least $5.9\times10^{10}$ times the CMOS energy floor. Transient 3D thermal simulations show that this inefficiency is also a thermal one, since sustained back-to-back planning heats a millimeter-scale silicon tile to 556 K even behind an ideal copper heat spreader. Guided by this chain from bound to bottleneck, we propose the World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA), a chip architecture for embedded world model planning that combines near-memory computation, real-time entropy estimation, variable-precision rollout units, and copy-on-write latent scratchpads. With a design target of 40x lower power, the same tile stays near ambient at 306 K in simulation, pointing toward practical planning on thermally constrained robots.

AI.title_zh: 世界模型规划加速器（WMPA）：面向机器人嵌入式 AI 的软硬件协同设计
AI.abstract_zh: 嵌入式 AI 正从感知走向预测。机器人现在使用世界模型——即在压缩的潜空间中对候选动作的结果进行预测、且在任何动作被执行之前即作出预测的学习型模拟器。每一个被预测的步骤都必须在片上、在严格的功耗与热预算内完成计算，然而这些步骤从根本上所需的能量，以及真实硬件距离该下限有多远，尚未得到表征。我们从信息论与布尔电路复杂性出发，推导了潜状态转移的算术运算量与 CMOS 动态能量的下界。对 DreamerV3 风格的循环状态空间模型（RSSM）进行剖析（profiling）表明，每一次 rollout 运算都受内存带宽限制，并且 GPU 的能耗至少是 CMOS 能量下限的 $5.9\times10^{10}$ 倍。瞬态三维热仿真表明，这种低效同时也是热学上的低效：即使置于理想的铜质均热板之后，持续不断的背靠背规划也会将毫米级硅芯片加热至 556 K。在这一从界限到瓶颈的链条指引下，我们提出了世界模型规划加速器（WMPA），这是一种面向嵌入式世界模型规划的芯片架构，结合了近内存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度 rollout 单元以及写时复制（copy-on-write）潜变量暂存区。以功耗降低 40 倍为设计目标，仿真中同一芯片的温度保持在接近环境的 306 K，指向了在受热约束的机器人上实现实用化规划的可能。

title: WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have continuous deficiency in spatial reasoning tasks that require \emph{mental spatial transformation}, such as reasoning under hypothetical changes in viewpoint or position, known as perspective-taking tasks. Existing approaches either scale linguistic reasoning or augment VLMs with static geometric representations, but neither directly enables active transformation of the represented scene. World models offer this capability, yet existing systems typically communicate through synthesized RGB images, introducing a latent-to-pixel-to-latent bottleneck. We introduce \emph{WorldMind}, a framework for test-time scaling of spatial reasoning through latent world simulation. Given a query and observation, the VLM selects useful spatial transformations, while a world model executes them and exposes aligned intermediate latent features directly to the VLM. The resulting latent evidence is incorporated into subsequent reasoning steps, enabling iterative spatial simulation without repeatedly decoding imagined states into pixels. To optimize this interaction, WorldMind further employs process-verifiable reinforcement learning that rewards reasoning progress only when the associated action and latent transition are valid. WorldMind thus scales spatial reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation to active world simulation rather than generating more language or pixels. Across VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and MindCube-Tiny, WorldMind achieves an average improvement of 16.0% over the base VLM and 8.3% over the strongest RGB-based world simulation.

AI.title_zh: WorldMind：通过潜空间世界模拟实现视觉空间推理的测试时扩展
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在需要\emph{心理空间变换}的空间推理任务上持续存在不足，例如在关于视点或位置的假设性变化下进行推理，这类任务被称为采择视角任务（perspective-taking tasks）。现有方法要么扩增语言推理，要么用静态几何表示增强 VLM，但两者都无法直接实现对所表征场景的主动变换。世界模型提供了这种能力，然而现有系统通常通过合成的 RGB 图像进行交流，引入了潜在的“潜变量—像素—潜变量”瓶颈。我们提出 \emph{WorldMind}，一个通过潜空间世界模拟实现空间推理测试时扩展的框架。给定一个查询和观测，VLM 选择有用的空间变换，而世界模型执行这些变换，并将对齐的中间潜特征直接暴露给 VLM。由此得到的潜证据被纳入后续推理步骤，使得无需反复将想象的状态解码为像素即可进行迭代式空间模拟。为优化这一交互，WorldMind 进一步采用过程可验证的强化学习，仅当相关联的动作与潜状态转移有效时才奖励推理进展。因此，WorldMind 通过将额外的推理时计算分配给主动世界模拟而非生成更多语言或像素来扩展空间推理。在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 MindCube-Tiny 上，WorldMind 相比基础 VLM 取得平均 16.0% 的提升，相比最强的基于 RGB 的世界模拟提升 8.3%。

title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
summary: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code

AI.title_zh: Video-Coder：强化面向视频生成的智能体化编程
AI.abstract_zh: 近年来，视频生成在视觉质量与时间一致性方面取得了显著进展。然而，生成具有精确空间结构、连贯运动动态和可控场景构图的视频仍然充满挑战。在本文中，我们提出 Video-Coder，这是首次尝试训练一个代码驱动的视频生成智能体（agent），它能够自主编写并执行代码以构建动态 3D 场景（Draft Video），从而为下游视频生成器提供结构与运动信号。为支持这一范式，我们设计了专门的数据流水线，并构建了两个高质量数据集 Video-Coder-SFT-6k 和 Video-Coder-RL-2k，其中包含多样化的提示词与真实参考视频。我们进一步开发了 Video-Coder Harness，这是一个统一的交互环境，集成了代码执行、3D 场景渲染和执行反馈，用于智能体的训练与推理。随后，我们采用先 SFT、后进行 harness 原生智能体强化学习的方式训练 Video-Coder，该强化学习使用结合了基于执行的奖励与基于视频的奖励的双重奖励反馈。此外，我们设计了一种退火训练策略，随时间逐渐降低执行奖励，使模型在训练后期更多地依赖视频奖励。实验表明，Video-Coder 取得了显著提升，在 PhyGenBench 上将 Minimax-H3 提升约 7 分，在 VBench-2.0 上提升 24 分。我们希望这项工作能够成为视频生成中编程智能体的开放基础，并将我们的数据、模型和代码全部开源。

title: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
summary: In many areas of AI, general-purpose models have increasingly replaced handcrafted methods and specialized architectures. We argue that embodied AI is poised for a similar shift. Our key claim is that embodied tasks can be formulated as interaction with digital software. Specifically, we build software that renders an agent's view of a physical environment on a screen and provides controls for acting in it. A computer-use agent (CUA) can then perform embodied tasks through the same screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions that it uses to operate ordinary software. Using a single CUA design and changing only the software, our entries win first-, second-, third-, and sixth-place prizes across four ECCV workshop competitions, without any competition-specific agent tuning. These results suggest that the skills CUAs learn on software, such as visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration, already carry over to embodied tasks, giving CUAs a far broader scope in embodied AI than previously realized. We therefore advocate that computer-use agents can be embodied generalists. Further, we advocate that, by following the training strategy that made computer-use agents general, embodied AI can converge on a single general model as well, ushering in a new era of general embodied AI. Website: https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied

AI.title_zh: 计算机使用智能体是具身通才
AI.abstract_zh: 在人工智能的许多领域，通用模型已日益取代手工设计的方法与专用架构。我们认为，具身人工智能（embodied AI）也正面临类似的转变。我们的核心主张是：具身任务可以被表述为与数字软件的交互。具体而言，我们构建软件，将智能体对物理环境的视角渲染在屏幕上，并提供在其中行动的控制方式。于是，计算机使用智能体（computer-use agent, CUA）便可以通过与操作普通软件时相同的屏幕截图以及键盘和鼠标动作来完成具身任务。使用单一 CUA 设计、仅更换软件，我们的参赛方案在四个 ECCV 研讨会竞赛中分别获得第一名、第二名、第三名和第六名，且没有进行任何针对特定竞赛的智能体调优。这些结果表明，CUA 在软件上习得的技能，如视觉定位、精确点击和探索，已经能够迁移到具身任务，从而使 CUA 在具身 AI 中的适用范围远超此前所认识到的程度。因此，我们主张计算机使用智能体可以是具身通才（embodied generalists）。此外，我们主张，通过遵循使计算机使用智能体具备通用性的训练策略，具身 AI 也能收敛到单一通用模型，从而开启通用具身 AI 的新时代。网站：https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied

title: BEV3SR: Evidence-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning from Video
summary: 3D spatial reasoning from video remains challenging for VLMs because videos provide sequential, view-local observations rather than persistent metric scene records. Many questions must be answered in a query-specified perspective rather than the observed camera viewpoint, and prompting with a fixed set of RGB views may miss sparse or occluded visual cues. To address these gaps, we introduce BEV3SR, a training-free and backbone-agnostic framework for RGB-D videos with camera parameters. BEV3SR turns video observations into queryable metric bird's-eye-view (BEV) scene memory and formalizes each query into an evidence-aware spatial task. The Spatial Task Formalizer specifies the query's reference frame, spatial constraints, objective, and evidence requirement. The evidence requirement determines the appropriate reasoning pathway. A query treated as requiring geometric evidence is handled by the Geometric Reasoner, which deterministically computes the answer using the metric BEV records in the query-specified reference frame. Otherwise, a query treated as requiring visual evidence is passed to the Visual Evidence Aligner, which uses BEV-indexed object records and their associated supporting views to retrieve object-consistent and scene-context RGB frames for VLM grounding. Within a standard 16-frame budget, BEV3SR consistently improves different VLM backbones across multiple 3D scene QA benchmarks, delivering large gains on spatially intensive questions and significant improvements on open-ended scene QA. These results demonstrate that BEV3SR offers an effective, efficient, and interpretable framework for explicit 3D spatial reasoning from video.

AI.title_zh: BEV3SR：基于视频的证据感知三维空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 从视频进行三维空间推理对视觉语言模型（VLM）而言仍然具有挑战性，因为视频提供的是序列化、视角局部的观测，而非持久的度量级场景记录。许多问题必须在查询指定的参考视角下回答，而不是在所观测到的相机视角下回答，并且用固定的一组 RGB 视图进行提示可能会遗漏稀疏或被遮挡的视觉线索。为弥补这些不足，我们提出 BEV3SR，一个无需训练且与骨干模型无关的框架，适用于带相机参数的 RGB-D 视频。BEV3SR 将视频观测转化为可查询的度量级鸟瞰图（BEV）场景记忆，并将每个查询形式化为一个证据感知的空间任务。空间任务形式化模块（Spatial Task Formalizer）明确查询的参考系、空间约束、目标以及证据需求。证据需求决定了相应的推理通路。被视为需要几何证据的查询由几何推理器（Geometric Reasoner）处理，它在查询指定的参考系中利用度量级 BEV 记录确定性地计算答案。否则，被视为需要视觉证据的查询被传递给视觉证据对齐器（Visual Evidence Aligner），它利用以 BEV 索引的对象记录及其关联的支持视图，检索对象一致且包含场景上下文的 RGB 帧，以供 VLM 进行 grounding。在标准的 16 帧预算内，BEV3SR 在多个三维场景问答基准上持续提升不同的 VLM 骨干模型，在空间密集型问题上带来大幅增益，并在开放式场景问答上取得显著改进。这些结果表明，BEV3SR 为从视频进行显式三维空间推理提供了一个有效、高效且可解释的框架。

title: AR-Edit: Training-Free Autoregressive Video Editing without Inversion
summary: Editing a video stream in real time, without access to future frames, is essential for interactive applications. Existing training-free video editing methods, however, assume full offline access to the entire sequence, while streaming approaches either rely on additional training or are limited to specific editing techniques. We show that this limitation can be removed by analyzing the self-attention dynamics of DMD-distilled autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. We uncover a key asymmetry: queries and keys remain stable and aligned with their source counterparts across denoising timesteps, while values diverge and encode the evolving content. Inherited from the non-distilled bidirectional teacher, this asymmetry is strongest at high noise, where few-step streaming models operate. The resulting mechanism is simple: a single forward pass suffices to capture source identity in the value features, which can be reused throughout generation. Starting from pure Gaussian noise and injecting only these source values reconstructs the input with fidelity matching or surpassing inversion-based methods, effectively eliminating inversion. Based on this insight, we introduce AR-Edit, a training-free, inversion-free method that caches source values once and selectively injects them during denoising. Across multiple AR backbones, AR-Edit enables real-time streaming editing with superior source preservation and tonal fidelity at minimal overhead.

AI.title_zh: AR-Edit：无需反演的无训练自回归视频编辑
AI.abstract_zh: 在没有未来帧可用的条件下实时编辑视频流，对于交互式应用至关重要。然而，现有的免训练视频编辑方法假定可以离线获取整个序列，而流式方法要么依赖额外训练，要么仅限于特定的编辑技术。我们表明，通过分析 DMD 蒸馏的自回归（AR）视频扩散模型的自注意力动态，可以消除这一限制。我们揭示了一种关键的不对称性：在去噪时间步上，查询（queries）和键（keys）保持稳定，且与源序列对应部分保持一致，而值（values）则发生偏离并编码不断演变的内容。这一不对称性继承自未蒸馏的双向教师模型，在高噪声条件下最为显著，而这正是少步流式模型所处的操作区间。由此得到的机制很简单：单次前向传播就足以在值特征中捕获源身份，且这些特征可在整个生成过程中复用。从纯高斯噪声出发、仅注入这些源值，即可重建输入，其保真度与基于反演的方法相当或更优，从而有效地消除了反演。基于这一洞见，我们提出 AR-Edit，这是一种免训练、免反演的方法，它只需缓存一次源值，并在去噪过程中有选择地注入这些值。在多个 AR 骨干网络上，AR-Edit 以极小的开销实现了具有更优源保持和色调保真度的实时流式编辑。

title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) approaches have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains in recent years, learning accurate world models from agent trajectories. However, despite this progress, current approaches still struggle to surpass human performance on tasks that require long-term memory and planning. In this work, we address the problem of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. We introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode observations into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark. Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.

AI.title_zh: 以测试时基于模型的强化学习在世界模型中编码记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）方法近年来在多个领域展现出强劲的性能，能够从智能体轨迹中学习准确的世界模型。然而，尽管取得了这些进展，当前方法在需要长期记忆与规划的任务上仍难以超越人类表现。在本工作中，我们通过跳出通常所研究的架构设计范式，来解决 MBRL 中的长期记忆问题。我们提出了测试时基于模型的强化学习（Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, TT-MBRL），在测试时使用梯度下降将情节观测的记忆编码进世界模型参数。这使得智能体能够为每个情节学习一个独特的世界模型，相比仅依赖上下文记忆的传统方法提升了记忆能力。我们首先在 Memory Maze 环境的一个简化二维变体（我们称之为 Memory Maze 2D）上建立概念验证，展示了在不同世界模型架构上的一致改进。随后，我们在三维领域展示了 TT-MBRL 的有效性，在 Memory Maze 基准上取得了新的最先进结果。最后，我们表明 TT-MBRL 在 DeepMind Control 和 Atari 100k 等非记忆类基准上仍保持强劲性能。

title: HiMEM: Hippocampus-Inspired Memory Consolidation, Pruning, and Composition for Vision-Language-Action Models in 3D Scenes
summary: Memory plays a crucial role in long-horizon task execution and cross-task generalization for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models operating in complex 3D scenes. However, existing VLA memory mechanisms suffer from memory noise, particularly in complex 3D scenes, as stored episodic memories contain extensive redundant details about scene layouts, object configurations, and robot-specific states, which obscure generalizable manipulation principles and hinder cross-task transfer. To address this challenge, we first introduce a hippocampus-inspired memory consolidation mechanism that synthesizes extensive episodic experiences into a compact set of essential semantic memories, enabling VLA models to derive generalizable principles from practical experience. Second, we propose an episodic memory pruning mechanism that removes redundant episodic memories whose contents are captured by consolidated semantic memories, thereby increasing effective memory capacity and improving long-horizon task execution. Finally, to handle complex task scenarios, we develop a flexible memory composition mechanism that jointly leverages multiple episodic and semantic memories to enhance cross-scenario generalization. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus demonstrate the effectiveness of HiMEM across different VLA backbones, improving the average success rate of pi_0 from 91.88% to 98.20% on LIBERO.

AI.title_zh: HiMEM：受海马体启发的三维场景中视觉-语言-动作模型的记忆巩固、剪枝与组合
AI.abstract_zh: 记忆对于在复杂三维场景中运行的视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型的长时程任务执行与跨任务泛化起着至关重要的作用。然而，现有的 VLA 记忆机制存在记忆噪声问题，在复杂三维场景中尤为突出，因为所存储的情景记忆包含了大量关于场景布局、物体配置以及机器人特定状态的冗余细节，这些细节掩盖了可泛化的操作原理，并阻碍了跨任务迁移。为应对这一挑战，我们首先引入一种受海马体启发的记忆巩固机制，该机制将大量情景经验综合为一组紧凑的核心语义记忆，使 VLA 模型能够从实际经验中提炼出可泛化的原理。其次，我们提出一种情景记忆剪枝机制，移除那些内容已被巩固后的语义记忆所涵盖的冗余情景记忆，从而提高有效记忆容量并改善长时程任务执行。最后，为处理复杂任务场景，我们开发了一种灵活的记忆组合机制，联合利用多个情景记忆与语义记忆以增强跨场景泛化能力。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 上的实验证明了 HiMEM 在不同 VLA 主干模型上的有效性，将 pi_0 在 LIBERO 上的平均成功率从 91.88% 提升至 98.20%。

title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
summary: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.

AI.title_zh: 迈向智能体具身智能的时代
AI.abstract_zh: 基础模型（foundation models）日益用于引导机器人动作，然而持续自主性需要高效的控制与故障恢复。我们提出 A2-MEAS，一个以代码作为扩展接口（scaling interface）构建的具身多智能体框架。学习到的纠错代码（correction codes）结合纠错语言、空间证据、执行历史与动作提议。MetaBrain 提供训练监督与运行时指导。在训练过程中，纠错编码器与适配器（correction encoder and adapter）将这些知识吸收进策略权重；而在部署时，新的代码在权重冻结的情况下调整行为。动作模型 A2-WLA 在视觉-语言-动作策略（vision-language-action policy）中加入运动感知历史和潜在世界模型（latent world model）。令人意外的是，这种结合动作预训练与任务特化的简单设计，在在线纠错之前，于 50 任务的 BEHAVIOR 2026 公开子集上达到 0.5755 Q-score，是 2025 年冠军所报告的 0.2605 的 2.21 倍（二者分属不同的基准版本与训练配置）。在 BEHAVIOR 2026 全部 100 个公开任务上，A2-MEAS 达到 0.6411 Q-score 和 45.40% 的任务成功率。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，A2-WLA 达到 93.98% 的平均成功率，使用完整系统时提升至 95.05%。在五种家居环境中的 12 个真实机器人任务上，A2-WLA 的平均成功率为 57.92%，而 pi0.5 为 26.67%。在长时程的手冲咖啡（pour-over coffee）制备中，与 A2-WLA 重试相比，一个以历史为条件的适配器（history-conditioned adapter）将两个滤纸处理步骤的故障后完成率分别从 14% 提升至 94%，从 8% 提升至 82%。我们的训练基础设施在同等硬件上每秒处理 427.1 个样本，是 pi0.5 参考实现吞吐量的 4.03 倍。我们将发布系统、模型、训练脚本和基础设施，以支持高效的具身学习。

title: Trajectory Forcing: Exploiting Diffusion Trajectories for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) modeling is arguably the only way to extend a fixed-length video diffusion model to longer or even streaming videos. However, existing AR diffusion methods use only the previously predicted chunk as context for the next, discarding the intermediate predictions that constitute the chunk's generation history. In contrast, conventional AR models such as LLMs condition on the entire history of preceding tokens. To this end, we propose Trajectory Forcing (TraF), an AR diffusion method that exploits the denoising trajectories of previous video chunks as context. TraF operates under two training regimes: (1) with ground-truth videos, where pseudo-trajectories are constructed from Gaussian interpolations and re-predicted by the model, and (2) with a teacher model, where real trajectories are obtained from the student's own denoising rollout. The first regime naturally provides a strong initialization for the second. On the 5-second VBench benchmark, TraF achieves a Total score of 85.15, outperforming Self Forcing (+0.84) and Causal Forcing (+1.11), with Quality and Semantic improving simultaneously. On 30-second generation---6$\times$ the training horizon---TraF achieves the highest overall quality among all compared methods.

AI.title_zh: 轨迹强制：利用扩散轨迹进行自回归长视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归（AR）建模可以说是将固定长度的视频扩散模型扩展到更长甚至流式视频的唯一途径。然而，现有的自回归扩散方法仅将先前预测的视频块（chunk）作为下一个视频块的上下文，丢弃了构成该视频块生成历史的中间预测结果。相比之下，LLM 等传统自回归模型以全部前序 token 的历史为条件。为此，我们提出轨迹强制（Trajectory Forcing, TraF），这是一种利用先前视频块去噪轨迹作为上下文的自回归扩散方法。TraF 在两种训练机制下运行：（1）使用真实视频，其中伪轨迹由高斯插值构建并由模型重新预测；（2）使用教师模型，其中真实轨迹从学生模型自身的去噪 rollout 中获得。第一种机制自然地为第二种机制提供了强初始化。在 5 秒的 VBench 基准上，TraF 取得了 85.15 的总分，优于 Self Forcing（+0.84）和 Causal Forcing（+1.11），且质量与语义指标同时提升。在 30 秒生成——即训练时间跨度的 6$\times$——上，TraF 在所有对比方法中取得了最高的整体质量。

title: Emo-LiveSync: Real-Time Universal Lip Synchronization with Explicit Emotion Control
